客服转专门流程与主Agent请求只读审查，适合不同组织。框架不会自动保证交接信息.en: Transferring customer support to a specialized workflow and having the main agent request a read-only review suit different organizations. Frameworks do not automatically make handoff information minimal yet complete; check what is passed, how original evidence is obtained and how errors return.

消融实验判断价值.en: Use ablation experiments to judge value

原创实验依次比较单Agent、加Skill、加并行调查、加独立审查，每次只改一项.en: An original experiment compares one agent, then adds a skill, parallel investigation and independent review, changing only one item at a time. Report simple and complex tasks separately so averages do not hide regressions. If routing reduces missed skills but greatly increases irrelevant loading, judge actual loss rather than hit rate alone.

自检：多个Agent同意是否证据独立？</strong>不是。<strong>并.en: Self-check: does agreement among agents mean independent evidence? No. Is parallelism always faster? No; coordination and dependencies may cancel the gains. Are longer skills more professional? No; judge whether necessary knowledge is used correctly at the right time.

对应资料：Equipping Agents with Agent Skills.en: Related material: Equipping Agents with Agent Skills

Agent Skills文章提出通过渐进披露组织专业能力：先展示元数据，相关时展.en: The Agent Skills article proposes organizing expertise through progressive disclosure: show metadata first, expand relevant main text, then read resources as needed. This changes information supply, not model parameters through training.

技能入口需要足够清晰以便发现，正文需要可执行的方法，资源需要可信且最新。任何一层.en: Skill entry points need clarity for discovery, main text needs actionable methods, and resources need trustworthiness and freshness. Failure at any layer can make a skill ineffective.

只加载相关技能节省什么.en: What loading only relevant skills saves

输入与条件。</strong>有10个技能，各正文1000单位，当前只需测试技能.en: Input and conditions. There are 10 skills, each with 1000 units of main text; only the testing skill is currently needed.

正文共10000.en: 10000 units of main text in total

大量不相关方法竞争上下文。.en: Many irrelevant methods compete for context.

先看短元数据，再读1个相关正文.en: Read short metadata first, then 1 relevant body

只需该正文和必要依赖。.en: Only that body and necessary dependencies are needed.

若漏掉真正必要技能.en: If a truly necessary skill is missed

省下长度却损害任务，须双向评测。.en: Saved length harms the task; evaluate both directions.

把过程连起来。</strong>渐进加载的目标是充分且相关，不是越少越好。.en: Join the steps up. Progressive loading aims for sufficiency and relevance, not minimum size alone.

原创练习：把一个长检查清单分成默认描述、任务正文与按需参考，说明哪些内容不应每轮.en: Original exercise: split a long checklist into a default description, task body and on-demand references. Explain what should not load every turn.

完成标准是减少无关上下文同时保留必要能力，而不是只把文档拆成更多文件。.en: Completion means reducing irrelevant context while preserving necessary capability, not merely splitting documents into more files.

用具体过程辅助理解：<a href=\"../visual/O11.html\".en: A concrete process to help: Multi-agent: work that can run in parallel matters more than the number of agents. The figure explains the shared mechanism; the method specific to this item and its experimental conclusions remain as stated in this item's own notes.
用具体过程辅助理解：<a href=\"../visual/O11.html\".ja: 具体的な過程で理解を助けます：マルチエージェント：数よりも、並列に進められる作業が重要。図解は共通の仕組みを説明します。この資料固有の手法と実験の結論は、この項目の講義資料に従います。

对应资料：Agent Skills Open Specification.en: Related material: Agent Skills Open Specification

开放技能规范描述文件、元数据和资源组织约定。遵守格式有助于互操作，但不保证所有客.en: The open skill specification defines conventions for files, metadata and resource organization. Format compliance helps interoperability, but does not guarantee identical loading, permission or execution behavior in every client.

规范有效与技能内容正确是两回事。一个格式合法的技能仍可能范围含糊、步骤过时或引用.en: Specification compliance differs from correct skill content. A validly formatted skill may still have vague scope, stale steps or invalid references.

Skill正文引用不存在的脚本.en: A skill body references a nonexistent script

输入与条件。</strong>SKILL.md要求运行scripts/check.en: Input and conditions. SKILL.md requires scripts/check.py, but that file is absent from the package.

相对路径目标不存在.en: The relative-path target does not exist

技能执行链断裂。.en: The skill execution chain is broken.

修正引用或补齐真实脚本.en: Correct the reference or supply the actual script

不让模型编造运行成功。.en: Do not let the model fabricate a successful run.

把过程连起来。</strong>技能规范、资源完整性与执行质量分别验证。.en: Join the steps up. Verify skill specifications, resource completeness and execution quality separately.

原创练习：验证一个玩具SKILL.md的字段和资源路径，再用真实任务检查是否被正.en: Original exercise: validate a toy SKILL.md's fields and resource paths, then check correct selection with a real task.

不要把格式测试当成专业能力评测。加载、遵循与最终工程结果需要分别验证。.en: Do not treat format tests as evaluations of expertise. Loading, adherence and final engineering outcomes need separate verification.

Claude Code技能可以通过产品支持的方式被发现和使用，部分配置影响执行上.en: Claude Code skills can be discovered and used through product-supported methods, with some settings affecting execution context. Check actual behavior against the version and documentation; the open specification alone cannot establish it.

技能与子Agent结合时，要检查工具、状态和返回方式。将任务放到独立上下文并不自.en: When combining skills with sub-agents, check tools, state and return methods. Moving a task into a separate context does not automatically preserve all evidence.

显式技能仍需检查当前任务约束.en: An explicitly selected skill still needs current task constraints checked

输入与条件。</strong>用户指定部署技能，但本轮同时说“仅制定方案”。.en: Input and conditions. The user selects a deployment skill but also says "plan only" this turn.

不等于授权实际部署。.en: This does not authorize actual deployment.

只输出计划与验证条件.en: Output only the plan and verification conditions

没有批准不发生产写动作.en: Do not issue production writes without approval

技能不能扩大用户授权。.en: A skill cannot expand user authorization.

把过程连起来。</strong>显式选技能和批准副作用是两件事。.en: Join the steps up. Explicit skill selection and approval of side effects are separate matters.

原创练习：分别在主会话与独立调查中使用同一技能，比较必要输入和结果交接，检查是否.en: Original exercise: use the same skill in the main session and an independent investigation, compare necessary inputs and handoffs, and check for duplicate reading.

本条关注使用条件，不主张所有技能都应隔离执行。简单任务直接加载可能更合适。.en: This item concerns conditions of use and does not advocate isolating every skill. Direct loading may suit simple tasks better.

Copilot技能提供任务相关的专业指导和资源。它与持续性仓库指令不同，不应默认.en: Copilot skills provide task-specific guidance and resources. They differ from persistent repository instructions; do not add every skill body to every task by default.

多表面支持差异要求先确认运行环境。安装成功与本轮加载是不同事实，不能用其中一个证.en: Differences across interfaces require checking the execution environment first. Successful installation and loading this turn are separate facts; neither proves the other.

一个平台支持Skill不代表所有表面加载规则相同.en: Skill support on one platform does not imply identical loading rules across interfaces

输入与条件。</strong>本地CLI读取技能成功，云任务却没有对应目录。.en: Input and conditions. The local CLI reads a skill successfully, but the cloud task lacks the corresponding directory.

本地未提交文件未在远程.en: Local uncommitted files are absent remotely

不是描述本身错误。.en: The description itself is not the error.

按产品支持方式提供资源.en: Supply resources through supported product methods

确认云环境真实存在。.en: Confirm they actually exist in the cloud environment.

候选发现、加载和执行分别看.en: Inspect candidate discovery, loading and execution separately

不直接外推本地结果。.en: Do not extrapolate directly from local results.

把过程连起来。</strong>适用表面、版本与文件分发属于事实条件。.en: Join the steps up. Supported interfaces, versions and file distribution are factual conditions.

原创练习：设计需要、无需和边界模糊三组任务，统计技能选择及最终质量，而非只检查文.en: Original exercise: design three task groups: skills needed, unnecessary and ambiguous. Measure skill selection and final quality rather than file existence alone.

完成标准是让路由“刚好够用”：必要技能不漏，不相关技能不成为额外负担。.en: Completion means routing provides "just enough": necessary skills are not missed, and irrelevant ones add no burden.

Codex技能入口与文档可能迁移，当前通用技能说明不能被无条件倒推为所有历史Co.en: Codex skill entry points and documentation may move; current general skill descriptions cannot unconditionally establish behavior in every historical Codex version. This book preserves the further-reading list's mappings without assuming all new extensions are backward compatible.

核心机制仍是通过元数据发现、相关时加载和按需获取资源。具体目录、触发和配置应在实.en: The core remains metadata discovery, loading when relevant and resource retrieval as needed. Check specific directories, triggers and configuration in the actual version.

Codex技能问题沿数据链定位.en: Trace Codex skill issues along the data chain

输入与条件。</strong>技能已安装，任务却没使用。.en: Input and conditions. A skill is installed but unused by the task.

确认是否读取技能内容.en: Confirm the skill content was read

若正文要求不可用工具.en: If the body requires unavailable tools

报告能力缺口而非再改描述。.en: Report the capability gap rather than editing the description again.

把过程连起来。</strong>把“未使用”拆成具体缺失环节才能有效修复。.en: Join the steps up. Effective repair requires breaking "unused" into specific missing steps.

原创练习：固定安装版本，记录一个技能被发现和读取的证据，再测试显式指定与语义选择.en: Original exercise: fix the installed version, record evidence that a skill was discovered and read, then test explicit selection versus semantic selection.

不要根据最终回答声称“使用了技能”就结束核验；应关注实际输入或可观察行为与结果。.en: Do not end verification because the final answer claims "the skill was used"; inspect actual inputs or observable behavior and results.

来源 S123，Codex技能加载与使用.en: Source S123, Codex skill loading and use

再次使用定制机制对照表时，重点是消除重叠职责。全局规则、专业技能、工具、事件检查.en: When returning to the customization comparison table, focus on eliminating overlapping responsibilities. Global rules, expertise, tools, event checks and role orchestration should each have a clear authoritative source.

同一约束在多个文件复制，短期看似保险，长期可能版本冲突。需要明确维护位置与引用关.en: Copying one constraint across several files may seem reassuring briefly but cause version conflicts later. Establish its maintenance location and reference relationships.

常驻规则与按需专业材料分别放.en: Separate resident rules from on-demand specialist material

输入与条件。</strong>项目总要求“不泄露凭据”，另有1000字性能调优手.en: Input and conditions. The project always requires "do not leak credentials" and also has a 1000-character performance-tuning manual.

按需技能或资源更合适。.en: An on-demand skill or resource fits better.

交给确定性流程，不只写在手册里。.en: Use a deterministic process, not just written instructions in a manual.

把过程连起来。</strong>先判内容的作用与频率，再选扩展机制。.en: Join the steps up. Judge content's role and frequency before choosing an extension mechanism.

原创练习：将“测试必须运行”分别放在说明、Skill和CI中，解释每层承担的是提.en: Original exercise: place "tests must run" in instructions, a Skill and CI, explaining whether each layer provides a reminder, method or enforced verification.

不是所有重复都该删除；必要的执行保障可以保留，但不要用多份文字副本代替真正的检查.en: Not every duplication needs removal; necessary execution safeguards may remain, but several text copies cannot replace actual checks.

10.7 · 主Agent与并行研究者.en: 10.7 · The main agent and parallel researchers

多Agent研究系统使用协调者与工作者处理可分解的研究方向。收益来自并行探索与任.en: Multi-agent research systems use coordinators and workers for separable research directions. Gains come from parallel exploration and task structure, alongside coordination, duplicate search and integration costs.

研究类任务的成功经验不能直接推广到多个Agent同时编辑同一文件。共享状态与写入.en: Research-task successes cannot be extended directly to several agents editing one file. Shared state and write conflicts may cancel parallel gains.

并行研究者要给不同证据范围.en: Give parallel researchers different evidence scopes

输入与条件。</strong>两子Agent都搜索完全相同关键词和网站。.en: Input and conditions. Two sub-agents search identical keywords and websites.

付两份成本不等于覆盖更广。.en: Paying twice does not mean broader coverage.

A查官方机制，B查可复现实现与反例.en: A checks official mechanisms; B checks reproducible implementations and counterexamples

更可能获得互补证据。.en: More likely to obtain complementary evidence.

去重、核对冲突和版本.en: Deduplicate and check conflicting claims and versions

父Agent不只拼接两份总结。.en: The parent agent does more than concatenate summaries.

把过程连起来。</strong>并行研究收益依赖任务独立性与信息互补。.en: Join the steps up. Parallel research gains depend on task independence and complementary information.

继续逐步计算：<a href=\"../chapters/20.html#wor.en: Continue the step-by-step calculation: <a href="../chapters/20.html#worked-Q078">Q054 · Two parallel tasks plus a merge: how the critical path is computed
继续逐步计算：<a href=\"../chapters/20.html#wor.ja: 段階的な計算を続ける：<a href="../chapters/20.html#worked-Q078">Q054 · 二つの並列タスクとマージのクリティカルパスをどう計算するか

原创练习：把一个调查拆成三个互相独立的问题，再列出一个不能拆开的依赖链。分别计算.en: Original exercise: split an investigation into three independent questions, then list a dependency chain that cannot be split. Calculate waiting and integration costs separately.

完成标准是证明任务分解带来新增证据或缩短关键路径，而不是增加角色数量。.en: Completion means proving that decomposition adds evidence or shortens the critical path, not just adds roles.

对应资料：LangGraph Workflows and Agents.en: Related material: LangGraph Workflows and Agents

LangGraph区分预设工作流与动态Agent，并提供路由、并行和协调等编排模.en: LangGraph distinguishes predefined workflows from dynamic agents and offers orchestration patterns such as routing, parallelism and coordination. A framework's expressive power does not mean every pattern should be used.

显式状态与边界有利于恢复和检查，但过细节点也会增加配置及交接成本。模型需要灵活判.en: Explicit state and boundaries help recovery and inspection, but overly fine nodes add configuration and handoff costs. Steps requiring flexible model judgment should not all be hard-coded.

DAG边决定谁可以同时跑.en: DAG edges determine what can run simultaneously

输入与条件。</strong>A读模块1，B读模块2，C需要A/B结果，D只需A.en: Input and conditions. A reads module 1, B reads module 2, C needs A/B results, and D needs only A.

不相互等待。.en: They do not wait for one another.

C仍需等B。.en: C must still wait for B.

按依赖而不是固定全阶段屏障调度。.en: Schedule by dependencies rather than fixed barriers across whole stages.

把过程连起来。</strong>正确依赖可以减少无意义等待，但共享写入还需额外约.en: Join the steps up. Correct dependencies reduce needless waits; shared writes still need additional constraints.

原创练习：把固定校验与未知原因调查放在不同节点，说明哪些边可预设、哪些需依赖观察.en: Original exercise: put fixed validation and investigation of unknown causes in different nodes. Explain which edges can be predefined and which depend on observations.

完成标准是流程能解释实际任务，而不是为了展示框架能力构建复杂图。.en: Completion means a flow that explains actual tasks, not a complex graph built to showcase framework capabilities.

Handoff通常表示把控制移交给另一个Agent，与把子Agent当工具调用并.en: Handoff usually means transferring control to another agent, unlike calling a sub-agent as a tool and receiving a result. The SDK defines specific context filtering and control semantics.

交接需要传递目标、已知事实和必要状态，同时避免泄露无关敏感内容。控制权转移不是权.en: A handoff must pass the goal, known facts and necessary state while avoiding unrelated sensitive content. Transferring control does not grant unlimited inherited permissions.

handoff与返回结果的调用不同.en: handoff differs from a call that returns a result

输入与条件。</strong>主Agent把客户问题转给账单Agent。.en: Input and conditions. The main agent transfers a customer's issue to a billing agent.

后续轮由账单角色推进。.en: The billing role drives subsequent turns.

主Agent调用账单分析后等结果.en: The main agent calls billing analysis and waits for a result

主Agent继续整体任务。.en: The main agent continues the overall task.

是否需要长期接管决定方式.en: Choose by whether sustained takeover is needed

把过程连起来。</strong>交接控制流与普通函数式委派有不同生命周期。.en: Join the steps up. Control-flow handoff and ordinary function-like delegation have different lifecycles.

原创练习：设计普通接待转专门流程的交接，再设计只读审查返回主Agent的调用，比.en: Original exercise: design a handoff from general reception to a specialized workflow, then a read-only review call returning to the main agent. Compare responsibility for final answers and error handling.

完成标准是清楚控制权和状态边界，避免Agent之间反复转交却无人负责完成。.en: Completion means clear control and state boundaries, avoiding repeated handoffs with nobody responsible for completion.

10.10 · Agent配置与作为工具调用.en: 10.10 · Agent configuration and calling agents as tools

Agents SDK中的Agent定义组织模型、指令与工具等配置，也支持不同协作.en: An Agent definition in Agents SDK organizes model, instruction and tool configuration and supports several collaboration methods. Defining the object does not guarantee completion; a runner, environment and acceptance are still needed.

把Agent作为工具使用时，调用者通常消费结果并继续外层任务；应明确输入输出，而.en: When an agent acts as a tool, its caller usually consumes the result and continues the outer task. Define inputs and outputs rather than return unbounded history.

Agent-as-tool返回仍是待核验结果.en: An Agent-as-tool return is still a result to verify

输入与条件。</strong>分析子Agent返回根因X与证据路径。.en: Input and conditions. An analysis sub-agent returns root cause X and evidence paths.

不自动信为终局。.en: Does not automatically accept it as final.

读取当前版本对应行.en: Read corresponding lines in the current version

父级保留完成责任。.en: The parent retains responsibility for completion.

把过程连起来。</strong>把Agent封装为工具不消除模型错误与交接损失。.en: Join the steps up. Wrapping an agent as a tool does not remove model errors or handoff losses.

原创练习：定义一个只返回证据摘要的调查者，主Agent据此决定是否修改。检查调查.en: Original exercise: define an investigator returning only an evidence summary; the main agent then decides whether to edit. Check whether findings include sources and uncertainty.

避免让每个角色都重复完整计划与审查。角色存在应对应真实的独立责任。.en: Avoid having every role repeat a full plan and review. Each role should correspond to a real independent responsibility.

Agentless以较简单的定位、修复与验证流程作为软件工程任务方案，提醒复杂A.en: Agentless uses a relatively simple localization, repair and verification process for software engineering tasks, reminding us that complex agent architectures need strong-baseline comparisons. It does not prove dynamic agents never have value.

简单流程更容易归因和调试，但可能不适合开放探索或高度动态环境。选择取决于任务结构.en: Simple processes are easier to attribute and debug but may not suit open exploration or highly dynamic environments. Selection depends on task structure rather than names.

简单强基线先做出来.en: Build a strong simple baseline first

输入与条件。</strong>Bug可通过定位、补丁、测试三步解决。.en: Input and conditions. A bug can be solved in three steps: locate, patch, test.

复杂方案有可重复净收益.en: The complex approach gives reproducible net gains

把过程连起来。</strong>Agentless式基线的价值是检验哪些自主机制.en: Join the steps up. An Agentless-style baseline tests which autonomous mechanisms are actually necessary.

原创练习：对一组局部Bug分别运行固定流程和动态探索，记录成功、工具轮次和返工，.en: Original exercise: run fixed workflows and dynamic exploration on a set of localized bugs. Record success, tool rounds and rework, and analyze the sources of differences.

完成标准是能够保留真正带来收益的复杂性，并删除没有证据支持的编排层。.en: Completion means keeping complexity that actually helps and removing orchestration layers unsupported by evidence.

AutoGen通过多Agent对话与配置支持协作。消息交换可以分工，也会引入循环.en: AutoGen supports collaboration through multi-agent conversation and configuration. Messages divide work but may also create loops, duplication and shared wrong premises.

不同角色表达不同意见，不代表证据独立。若都依赖同一错误摘要，一致或辩论都不能自动.en: Different roles expressing different views does not establish independent evidence. If all rely on the same wrong summary, neither agreement nor debate automatically produces truth.

多Agent对话会循环赞同.en: Multi-agent conversations can loop through agreement

输入与条件。</strong>A说方案可行，B复述认可，A把认可当新增证据。.en: Input and conditions. A says a plan is viable, B repeats agreement, and A treats that agreement as new evidence.

证据数量并未增加。.en: The amount of evidence has not increased.

要求测试或具体反例.en: Require a test or concrete counterexample

把对话转为有信息增量的行动。.en: Turn conversation into action that adds information.

把过程连起来。</strong>对话次数不是证据数量。.en: Join the steps up. Conversation count is not evidence count.

原创练习：给两个角色不同但可核验的材料，再比较共享同一材料的情况。要求结论回到证.en: Original exercise: give two roles different but verifiable material, then compare with both sharing the same material. Require conclusions grounded in evidence rather than voting.

完成标准是明确发言、控制、停止与验证规则，不把持续对话当成持续进步。.en: Completion means explicit speaking, control, stopping and verification rules, not equating continued conversation with continued progress.

路由回归的正负样本.ja: ルーティングの回帰テストの正例と負例

同一Skill描述分别用于简单重命名、协议迁移和显式指定任务，测必需召回与无关加.ja: 同じスキルの記述を、単純な名前変更、プロトコル移行、明示的に指定したタスクにそれぞれ使い、必要な候補取得と無関係な読み込みを測ります。

关键边界：</strong>只测正样本会鼓励描述不断扩张，最终每个任务都加载。.en: Key boundary: testing positive samples only encourages the description to keep expanding, until it loads for every task.
关键边界：</strong>只测正样本会鼓励描述不断扩张，最终每个任务都加载。.ja: 重要な境界：正例だけでテストすると、説明を広げ続けるよう促し、最終的にどのタスクでも読み込まれるようになります。

顺着源码或工程依据继续追：</strong>发现、选择、正文加载、资源执行、有效.en: Follow it further through the source or the engineering basis: review five stages — discovery, selection, body loading, resource execution and validity. Do not check only the path that goes well; check the behavior on cancellation, on a version change, and when the result is unknown.
顺着源码或工程依据继续追：</strong>发现、选择、正文加载、资源执行、有效.ja: ソースコードや工学的根拠をさらにたどる：発見・選択・本文の読み込み・リソースの実行・有効性の五段階をレビューします。正常な経路だけでなく、キャンセル、バージョンの変化、結果不明の場合の振る舞いも照合します。

AI软件工程不是生成尽可能多的代码，而是让需求、实现与证据对齐。SWE-agen.en: AI software engineering aligns requirements, implementation and evidence rather than generating as much code as possible. SWE-agent studies the operating interface, long-running harness research studies progress across sessions, and traditional testing and review provide quality foundations; none can replace the others.

完成标准：嵌套路径有效，旧顶层行为不变，非法配置明确报错，相关测试通过，没有无关.en: completion standard: nested paths work, old top-level behavior stays unchanged, invalid configuration produces explicit errors, related tests pass, and there are no unrelated interface changes. "Looks professional" can reward stacked abstractions; "all tests pass" may also be false completion if the tests are too weak.

理解目标→找证据→复现→确定边界→修改→验证→交付，是实用思路而非固定审批制度。.en: Understand the goal→find evidence→reproduce→define boundaries→change→verify→deliver is a practical approach, not a fixed approval system. Simple tasks can proceed continuously; complex tasks expand when evidence is insufficient. The smallest sufficient change is not mechanically the fewest lines, but a change that meets the goal with reasonable risk.

来源 S136，审查标准与非完美交付.en: Source S136, Review standards and less-than-perfect delivery
来源 S136，审查标准与非完美交付.ja: 出典 S136、レビュー基準と不完全さを許容する提供

原创例子：路径基准不一致，可以调用前规范化，也可以匹配器内部规范化。选择取决于职.en: Original examples: inconsistent path bases can be normalized before the call or inside the matcher. The choice depends on responsibilities, callers and compatibility, not a new global framework for uniformity's sake. Fewer unrelated formatting changes help review, but structural issues that actually prevent correctness must still be addressed.

测试行为，不迎合实现.en: Test behavior rather than accommodating the implementation

单元测试便于定位，集成测试验证边界，端到端测试验证用户路径。测试金字塔是成本与反.en: Unit tests help locate issues, integration tests verify boundaries, and end-to-end tests verify user paths. The testing pyramid is a principle about cost and feedback, not a fixed numerical recipe.

来源 S138，测试金字塔.ja: 出典 S138、テストピラミッド

，单元测规范化，集成测配置和文件列表，端到端测产物。还要验证不应排除的文件，避免.en: , unit tests cover normalization, integration tests cover configuration and file lists, and end-to-end tests cover artifacts. Also verify files that should not be excluded, so "filter everything" does not pass one-sided assertions. Tie test records to code versions; adding patch B after A passes does not automatically extend the old results to the new version.

CI稳定执行检查与反馈，不证明所有未测行为正确。Agent不应为绿色状态删除不理.en: CI runs checks and feedback consistently; it does not prove every untested behavior correct. An agent should not delete tests it does not understand to get a green status, unless requirements have actually changed and evidence is sufficient.

给审查发现分成架构错误与局部命名问题；后者直接带入实现与验证，前者再改变方案。.en: Split review findings into architectural errors and local naming problems; the latter go straight into implementation and verification, while the former change the plan first.
给审查发现分成架构错误与局部命名问题；后者直接带入实现与验证，前者再改变方案。.ja: レビューの指摘を、アーキテクチャの誤りと局所的な命名の問題に分けます。後者はそのまま実装と検証へ進め、前者は案を変更してから進めます。

关键边界：</strong>不把每个问题都升级为重新设计，衡量返工与缺陷是否真的.en: Key boundary: do not escalate every problem into a redesign; measure whether rework and defects really do go down.
关键边界：</strong>不把每个问题都升级为重新设计，衡量返工与缺陷是否真的.ja: 重要な境界：すべての問題を再設計にまで広げず、手戻りと欠陥が実際に減ったかを測ります。

顺着源码或工程依据继续追：</strong>用可恢复状态、功能验收与最小检查点连.en: Follow it further through the source or the engineering basis: connect the work with recoverable state, functional acceptance and minimal checkpoints. Do not check only the path that goes well; check the behavior on cancellation, on a version change, and when the result is unknown.
顺着源码或工程依据继续追：</strong>用可恢复状态、功能验收与最小检查点连.ja: ソースコードや工学的根拠をさらにたどる：復旧可能な状態、機能の受け入れ検証、最小限のチェックポイントで作業をつなぎます。正常な経路だけでなく、キャンセル、バージョンの変化、結果不明の場合の振る舞いも照合します。

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../chapters/22.html.en: For the complete mechanism and the continuous example see How does a long task avoid starting over each time, or finishing falsely?; this section keeps its original derivation and experiment, and the two accounts work at different levels rather than replacing each other.
完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../chapters/22.html.ja: 仕組み全体と一連の例は、長期タスクで、毎回のやり直しや偽の完了を避けるには？を参照してください。この節でも従来の導出と実験を残しています。両者は異なる水準の説明であり、互いを置き換えるものではありません。

Review不追求无穷完美.en: Review does not seek endless perfection

Google标准强调改善整体代码健康度，并区分重要问题与个人偏好。Review应.en: Google's standards emphasize improving overall code health and distinguishing important issues from personal preferences. Review should focus on design, functionality, complexity and tests rather than indefinitely blocking imperfect but reasonable progress.

原创流程可以允许审查者直接修正小而明确的问题，再验证；跨模块或目标歧义再交回处理.en: An original process can let reviewers directly fix small, clear issues and verify them; cross-module issues or ambiguous goals go back for handling. Independent review adds value by finding new important problems, not by adding another role name. Repeated reviews without new evidence may only increase latency.

早期长任务Harness案例使用初始化与增量开发职责，配合进度、功能清单和版本历.en: Early long-task harness cases used initialization and incremental-development responsibilities alongside progress records, feature lists and version history. Later experiments explored combinations of planning, generation and evaluation, adjusting context-reset strategies as model capability changed. These are conditional cases, not requirements that every project use identical file names and roles.

原创最小交接包括当前可运行状态、已完成与未完成需求、决策理由、验证证据和下一步。.en: An original minimal handoff includes the current runnable state, completed and incomplete requirements, decision reasons, verification evidence and next steps. A small bug does not need hundreds of acceptance items first. Multi-agent compiler cases offer lessons in task division and testing; code volume does not establish that arbitrary scenarios can run without human management.

来源 S134，并行Agent构建编译器案例.ja: 出典 S134、並列エージェントによるコンパイラー構築の事例

It distinguished affected product layers from the API situation at the time; it is not a universal explanation for every quality fluctuation.

来源 S141，编码Agent质量回退复盘.ja: 出典 S141、コーディングエージェントの品質低下の振り返り

原创启发：版本化模型、Prompt、工具、裁剪和环境，测试长会话与恢复场景，做消.en: Original lesson: version the model, prompt, tools, trimming and environment; test long sessions and recovery scenarios; use ablations to locate causes. Testing only newly created short sessions may miss state-dependent failures.

ADR记录背景、选择和后果，适合重要且可能被重新质疑的决策，不必为每个变量写文档.en: An ADR records context, choices and consequences. It suits important decisions that may be questioned again; not every variable needs documentation. Delivery should state actual changes, verification results, unverified parts and risks rather than a vague "everything is complete".

长期Harness文章研究如何让Agent跨多个上下文持续推进应用开发，通过初始.en: The long-running harness article studies how agents keep developing applications across multiple contexts, maintaining progress through initialization, incremental tasks and handoff records. It concerns specific experiments, not a file and role checklist every project must copy.

长对话不是唯一持久状态。需求、代码版本、测试结果与下一步应能在新会话中重新确认，.en: A long conversation is not the only persistent state. Requirements, code versions, test results and next steps should be reconfirmable in a new session to avoid repeatedly starting from zero.

新上下文如何接着修复而不重做.en: How a new context continues a fix without redoing it

输入与条件。</strong>上一阶段已写v8，测试未运行，原文日志外置。.en: Input and conditions. The previous stage wrote v8, tests have not run, and the original logs are stored externally.

目标、v8、未测、禁止提交.en: Goal, v8, untested, do not commit

先确认磁盘确为v8.en: First confirm the disk really contains v8

避免拿旧检查点继续。.en: Avoid continuing from an old checkpoint.

不重新应用已完成补丁。.en: Do not reapply a completed patch.

把过程连起来。</strong>跨窗口连续性依赖可核查状态，不是让模型记得全部聊.en: Join the steps up. Continuity across windows depends on checkable state, not making the model remember every chat message.

原创练习：完成一半功能后清空会话，只保留简短交接和原始证据位置，让后续过程恢复任.en: Original exercise: clear the session halfway through a feature, keeping only a short handoff and original-evidence locations, then have the subsequent process recover the task.

完成标准是不重复已完成动作、不把未验证状态当成通过，并能识别环境后来发生的变化。.en: The completion standard is avoiding repeated completed actions, not treating unverified state as a pass, and recognizing later environmental changes.

长应用开发Harness探索规划、生成与评价之间的反馈组织，尤其关注完整应用的质.en: Long application-development harnesses explore feedback among planning, generation and evaluation, particularly the quality of complete applications. Changing model capability may make some older constraints unnecessary, so the approach needs reassessment.

复杂应用需要外部验收与状态管理，简单修复却可能不值得同样编排。不能把一个成功案例.en: Complex applications need external acceptance and state management, while a simple fix may not justify the same orchestration. One successful case cannot become a fixed multi-stage system.

完成标准是根据任务风险和证据决定深度，不把流程长度当作专业程度。.en: The completion standard is choosing depth according to task risk and evidence, not treating process length as professionalism.

SWE-agent研究面向Agent的计算机交互接口如何影响自动软件工程。搜索、.en: SWE-agent studies how computer interaction interfaces designed for agents affect automated software engineering. Search, reading, editing and testing tool design affects whether the model can act effectively.

相同模型使用不同工具界面可能表现不同。工具输出过大、编辑反馈模糊或错误信息缺失，.en: The same model may perform differently with different tool interfaces. Oversized tool output, unclear editing feedback and missing error messages all increase failure probability.

工具接口保留行号怎样帮助补丁准确定位.en: How line numbers in tool interfaces help locate patches precisely

输入与条件。</strong>文件很长，只返回匹配行文本但无路径/行号。.en: Input and conditions. A file is long, but only matching line text is returned, without a path/line number.

模型知道关键词但不知道改哪里.en: The model knows the keyword but not where to change

返回路径、范围、版本与上下文.en: Return the path, range, version and context

完成标准是把工具设计当作可评测的工程变量，而不是所有失败都通过换模型解决。.en: The completion standard is treating tool design as an engineering variable to evaluate, rather than changing the model to address every failure.

11.4 · 代码审查的目的与流程.en: 11.4 · The purpose and process of code review

对应资料：Google Engineering Practices Code R.en: Related material: Google Engineering Practices Code Review

Google代码审查实践关注设计、功能、复杂性、测试和可维护性等方面。审查应改善.en: Google's code-review practices cover design, functionality, complexity, tests and maintainability. Review should improve code health rather than block every imperfect change without evidence.

AI可以协助发现问题，但必须结合补丁、上下文和验证。只读作者解释容易共享同一个错.en: AI can help find problems, but must be combined with the patch, context and verification. Reading only the author's explanation can lead to sharing the same incorrect premise.

审查发现小命名问题，如何避免重走设计.en: How to avoid restarting design over a small naming issue found in review

输入与条件。</strong>功能与测试正确，仅局部变量名误导。.en: Input and conditions. Functionality and tests are correct; only a local variable name is misleading.

不影响架构选择.en: It does not affect architectural choices

按实际影响补检查.en: Add checks according to the actual impact

完成后合并，不无限延长审查。.en: Merge when finished, without extending review indefinitely.

把过程连起来。</strong>Review应改善代码健康度，不把所有问题升级为.en: Join the steps up. Review should improve code health, not turn every issue into a process blocker.

原创练习：审查一个能通过目标测试但破坏默认行为的补丁，指出需要额外读取与验证的地.en: Original exercise: review a patch that passes target tests but breaks default behavior, and identify where more reading and verification are needed.

完成标准是提出具体、可行动且有依据的问题，不用大量风格意见制造“审查很深入”的印.en: The completion standard is specific, actionable, evidence-based issues, not a mass of style comments creating an impression of "deep review".

11.5 · 并行Agent构建编译器案例.en: 11.5 · A case of parallel agents building a compiler

对应资料：Building a C Compiler.en: Related material: Building a C Compiler

并行Agent构建编译器的案例展示任务分工、测试基础设施与协调的结合。它是特定项.en: The case of parallel agents building a compiler combines task division, testing infrastructure and coordination. It is specific project experience, not a guarantee that arbitrary complex software can run entirely without human management.

代码规模与任务正确性不同。编译器需要语言语义、测试覆盖、平台行为等多方面验证，生.en: Code volume differs from task correctness. A compiler needs verification of language semantics, test coverage, platform behavior and more; generating many files is only a process metric.

并行写编译器的模块接口要一致.en: Module interfaces must agree when agents build a compiler in parallel

输入与条件。</strong>Agent A写词法Token，B写解析器，双方对.en: Input and conditions. Agent A writes lexical tokens and B writes the parser, but they use different names for token.type.

A自己的测试、B自己的mock都绿.en: A's own tests and B's own mocks are green

明确共享接口与组合测试.en: Define shared interfaces and combined tests

不是只再加两个独立审查者。.en: Do more than add two independent reviewers.

把过程连起来。</strong>大规模并行需要真实集成反馈；本例不是已发表项目的.en: Join the steps up. Large-scale parallelism needs real integration feedback; this example is not original experimental data from the published project.

继续逐步计算：<a href=\"../chapters/20.html#wor.en: Continue the step-by-step calculation: <a href="../chapters/20.html#worked-Q079">Q055 · Two agents both write the same file from v7: what happens to the later write

原创练习：把词法分析、解析和代码生成之间的接口画清，说明哪些可并行、哪些需要先稳.en: Original exercise: draw clear interfaces among lexical analysis, parsing and code generation, explaining what can run in parallel and what needs stable agreements first.

完成标准是学习可分解边界与验证机制，不把案例中的投入或成绩外推成自己的预算承诺。.en: The completion standard is learning decomposable boundaries and verification mechanisms, not turning the case's investment or results into promises about your own budget.

对应资料：Copilot Agentic Code Review.en: Related material: Copilot Agentic Code Review

Copilot的Agent代码审查功能提供发现和处理问题的产品入口，但不能代替项.en: Copilot's agentic code-review feature offers a product entry point for finding and handling issues, but cannot replace project acceptance. Check support and permissions for the specific CLI version.

审查结果需要区分实际缺陷、风险提示和风格建议。模型提出的问题也可能错误，应以源码.en: Review results must distinguish actual defects, risk notices and style suggestions. Model-raised issues may also be wrong; verify them against source code, specifications and tests.

Agent审查不能只复述diff.en: Agent review must do more than paraphrase the diff

输入与条件。</strong>补丁把&gt;=改&gt;，用户需求在边界等值仍应.en: Input and conditions. The patch changes >= to >, while the user's requirement still permits equality at the boundary.

等值输入应允许.en: Equal input values should be allowed

新行为违反契约。.en: The new behavior violates the contract.

构造相等测试并失败.en: Construct an equality test that fails

把过程连起来。</strong>有效Review要连接需求、变化和反例，而非点评.en: Join the steps up. Effective review connects requirements, changes and counterexamples rather than merely commenting on code style.

原创练习：给一个含真实边界Bug及无害风格差异的补丁，检查审查是否正确排序重要性.en: Original exercise: provide a patch with a real boundary bug and harmless style differences, and check whether the review ranks their importance correctly.

完成标准是减少有效缺陷与返工，而不是追求评论数量或强迫每次审查都有发现。.en: The completion standard is reducing real defects and rework, not maximizing comments or forcing every review to find something.

对应资料：The Standard of Code Review.en: Related material: The Standard of Code Review

代码审查标准强调当修改改善整体代码健康度时，不应因尚未完美而无限阻塞。重要质量问.en: Code-review standards emphasize that a change improving overall code health should not be blocked indefinitely because it is not yet perfect. Distinguish important quality issues from personal preferences.

这并不意味着降低正确性要求。关键缺陷、兼容性和安全问题仍应解决；只是避免把所有小.en: This does not lower correctness requirements. Critical defects, compatibility and security issues still need resolution; it merely avoids turning every small suggestion into major rework.

不完美但改善代码与阻塞缺陷分开.en: Separate imperfect improvements from blocking defects

输入与条件。</strong>补丁修复数据丢失，仍有一个不影响功能的小注释措辞。.en: Input and conditions. The patch fixes data loss but still has a minor comment-wording issue that does not affect functionality.

数据丢失已被反例与回归验证.en: The data-loss fix is verified by counterexamples and regression tests

注释措辞可直接修或后续记录.en: Fix the comment directly or record it for later

不必否定整个方案。.en: The whole approach need not be rejected.

若仍有可触发丢失更新.en: If a lost update can still be triggered

不能以“整体改善”掩盖重大缺陷。.en: "Overall improvement" must not conceal a major defect.

把过程连起来。</strong>审查标准允许渐进改善，但不等于忽略实际风险。.en: Join the steps up. Review standards allow incremental improvement, not disregard of actual risk.

原创练习：将审查意见分为必须修复、可直接顺手修复和非阻塞建议，逐条写出具体后果。.en: Original exercise: classify review comments as must-fix, small direct fixes or nonblocking suggestions, and state the concrete consequence of each.

完成标准是让Review的成本与实际风险匹配，而不是形成设计—审查—重设计的无休.en: The completion standard is matching review cost to actual risk, rather than an endless design–review–redesign loop.

对应资料：What to Look for in a Code Review.en: Related material: What to Look for in a Code Review

审查检查内容覆盖设计、功能、复杂度、测试、命名和文档等，但不同修改需要不同重点。.en: Review checks cover design, functionality, complexity, tests, naming and documentation, but different changes need different priorities. A configuration fix should not automatically trigger a full architectural refactor.

测试存在不代表测试有效，注释丰富也不代表解释准确。审查应检查它们是否支持实际行为.en: Tests being present does not make them effective, and plentiful comments do not make explanations accurate. Review should check whether they support actual behavior and maintenance.

设计、复杂度与测试一起判断.en: Judge design, complexity and tests together

输入与条件。</strong>为了排除一个目录，引入三层插件和一张数据库表。.en: Input and conditions. Excluding one directory introduces three plugin layers and a database table.

简单边界判断已经覆盖目标.en: A simple boundary check already covers the goal

额外组件尚无失败模式对应。.en: No failure mode yet justifies the extra components.

可能大于收益。.en: The cost may exceed the gain.

用实际扩展需求证明抽象必要.en: Establish the abstraction's necessity through actual extension needs

把过程连起来。</strong>工程合理性不是组件越多越资深。.en: Join the steps up. More components do not mean more senior engineering judgment.

原创练习：阅读一个只有正向断言的过滤测试，增加“不应排除其他文件”的反例，解释遗.en: Original exercise: read a filtering test containing only positive assertions, add a counterexample that "other files must not be excluded", and explain the risk the test missed.

完成标准是从目标和失败模式出发选择检查项，而不是机械完成一张与任务无关的长表。.en: The completion standard is choosing checks from goals and failure modes, not mechanically completing a long checklist unrelated to the task.

对应资料：The Practical Test Pyramid.en: Related material: The Practical Test Pyramid

测试金字塔说明不同层次测试在范围、速度和维护成本上的差异。单元、集成与端到端测试.en: The testing pyramid explains differences in scope, speed and maintenance cost among test levels. Unit, integration and end-to-end tests complement one another; no fixed numerical ratio suits every project.

测试应验证行为而非锁死实现细节。过度依赖内部结构会让合理重构频繁破坏测试，过度只.en: Tests should verify behavior rather than lock down implementation details. Excessive dependence on internal structure makes reasonable refactors break tests frequently, while testing only the final interface can make faults hard to locate.

三层测试分别抓哪类错.en: Which errors the three test levels catch

输入与条件。</strong>路径判断、配置读取、真实构建流程三个层次。.en: Input and conditions. Three levels: path checks, configuration reading and the actual build flow.

读取配置并调用判断.en: Read configuration and invoke the check

验证完整行为，但成本更高。.en: Verify complete behavior at higher cost.

把过程连起来。</strong>层次互补，不是把所有测试都堆到最慢的端到端。.en: Join the steps up. The levels complement one another; do not pile every test into the slowest end-to-end layer.

原创练习：为exclude设计匹配函数、配置集成和最终构建产物三个层次测试，说明.en: Original exercise: design three test levels for exclude: the matching function, configuration integration and final build artifacts. Explain each level's unique value.

完成标准是用较低成本覆盖关键风险，而不是用测试数量代替覆盖质量。.en: The completion standard is covering key risks at lower cost, not replacing coverage quality with test counts.

持续集成强调频繁整合与自动反馈，尽早发现变化之间的冲突。CI绿色状态只说明已配置.en: Continuous integration emphasizes frequent integration and automated feedback to find conflicts among changes early. Green CI means only that configured checks passed, not that every requirement and defect is covered.

Agent修改后应记录验证对应的版本。之后继续改代码，旧测试通过记录不能自动证明.en: After an agent changes code, record the version to which verification applies. If code changes again, old passing test records do not automatically establish the latest code's correctness.

持续集成测试必须针对合并结果.en: Continuous integration tests must target the merged result

输入与条件。</strong>分支A/B各自基于v7测试通过，合并后产生v9。.en: Input and conditions. Branches A/B each pass tests based on v7; merging them produces v9.

只使用对应版本验证结果.en: Use only verification results for the corresponding version

避免错用旧流水线绿灯。.en: Avoid misusing an old pipeline's green status.

把过程连起来。</strong>CI的价值在频繁且版本对齐的反馈。.en: Join the steps up. CI's value lies in frequent feedback tied to the correct version.

继续逐步计算：<a href=\"../chapters/22.html#wor.en: Continue the step-by-step calculation: <a href="../chapters/22.html#worked-Q086">Q006 · The tests pass 100% — so why can the patch still be wrong

原创练习：让补丁A通过测试后再应用补丁B，检查交付说明是否准确区分已验证与待验证.en: Original exercise: apply patch B after patch A passes tests, and check whether the delivery account accurately separates verified parts from those awaiting verification.

完成标准是把验证嵌入实际交付流程，同时保持反馈速度，避免所有小改动都运行无关且昂.en: The completion standard is embedding verification in actual delivery while keeping feedback fast, rather than running expensive, unrelated checks for every small change.

11.11 · 记录架构决策及其条件.en: 11.11 · Recording architecture decisions and their conditions

ADR记录重要架构决策的背景、选择与后果，帮助未来维护者理解当时约束。它不是为每.en: An ADR records the context, choices and consequences of an important architecture decision, helping future maintainers understand the constraints at the time. It does not require documentation for every variable or small fix.

有价值的记录应说明替代方案和取舍，而不是只写“提高可维护性”。条件变化后，旧决定.en: A useful record explains alternatives and trade-offs, not merely "improves maintainability". When conditions change, a new decision can supersede an old one while preserving its historical reasons.

架构决策记录需要包含放弃条件.en: Architecture decision records need conditions for abandoning a choice

输入与条件。</strong>决定暂用关键词检索，不建向量库。.en: Input and conditions. The decision is to use keyword retrieval for now, without a vector database.

符号查询占多数且精确搜索有效.en: Most queries concern symbols, and exact search works

绑定当前场景。.en: Tie the decision to the current situation.

自然语言跨模块发现较弱.en: Natural-language discovery across modules is weak

相关任务持续漏召回并有测评证据.en: Relevant tasks repeatedly miss recall, with evaluation evidence

到时再升级，而非永久教条。.en: Upgrade then, rather than adopting permanent dogma.

把过程连起来。</strong>有用ADR记录为什么及何时重新考虑，不只记录选了.en: Join the steps up. A useful ADR records why and when to reconsider, not just what was chosen.

原创练习：为“在匹配器入口统一路径”写一段简短决策，包含调用者约定、兼容风险和失.en: Original exercise: write a short decision for "normalize paths at the matcher entry point", including caller conventions, compatibility risks and conditions that invalidate the decision.

完成标准是让未来Agent能判断是否仍适用，而不是把旧决策当成永远不能改变的规则.en: The completion standard is letting a future agent judge whether a decision still applies, not treating old decisions as rules that can never change.

11.12 · 编码Agent质量回退复盘.en: 11.12 · Retrospective on a coding-agent quality regression

对应资料：An Update on Recent Claude Code Qua.en: Related material: An Update on Recent Claude Code Quality Reports

2026年4月的Claude Code质量复盘指出部分变化来自产品层的推理配置、.en: Claude Code's 2026-4 quality retrospective identifies product-layer reasoning configuration, history handling and prompt adjustments as sources of some changes. Final product quality cannot be equated with underlying model capability.

同一模型在不同Harness配置下可能表现不同。尤其长会话、恢复与上下文清理相关.en: The same model may perform differently under different harness configurations. Defects involving long sessions, recovery and context cleanup in particular may escape short-task tests.

产品质量回退先拆模型与Harness.en: Separate model and harness first when product quality regresses

输入与条件。</strong>模型版本没变，工具结果裁剪策略改变。.en: Input and conditions. The model version stays unchanged, but the tool-result trimming policy changes.

任务更常遗漏关键报错.en: Tasks miss key errors more often

同日志保持模型相同，只恢复输出范围.en: Keep the same logs and model, restoring only the output scope

只有受控证据支持时归因.en: Attribute causes only when controlled evidence supports them

不凭用户感觉宣称模型“变笨”。.en: Do not claim the model "got dumber" from user impressions alone.

把过程连起来。</strong>此为故障诊断构造，不冒充厂商事故细节或内部原因。.en: Join the steps up. This is a constructed diagnosis example, not vendor incident details or internal causes.

原创练习：固定模型，分别改变推理预算、历史裁剪和输出要求，设计消融测试以定位回归.en: Original exercise: hold the model fixed and separately change reasoning budget, history trimming and output requirements. Design ablation tests to locate the regression.

完成标准是保存可比较版本与执行证据，不把用户感知的质量下降简单解释成“模型变笨了.en: The completion standard is preserving comparable versions and execution evidence, not simply explaining perceived quality loss as "the model got dumber".

11.13 · 推理与执行环境解耦.en: 11.13 · Decoupling inference from the execution environment

Managed Agents文章讨论把模型运行、会话状态和执行环境解耦。这样可以.en: The Managed Agents article discusses decoupling model execution, session state and the execution environment. This reduces the impact of a single container or process failure on overall task continuity, while adding boundary-design needs.

持久日志应区分意图与已执行事实。重放任务历史不应自动重放全部外部副作用。.en: Persistent logs should distinguish intent from executed facts. Replaying task history should not automatically replay every external side effect.

模型进程中断，外部任务仍可能运行.en: An external task may keep running after the model process stops

输入与条件。</strong>远端构建启动后模型会话断开。.en: Input and conditions. The model session disconnects after a remote build starts.

不是构建被取消的证明。.en: This does not prove the build was canceled.

构建服务有独立job_id.en: The build service has an independent job_id

按job_id查询状态并接回任务.en: Query status by job_id and reconnect it to the task

不直接再启动一份构建。.en: Do not immediately start another build.

把过程连起来。</strong>推理与执行生命周期解耦必须配套任务身份与恢复。.en: Join the steps up. Decoupling inference and execution lifecycles requires matching task identity and recovery mechanisms.

原创练习：在文件修改完成但Harness重启的情境下，设计如何恢复状态并检查版本.en: Original exercise: after a file change completes but the harness restarts, design state recovery and version checking instead of blindly applying the patch again.

小型本地工具未必需要立即服务化。应先保持职责清晰，再随真实恢复与规模需求演进。.en: A small local tool may not need to become a service immediately. Keep responsibilities clear first, then evolve with actual recovery and scaling needs.

评测定义成功，而非评价漂亮回答.en: Evaluation defines success rather than grading attractive answers

Agent评测包括任务、尝试、评分器、轨迹与实际环境结果。最终回答只是证据的一部.en: Agent evaluation includes tasks, trials, graders, traces and actual environmental outcomes. The final answer is only part of the evidence. Code success must meet the goal without breaking regressions; retrieval success must find necessary evidence; recovery success must also avoid duplicated side effects. Percentages with different definitions cannot be compared directly.

来源 S143，Agent评测的完整方法.en: Source S143, a complete method for agent evaluation
来源 S143，Agent评测的完整方法.ja: 出典S143：エージェント評価の包括的な方法

来源 S145，执行轨迹评分.ja: 出典S145、実行トレースの採点

原创样本应保存目标、基线、授权、约束、验收、预算与故障类型。不要把固定工具路径当.en: Original samples should preserve goals, baselines, authorization, constraints, acceptance criteria, budgets and fault types. Do not make one fixed tool path the only correct process unless the path itself is a task requirement.

确定性评分适合测试、文件和数据库状态；模型裁判可评价语义或主观标准，但受位置、冗.en: Deterministic grading suits tests, files and database state; model judges can assess semantics or subjective criteria, but are affected by position, verbosity and preferences. A high score is not factual proof; human calibration and independent evidence are needed.

来源 S148，模型评委与评分偏差.en: Source S148, model judges and grading bias
来源 S148，模型评委与评分偏差.ja: 出典S148、モデルによる評価者と採点バイアス

原创组合：测试验行为，静态检查守边界，抽查维护性，Trace解释失败。不能用总分.en: Original combination: tests verify behavior, static checks enforce boundaries, spot checks assess maintainability, and traces explain failures. Do not average serious security failures away in an overall score or reward mechanically completing a long process.

pass@1关注一次正常尝试，pass@k关注允许k次时至少一次成功，pass^.en: pass@1 concerns one normal attempt, pass@k concerns at least one success when k attempts are allowed, and pass^k emphasizes reliability across repeated successes. τ-bench examines stability through repeated execution.

因此最佳一次演示不能代表正常单次体验。还要说明是否允许筛选、重试、工具验证和额外.en: The best single demonstration therefore cannot represent the normal single-attempt experience. Also state whether selection, retries, tool verification and extra budgets are allowed.

从四格表定位退化.ja: 四つのセルの表から劣化を特定する

旧新都对12、修复5、退化1、都错2；计算旧13/20与新17/20，再逐个解释.en: Both old and new correct on 12, fixed 5, regressed 1, both wrong on 2; compute 13/20 for the old and 17/20 for the new, then explain each of the 6 disagreeing tasks.
旧新都对12、修复5、退化1、都错2；计算旧13/20与新17/20，再逐个解释.ja: 旧版も新版も正解12、修正5、劣化1、両方不正解2。旧版13/20と新版17/20を計算し、6件の不一致タスクを個別に説明する。

关键边界：</strong>同题重复不是独立任务；抽样与环境变化需要记录。.en: Key boundary: repeating the same question is not an independent task; sampling and changes of environment have to be recorded.
关键边界：</strong>同题重复不是独立任务；抽样与环境变化需要记录。.ja: 重要な限界：同じ問題を繰り返しても、独立したタスクにはなりません。標本抽出と環境の変化を記録する必要があります。

顺着源码或工程依据继续追：</strong>让任务、试验、判分与统计单位一致。.en: Follow it further through the source or the engineering basis: keep the task, the trial, the grading and the statistical unit consistent. Do not check only the path that goes well; check the behavior on cancellation, on a version change, and when the result is unknown.
顺着源码或工程依据继续追：</strong>让任务、试验、判分与统计单位一致。.ja: ソースコードや工学的根拠をさらにたどる：タスク・試行・採点・統計の単位をそろえます。正常な経路だけでなく、キャンセル、バージョンの変化、結果不明の場合の振る舞いも照合します。

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../chapters/23.html.en: For the full mechanism and a continuous example see Why can pass@k, pass^k and a single-attempt success rate not be used interchangeably?; this section keeps its own derivation and experiment, and the two accounts work at different levels rather than replacing each other.
完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../chapters/23.html.ja: 仕組みの全体と一続きの例は、pass@k・pass^k・一回の成功率を混同できないのはなぜか？を参照してください。この節にも元の導出と実験を残しています。二つの説明は異なる水準を扱い、互いの代わりにはなりません。

原创实验固定代码和环境，给新旧方案相同任务，按简单、跨模块、长上下文、受限权限分.en: An original experiment fixes code and environment, gives old and new approaches the same tasks, and groups them as simple, cross-module, long-context and restricted-permission tasks. Changing one mechanism at a time aids attribution; changing the model, prompt and retrieval together evaluates only their combination.

样本少要报告不确定性。可以按任务Bootstrap估计差异区间；同一任务的多次运.en: Report uncertainty with small samples. Bootstrap by task can estimate an interval for the difference; repeated runs of the same task are correlated and cannot all be treated as independent samples. The experiment appendix uses synthetic data for demonstration, not measured product rankings.

SWE-bench测试真实Issue修复，具体子集需注明；LiveCodeBen.en: SWE-bench tests real issue fixes, with the specific subset to be stated; LiveCodeBench focuses on continuing updates and contamination; AgentBench and GAIA cover different environments and tasks. Completion, algorithmic code, tool-based business tasks and repository fixes are different capabilities.

来源 S149，真实Issue修复基准.en: Source S149, A benchmark of real issue fixes
来源 S149，真实Issue修复基准.ja: 出典 S149、実際のIssue修正ベンチマーク

来源 S150，评测环境与任务变体.ja: 出典 S150、評価環境とタスクの変種

来源 S152，跨环境Agent评测.ja: 出典 S152、環境をまたぐエージェントの評価

来源 S154，时间更新与污染控制.en: Source S154, Temporal updates and contamination control
来源 S154，时间更新与污染控制.ja: 出典 S154、時間の更新と汚染の制御

来源 S155，通用助手的综合任务.en: Source S155, Composite tasks for a general assistant
来源 S155，通用助手的综合任务.ja: 出典 S155、汎用アシスタントの総合タスク

基础设施噪声研究说明CPU、内存、超时和执行限制能影响分数。比较必须控制环境、并.en: Research on infrastructure noise shows that CPU, memory, timeouts and execution limits affect scores. Comparisons must control the environment, concurrency, networking and retries, rather than attributing every infrastructure difference to the model.

来源 S151，基础设施噪声与比较偏差.en: Source S151, infrastructure noise and comparison bias
来源 S151，基础设施噪声与比较偏差.ja: 出典S151、インフラのノイズと比較バイアス

失败分类指向修复层.en: Failure categories point to the layer to fix

本书建议按第一关键断点区分目标错误、证据缺失、证据误读、工具选择、参数权限、环境.en: This book suggests classifying by the first critical break: wrong goal, missing evidence, misread evidence, tool choice, argument permissions, environmental failure, implementation errors, insufficient verification and inconsistent recovery. Classification locates issues; it does not add a new approval system.

成本应包含失败尝试与必要返工。只计算成功那次Token会低估真实成本。质量、效率.en: Costs should include failed attempts and necessary rework. Counting only the tokens in the successful attempt underestimates true cost. Keep quality, efficiency, reliability and security separate where possible, so a single score does not hide important regressions.

平台变化不应损坏评测资产.en: Evaluation assets must survive platform changes

核验日2026-10-17，OpenAI旧Evals平台文档列出2026-10-.en: On the verification date 2026-10-17, documentation for OpenAI's old Evals platform listed plans for read-only access on 2026-10-31 and closure on 2026-11-30; these must not be described as already having occurred. Task data, grading logic and traces should be portable, and methods should not depend on the old interface.

来源 S146，持续评测学习框架.ja: 出典 S146、継続的な評価と学習のフレームワーク

来源 S147，数据集与评分标准.ja: 出典 S147、データセットと採点基準

自检：pass@k提高是否单次更好？</strong>不必然。<strong>测.en: Self-check: does higher pass@k mean a better single attempt? Not necessarily. What if all tests pass but complexity rises? Record behavior and maintainability separately, and judge whether the complexity is necessary.

12.1 · Agent评测的完整方法.en: 12.1 · A complete method for agent evaluation

对应资料：Demystifying Evals for AI Agents.en: Related material: Demystifying Evals for AI Agents

Agent评测包括任务、尝试、评分器和运行轨迹。最终答案、实际环境结果与成本应分.en: Agent evaluation includes tasks, trials, graders and execution traces. Observe final answers, actual environmental outcomes and costs separately; do not rely only on the model's own completion claim.

评测从真实失败案例开始可以快速产生价值，但样本需要逐步覆盖相邻场景，避免只优化已.en: Starting evaluation from real failures can provide value quickly, but samples should gradually cover neighboring scenarios rather than optimizing only known issues.

先定义真实成功，再统计分数.en: Define real success before collecting scores

输入与条件。</strong>目标要求修复并通过当前版本测试，Agent只生成了.en: Input and conditions. The goal requires a fix and passing tests on the current version, but the agent generates only suggestions.

建议不等于完成修复.en: Suggestions are not a completed fix

哪些文件改了、测试是否运行.en: Which files changed and whether tests ran

失败也计入总成本.en: Failures also count toward total cost

把过程连起来。</strong>评测先回答成功意味着什么，再选指标。.en: Join the steps up. Evaluation first asks what success means, then chooses metrics.

原创练习：为一个Bug定义目标测试、回归约束、授权边界与成本记录，再比较两个方案.en: Original exercise: define target tests, regression constraints, authorization boundaries and cost records for a bug, then compare paired results from two approaches.

完成标准是能说明改动解决了什么、是否退化和增加多少开销，而不是只给一个无法解释的.en: The completion standard is explaining what the change solved, whether it regressed and how much overhead it added, not merely providing an unexplained aggregate score.

用具体过程辅助理解：<a href=\"../visual/F36.html\".en: A concrete process to help: It went up 10 percentage points — so why can we not conclude anything yet?. The figure explains the shared mechanism; the method specific to this item and its experimental conclusions remain as stated in this item's own notes.
用具体过程辅助理解：<a href=\"../visual/F36.html\".ja: 具体的な過程で理解を助けます：10パーセントポイント上がっても、なぜ結論を急げないのか？。図解は共通の仕組みを説明します。この資料固有の手法と実験の結論は、この項目の講義資料に従います。

工作流评测把多轮模型、工具和状态变化作为评价对象。一个步骤输出格式正确，不代表整.en: Workflow evaluation assesses multiple model rounds, tools and state changes. Correct output formatting at one step does not mean the task is complete; later errors can also undo local success.

数据集需要明确初始环境、输入、验收与允许预算。工具和模型版本变化都可能影响比较。.en: A dataset needs explicit initial environments, inputs, acceptance criteria and allowed budgets. Changes in tool and model versions can both affect comparisons.

工作流中某一步通过不代表全流程通过.en: One passing workflow step does not mean the whole flow passes

输入与条件。</strong>检索正确、参数生成正确，写入却超时且结果未知。.en: Input and conditions. Retrieval and argument generation are correct, but the write times out with an unknown result.

前两步有正证据.en: The first two steps have positive evidence

任务不能标完成。.en: The task cannot be marked complete.

查询外部结果再继续.en: Query the external result before continuing

不是把前两步平均成高分就交付。.en: Do not deliver by averaging the first two steps into a high score.

把过程连起来。</strong>组件评测与端到端评测互补而不能替代。.en: Join the steps up. Component and end-to-end evaluations complement one another and cannot replace each other.

原创练习：为搜索正确但补丁错误、补丁正确但测试环境失败两种轨迹分别评分，避免混淆.en: Original exercise: separately grade a trace with correct search but an incorrect patch, and one with a correct patch but a failed test environment. Avoid conflating capability with infrastructure problems.

完成标准是把结果与过程关联，找到应该修改的层次，而非对全部失败使用同一Promp.en: The completion standard is linking outcomes and processes to find the layer to change, not applying the same prompt fix to every failure.

Trace Grading评价执行过程中的决策、工具与证据使用。它能帮助定位错误.en: Trace Grading assesses decisions, tools and evidence use during execution. It helps locate errors, but should not reward mechanical imitation of one fixed example path.

不同搜索顺序可能同样正确。只有任务确实要求的证据或动作才适合成为必要条件。.en: Different search orders can be equally correct. Only evidence or actions actually required by the task should become necessary conditions.

轨迹评分发现答案背后的越权.en: Trace grading reveals unauthorized access behind an answer

输入与条件。</strong>最终回答数值正确，但过程读取了无权文件。.en: Input and conditions. The final numerical answer is correct, but the process read a file without authorization.

只能说明结果维度。.en: This establishes only the outcome dimension.

按任务底线拒绝该轨迹.en: Reject the trace according to the task's minimum requirements

不能用正确答案抵消越权。.en: A correct answer cannot offset unauthorized access.

把过程连起来。</strong>追踪用于评价怎么做，不只最后说什么。.en: Join the steps up. Tracing evaluates how the work was done, not only what was said at the end.

原创练习：比较两条不同但有效的修复轨迹，设计不会误罚其中一条的评分标准。再加入漏.en: Original exercise: compare two different but valid repair traces, and design grading criteria that do not wrongly penalize either. Then add a trace missing verification and see whether it is caught.

完成标准是评价因果必要性与风险，而不是把流程越长、工具越多当成更高质量。.en: The completion standard is evaluating causal necessity and risk, not treating longer flows and more tools as higher quality.

12.4 · 持续评测学习框架.en: 12.4 · A learning framework for continuous evaluation

评测学习资源提供从数据、评分到持续优化的框架。平台产品会变化，长期资产应是任务定.en: Evaluation learning resources provide a framework from data and grading to continuous improvement. Platform products change; long-term assets should be task definitions, grading logic and traceable run results.

截至本书核验日期，OpenAI旧Evals平台公告中的只读和关闭时间仍是未来计划.en: As of this book's verification date, the read-only and closure dates announced for OpenAI's old Evals platform remain future plans and must not be described as completed. The text keeps absolute dates and conditions.

把真实失败变成持续回归样本.en: Turn real failures into ongoing regression samples

输入与条件。</strong>一次ab误排除事故被修复。.en: Input and conditions. An incident incorrectly excluding ab has been fixed.

保留最小反例与预期.en: Keep the minimal counterexample and expectation

避免携带用户秘密。.en: Avoid carrying user secrets with it.

检查旧问题复发。.en: Check for recurrence of the old issue.

另加同类不同前缀的输入.en: Add similar inputs with different prefixes

不要只记ab这一个字符串。.en: Do not merely memorize the string ab.

把过程连起来。</strong>评测集应随真实失败增长，但不能变成答案泄漏清单。.en: Join the steps up. Evaluation sets should grow with real failures without becoming lists that leak answers.

原创练习：将某平台上的评测导出为独立任务JSON与评分脚本，说明哪些能力仍依赖平.en: Original exercise: export an evaluation from a platform into independent task JSON and grading scripts, explaining which capabilities still depend on the platform and which are portable.

完成标准是工具更换后仍能重跑核心比较，而不是只能记住某个界面的点击步骤。.en: The completion standard is rerunning core comparisons after changing tools, not merely remembering how to click through one interface.

对应资料：Getting Started with Datasets.en: Related material: Getting Started with Datasets

数据集建设需要代表真实任务分布，并把训练或调参用途与独立评价区分。反复根据同一测.en: Dataset construction should represent the real task distribution and distinguish training or tuning uses from independent evaluation. Repeatedly changing a system based on the same test set gradually overfits it.

样本应包含成功与失败、简单与复杂、边界和异常情况。只收集新方案最擅长的例子会夸大.en: Samples should include successes and failures, simple and complex cases, boundaries and exceptions. Collecting only examples where the new approach excels exaggerates its gains.

评分规则要区分缺信息与乱猜.en: Grading rules must distinguish missing information from guessing

输入与条件。</strong>问题无法从授权资料得到当前值。.en: Input and conditions. The current value cannot be obtained from authorized material.

指出缺口并取证或停止.en: Identify the gap and obtain evidence or stop

不是强迫所有题输出数值。.en: Do not force a numerical answer to every question.

应扣分而非奖励答得完整。.en: Deduct points rather than rewarding a complete-looking answer.

记录哪些题本就不可回答.en: Record which questions are inherently unanswerable

把过程连起来。</strong>评价体系会影响系统优化方向，拒答题必须有合适标准.en: Join the steps up. Evaluation affects the direction of system optimization; questions requiring refusal need suitable criteria.

继续逐步计算：<a href=\"../studies/chapters/25..en: Continue the step-by-step calculation: <a href="../studies/chapters/25.html#worked-S25">S25 · Refusal rate and accuracy both rise: is that really better

原创练习：把历史任务划为开发集与保留集，写明哪些修改可以参考哪部分结果，再检查重.en: Original exercise: split historical tasks into development and held-out sets. State which changes may use which results, then check duplicate and near-duplicate samples.

完成标准是比较具有可解释性与可复现性，而不是单纯追求样本数量。.en: The completion standard is an interpretable, reproducible comparison, not merely a larger sample count.

LLM-as-a-Judge研究模型裁判的能力与偏差，包括位置、风格和长度等因素.en: LLM-as-a-Judge studies the capabilities and biases of model judges, including position, style and length effects. Model evaluation can scale up, but is not inherently objective truth.

裁判需要明确标准、独立样本校准和必要人工抽查。与被评模型相同的错误知识可能导致共.en: A judge needs clear criteria, calibration on independent samples and necessary human spot checks. Incorrect knowledge shared with the evaluated model may produce shared bias.

交换答案顺序检查评委偏差.en: Swap answer order to check judge bias

输入与条件。</strong>同内容A/B，先A后B选A，交换后选B。.en: Input and conditions. Keep A/B content unchanged: A before B selects A; swapping them selects B.

双向判分与证据核查.en: Grade in both orders and check evidence

不能把两次矛盾都算“自信胜出”。.en: Do not count two contradictory judgments as "confident wins".

把过程连起来。</strong>模型评委也需要评测。.en: Join the steps up. Model judges also need evaluation.

继续逐步计算：<a href=\"../chapters/23.html#wor.en: Continue the step-by-step calculation: <a href="../chapters/23.html#worked-Q092">Q064 · How to spot a grading model that favors the first answer

原创练习：交换两个答案的展示顺序，并保持内容不变，检查评分是否稳定；再比较冗长错.en: Original exercise: swap the display order of two answers without changing content and check grading stability; then compare a verbose incorrect answer with a concise correct one.

事实与代码行为能直接验证时，应优先使用可靠证据。模型裁判适合补充，不应替代全部确.en: When facts and code behavior can be verified directly, prioritize reliable evidence. Model judges can supplement it, but should not replace all deterministic tests.

12.7 · 真实Issue修复基准.en: 12.7 · A benchmark for real issue fixes

SWE-bench使用真实仓库问题和测试评价修复能力。任务需要理解代码并产生补丁.en: SWE-bench evaluates repair capability using real repository issues and tests. Tasks require understanding code and producing patches, unlike merely completing one short function.

评分依赖测试、环境和数据版本。通过基准不代表补丁在所有未覆盖场景都正确，也不能据.en: Grading depends on tests, environments and data versions. Passing a benchmark does not establish patch correctness in every uncovered scenario or guarantee success on real user tasks.

真实Issue评测要验证补丁行为.en: Evaluation on real issues must verify patch behavior

输入与条件。</strong>修复候选在描述里说解决问题，但不改变代码。.en: Input and conditions. A repair candidate claims in its description to solve the issue, but changes no code.

补丁为空或无效.en: The patch is empty or ineffective

不能只凭说明算完成。.en: Its description alone cannot count as completion.

原复现测试失败、修改后通过.en: The original reproduction test fails, then passes after the change

证明修复目标。.en: Establish that the repair goal is met.

防止修一处破另一处。.en: Prevent fixing one thing while breaking another.

把过程连起来。</strong>SWE类任务的核心是环境中的可执行变化，不是解释.en: Join the steps up. SWE-type tasks center on executable changes in the environment, not explanation quality.

原创练习：检查一个教学Issue的失败测试、回归测试和环境依赖，说明缺少哪部分会.en: Original exercise: inspect a teaching issue's failing tests, regression tests and environment dependencies, explaining which missing parts would make the conclusion unreliable.

完成标准是读懂基准任务定义与验收边界，而不只记录排行榜数字。.en: The completion standard is understanding benchmark task definitions and acceptance boundaries, not merely recording leaderboard numbers.

SWE-bench项目存在不同数据子集和评测设置。比较结果需要注明具体版本、任务.en: The SWE-bench project has different data subsets and evaluation settings. Comparing results requires the specific version, task set, runtime environment and allowed budget.

不同子集难度或验证质量可能不同，不能把同名基准的百分比直接并列而不检查口径。.en: Subsets may differ in difficulty or verification quality. Do not compare percentages from the same benchmark name without checking the measurement basis.

测试环境不同会让同一补丁结果不同.en: Different test environments can give different results for the same patch

输入与条件。</strong>补丁依赖库版本2；环境A装2，环境B装1。.en: Input and conditions. The patch depends on library version 2; environment A has 2 and environment B has 1.

不一定是补丁业务逻辑变差。.en: The patch's business logic has not necessarily worsened.

统一依赖、资源与测试入口.en: Align dependencies, resources and test entry points

把过程连起来。</strong>环境版本属于评测条件而不是无关细节。.en: Join the steps up. Environment versions are evaluation conditions, not irrelevant details.

原创练习：为两个假想评测报告建立对照表，标出任务数、模型、工具、超时和重试差异，.en: Original exercise: compare two hypothetical evaluation reports in a table, marking differences in task count, model, tools, timeout and retries, then judge whether they are comparable.

本条强调项目层的复现条件，与前一条论文目标互补，不将官网某时点排名当作长期事实。.en: This item emphasizes project-level reproducibility conditions and complements the preceding paper's goals. It does not treat website rankings at one moment as lasting facts.

对应资料：Infrastructure Noise in Agentic Cod.en: Related material: Infrastructure Noise in Agentic Coding Evals

基础设施噪声研究说明Agent编码评测会受资源与运行环境影响。内存、CPU、超时.en: Infrastructure-noise research shows that agent coding evaluations depend on resources and runtime environments. Memory, CPU, timeout, concurrency and dependencies can all change results.

环境失败与模型能力失败需要区分，但也不能随意删除不利运行。排除规则应提前定义并透.en: Distinguish environmental failures from model-capability failures without arbitrarily deleting unfavorable runs. Define exclusion rules in advance and report them transparently.

资源噪声不能算作模型错误.en: Resource noise must not count as model error

输入与条件。</strong>同测试偶尔因为CPU限制超时。.en: Input and conditions. The same test occasionally times out because of CPU limits.

失败类型timeout且代码不变.en: The failure type is timeout, with code unchanged

给固定资源与超时口径.en: Fix resources and the timeout definition

不要无条件删掉不利样本或全算模型错。.en: Do not unconditionally delete unfavorable samples or count them all as model errors.

把过程连起来。</strong>公平评测需要事先定义环境故障处理规则。.en: Join the steps up. Fair evaluation needs rules for handling environmental faults defined beforehand.

原创练习：让同一测试在资源充足与受限环境中运行，记录失败原因，而不是把所有失败都.en: Original exercise: run the same test in well-resourced and constrained environments, recording failure causes rather than assigning every failure to the model.

完成标准是控制比较条件并保留原始证据，避免把基础设施差异误当算法改进。.en: The completion standard is controlling comparison conditions and retaining original evidence, rather than mistaking infrastructure differences for algorithmic improvements.

AgentBench在多种环境中评价Agent能力，涉及的不仅是文本回答，还包括.en: AgentBench evaluates agent capability in multiple environments, covering actions and feedback as well as text answers. Failure modes may differ substantially across environments.

综合分数可以概括表现，也可能掩盖某一关键能力短板。实际选型应看与你任务相关的子项.en: An aggregate score summarizes performance but can also hide a critical weakness. For actual selection, examine the subcategories relevant to your task.

跨环境成绩需分开看.en: Examine scores in different environments separately

输入与条件。</strong>Agent在终端任务9/10，网页任务2/10。.en: Input and conditions. The agent scores 9/10 on terminal tasks and 2/10 on web tasks.

可定位GUI观察或权限问题。.en: Helps locate GUI observation or permission issues.

按真实任务分布选择.en: Choose according to the actual task distribution

不把平均分直接当所有场景成功率。.en: Do not treat the average score as success rate in every scenario.

把过程连起来。</strong>能力基准是多维的，不能用一个总数替代所有操作环境.en: Join the steps up. Capability benchmarks are multidimensional; one total cannot replace every operating environment.

原创练习：将检索、工具参数、规划和恢复分别设为可观察环节，分析一个Agent总分.en: Original exercise: make retrieval, tool arguments, planning and recovery separately observable, then analyze an agent with a similar total score but different error types.

完成标准是了解基准覆盖范围，不能由通用Agent分数直接推断专门代码审查或生产部.en: The completion standard is understanding benchmark coverage, not directly inferring specialized code-review or production-deployment capability from a general agent score.

12.11 · 规则、工具和重复成功率.en: 12.11 · Rules, tools and repeated success rates

τ-bench评价工具、用户交互与规则遵循，并使用重复运行考察可靠性。一次成功与.en: τ-bench evaluates tools, user interaction and rule following, using repeated runs to examine reliability. One success and success every time are different goals.

在独立且成功率固定的理想条件下，至少一次成功是.en: Under ideal conditions of independence and a fixed success rate, the probability of at least one success is

，全部成功是.en: , while success on every attempt is

；真实尝试往往相关，不能无条件套公式。.en: ; real attempts are often correlated, so these formulas cannot be applied unconditionally.

输入与条件。</strong>同业务规则任务跑5次，只成功3次。.en: Input and conditions. Run the same business-rule task 5 times, with only 3 successes.

单次样本成功率。.en: The sample success rate for one attempt.

5次全通过条件未满足.en: The condition of passing all 5 runs is not met

不能称稳定可靠。.en: It cannot be called consistently reliable.

规则遗漏是否重复出现在同一条件.en: Check whether the same conditions repeatedly lead to missed rules

修共性缺口比不断重跑更有价值。.en: Fixing a shared gap is more valuable than continually rerunning.

把过程连起来。</strong>稳定性与至少一次成功不同。.en: Join the steps up. Stability differs from succeeding at least once.

继续逐步计算：<a href=\"../chapters/23.html#wor.en: Continue the step-by-step calculation: <a href="../chapters/23.html#worked-Q090">Q062 · pass@3 against succeeding three times in a row: why the numbers differ so much

原创练习：用p=0.8、k=3计算两者，再解释为什么高pass@k可能掩盖较弱的.en: Original exercise: calculate both with p=0.8 and k=3, then explain why high pass@k may hide weak single-attempt stability.

完成标准是明确重试、筛选和预算口径，不把最佳一次演示当成用户正常体验。.en: The completion standard is making retry, selection and budget definitions explicit, not presenting the best demonstration as the user's normal experience.

12.12 · 时间更新与污染控制.en: 12.12 · Updates over time and contamination control

LiveCodeBench通过时间更新的代码任务关注更贴近新问题的评价和污染风险.en: LiveCodeBench uses code tasks updated over time to evaluate newer problems and contamination risks. Dynamic data help reduce some memorization issues, but cannot prove the complete absence of similar training content.

时间、模型版本和数据公开情况都需要记录。代码生成任务也不同于完整仓库修复。.en: Record timing, model versions and whether data were public. Code-generation tasks also differ from complete repository fixes.

新题时间晚于训练截止仍不自动零污染.en: A new question after the training cutoff is not automatically free of contamination

输入与条件。</strong>新题复用了旧题结构和测试代码。.en: Input and conditions. A new question reuses an old question's structure and test code.

阻止直接使用早期原题.en: Prevents direct use of earlier original questions

仅控制一种泄漏。.en: Controls only one kind of leakage.

检查改名、重排和翻译副本.en: Check renamed, reordered and translated copies

报告来源、版本与已知限制.en: Report sources, versions and known limitations

不宣称绝对无污染。.en: Do not claim absolute freedom from contamination.

把过程连起来。</strong>时间更新是重要手段，但不是信息独立性的完整证明。.en: Join the steps up. Updating over time is important, but is not a complete proof of information independence.

原创练习：比较随机切分与按发布时间切分的任务集，说明各自可能存在的泄漏和分布变化.en: Original exercise: compare randomly split task sets with sets split by publication date, explaining possible leakage and distribution changes in each.

完成标准是对评测新鲜度与覆盖范围保持透明，不把“较新”直接写成“完全无污染”。.en: The completion standard is transparency about evaluation freshness and coverage, not turning "newer" into "completely uncontaminated".

GAIA面向通用助手的综合任务，可能需要检索、推理和工具协作。它强调现实任务组合.en: GAIA targets integrated tasks for general assistants that may require retrieval, reasoning and tools working together. It emphasizes realistic task combinations rather than one language-generation metric.

综合任务失败需要拆解：信息未找到、工具不可用、推理错误或最终验证不足。总分本身不.en: Integrated-task failures need decomposition: missing information, unavailable tools, reasoning errors or insufficient final verification. The overall score alone cannot identify the layer to fix.

通用助手任务要同时读、算、核对.en: General-assistant tasks need reading, calculation and checking together

输入与条件。</strong>虚构任务从两份表中找匹配项目并合计3+4。.en: Input and conditions. A fictional task finds matching items in two tables and totals 3+4.

找到同一项目的两条记录.en: Find two records for the same item

若找错项目，算对也不算任务正确。.en: If the wrong item was found, correct arithmetic still does not make the task correct.

把过程连起来。</strong>综合任务的失败可能在任一环节，不能只检查最后算式.en: Join the steps up. An integrated task can fail at any step; do not check only the final equation.

继续逐步计算：<a href=\"../chapters/26.html#wor.en: Continue the step-by-step calculation: <a href="../chapters/26.html#worked-Q101">Q105 · How enterprise Q&A connects every clause of the answer back to evidence

原创练习：设计一个需要读表、计算并核对来源的小任务，记录每步证据和最终答案的依赖.en: Original exercise: design a small task requiring table reading, calculation and source checking. Record the evidence at every step and the final answer's dependencies.

完成标准是理解跨能力任务的评价方式，不把通用基准成绩直接变成特定企业流程的可靠性.en: The completion standard is understanding evaluation across capabilities, not turning general benchmark scores directly into reliability promises for a specific enterprise workflow.
