6. GQA减少什么，不减少什么.en: 6. What GQA reduces and what it does not

MHA中每个Q头通常拥有对应K、V头；GQA让一组Q头共享一个K、V头，MQA可.en: In MHA, each Q head usually has corresponding K and V heads; GQA lets a group of Q heads share one K and V head, while MQA is the extreme with only one KV head. Keeping h fixed while reducing g shrinks cache and K/V projection outputs; Q heads can still produce different attention distributions through different Q representations.

。教学假设32层、1条32768长序列、8个KV头、每头128维、2字节，结果是.en: . A teaching assumption of 32 layers, 1 sequence of length 32768, 8 KV heads, width 128 per head and 2 bytes gives 4GiB; with 32 KV heads, it becomes 16GiB. This excludes paging metadata, alignment, fragmentation, temporary buffers and quantization scales, and is not actual usage by a service.

扩展共享KV；高性能实现应避免无意义复制。算法概念减少的内存，可能被天真的张量操.en: to expand shared KV; high-performance implementations should avoid unnecessary copies. Naive tensor operations can offset the algorithm's conceptual memory savings, illustrating the gap between "understanding a paper" and "writing an effective engineering implementation".

批内真实长度不同，缓存位置不能只看补齐长度.en: With unequal actual lengths in a batch, cache positions cannot depend only on padded length

输入与条件。</strong>样本A真实长3，B真实长2，右补齐到3。要继续生成.en: Input and conditions. Sample A has actual length 3, B length 2, and both are right-padded to 3. For continued generation, B has only 2 valid historical tokens.

PAD不是有效的历史词。.en: PAD is not a valid historical word.

错误地都取最后一格会读B的PAD表示。.en: Incorrectly choosing the final slot for both reads B's PAD representation.

B的新真实Token应延续其有效位置.en: B's new real token should continue its valid positions

不能因为整批T=3就任意跳过其序列位置。.en: Batch-wide T=3 does not justify arbitrarily skipping sequence positions.

某实现可保留PAD槽位，但必须正确mask与跟踪位置.en: An implementation may retain PAD slots, but must mask and track positions correctly

物理槽数和语义位置可以不同。.en: Physical slot count and semantic positions can differ.

逐条无padding运行与批处理比较.en: Compare separate unpadded runs with batching

应在声明的推理设定下得到一致有效结果。.en: They should give consistent valid results under the declared inference settings.

把过程连起来。</strong>批处理增加的是实现复杂度，不应改变每条输入独立计.en: Join the steps up. Batching adds implementation complexity without changing the semantics of independent computation for each input.

边界与反例。</strong>服务可能用左padding、打包或分页处理；本例不.en: Limits and counterexamples. Services may use left padding, packing or paging; this example does not provide a universal position_ids formula for every framework.

时应定位：归一化、投影、RoPE的位置、缓存拼接轴、非方形mask、softma.en: , locate normalization, projection, where RoPE is applied, the cache-concatenation axis, non-square masks, the softmax axis, head-combination order and feed-forward residuals. Each should have at least one invariance check or negative control.

验收题：若整段和缓存输出不同，先查什么？先检查dropout是否关闭、参数是否一.en: Acceptance question: if full-sequence and cached outputs differ, what should be checked first? Check whether dropout is disabled, parameters match, and position offsets and masks align; then inspect dtype and numerical tolerance. Do not hide logic errors merely by widening tolerance. If error suddenly grows with length, also inspect position limits, cache truncation, padding and sliding-window rules. High-precision teaching results are only a baseline; low-precision kernels need separate definitions of acceptable error and final-task degradation.

1. 数据管线是模型行为的一部分.en: 1. The data pipeline is part of model behavior

预训练不是把原始网页直接塞进GPU。需要确定采样范围、清洗与去重策略、编码、序列.en: Pretraining does not feed raw web pages straight into a GPU. It requires decisions about sampling scope, cleaning and deduplication, encoding, sequence packing, length distribution, training/validation splits and traceable data versions. Every step changes the distribution the model actually sees. Excessively removing short lines may damage code; deduplicating by page URL may retain many mirrors; random paragraph-level training/test splits may put versions of the same document on both sides.

最小数据清单应能回答：样本来自哪一快照、应用了哪些过滤、由何种Tokenizer.en: A minimal data manifest should answer: Which snapshot did each sample come from? Which filters were applied? Which Tokenizer encoded it? How are valid tokens counted? Was the validation set isolated before deduplication? Proving that a model can solve a problem requires ruling out the explanation that its answer or a highly similar solution leaked into training/retrieval data; final accuracy alone is insufficient.

当应用业务数据微调模型，权限与删除责任从原始数据延伸到训练工件。单纯删除数据库中.en: When business data is used to fine-tune a model, permission and deletion responsibilities extend from the original data to training artifacts. Deleting a database record alone does not mean model parameters have forgotten it. This is also why sensitive, frequently changing business facts often belong in an external retrieval layer with access controls rather than entering the training set blindly.

2. 一次训练步的具体数据流.en: 2. The data flow of one training step

AdamW分别维护梯度的一阶、二阶矩，偏差修正后用于归一化步长；解耦权重衰减是在.en: AdamW maintains the first and second moments of gradients and uses them after bias correction to normalize step sizes. Decoupled weight decay applies shrinkage directly in parameter updates; it should not simply be equated with applying L2 penalties uniformly to all parameters. Implementations specify which parameters decay, when accumulation occurs and how the learning rate is scheduled. Reproducing an experiment requires saving these configurations, not only a learning-rate number.

梯度累计将多个microbatch的贡献组合成一次优化更新。等价性取决于损失归一.en: Gradient accumulation combines contributions from several microbatches into one optimizer update. Equivalence depends on loss normalization, stochastic operators and how schedule steps are counted. With different numbers of valid tokens in long and short sequences, a simple mean of microbatch means may differ from the mean over all valid tokens. State whether the objective weights samples or tokens equally before designing accumulation logic.

3. 为什么显存不只是参数量乘2字节.en: 3. Why VRAM is not just parameter count times 2 bytes

训练可能同时持有模型权重、梯度、优化器矩、主权重副本、中间激活、临时算子缓冲和通.en: Training may simultaneously hold model weights, gradients, optimizer moments, master-weight copies, intermediate activations, temporary operator buffers and communication buffers. Some common mixed-precision Adam configurations approach 16 bytes of model state per parameter, but this is not a universal constant: FP32 master weights, gradient dtype, sharding and quantized optimizers all change it.

。仅根据“7B×2字节=14GB”判断能否训练是错误的；这至多是某种dtype下.en: . Judging trainability only from "7B×2 bytes=14GB" is wrong; at most, this estimates weight storage for a particular dtype. Longer sequences also increase activation costs even if model parameters stay unchanged.

激活检查点通过不保存部分中间值、反向时重新计算，换取更低显存。这里的checkp.en: Activation checkpointing saves VRAM by not storing some intermediate values and recomputing them during backpropagation. This checkpoint is an autodiff memory optimization, not an agent task checkpoint or persistent training state. The same English word has different meanings at three system layers; make the distinction explicit.

数据并行让各设备处理不同样本，再同步梯度；张量并行拆分单层矩阵运算，需要层内通信.en: Data parallelism lets devices process different samples, then synchronize gradients; tensor parallelism splits a layer's matrix computations and requires communication within that layer; pipeline parallelism splits layers, with microbatches flowing across stages and creating pipeline bubbles; expert parallelism assigns MoE experts to devices, with routing moving tokens between devices. They address different constraints and cannot be summarized as "More GPUs make training linearly faster".

选择并行方式时，先确认瓶颈是单卡放不下、矩阵计算量大，还是跨设备网络。把大矩阵切.en: Before choosing parallelism, determine whether the bottleneck is fitting on one GPU, matrix computation or the inter-device network. Splitting a large matrix too finely may increase the communication share; uneven pipeline stages let the slowest stage limit the whole; ignoring expert load distribution leaves popular experts queuing. Lesson 59 continues these trade-offs through roofline and bandwidth.

分片优化器状态、梯度、参数能够减少单设备持有状态，但相应引入收集与通信。检查点恢.en: Sharding optimizer state, gradients and parameters reduces what one device holds but introduces collection and communication. Checkpoint recovery also needs optimizer state, random state, data position and schedule counters; otherwise resuming from the same weights need not reproduce the same training trajectory. Production recovery seeks explicit recovery semantics, without requiring bitwise identity on every kind of hardware.

真实修复阅读：从梯度累积事故到一份可区分错误目标的测试.en: Reading a real fix: from the gradient-accumulation incident to a test that tells the wrong objective apart

原始工程证据在哪里.en: Where the original engineering evidence is

Transformers PR #34191标题为“Fix Gradient A.en: Transformers PR #34191, titled "Fix Gradient Accumulation issue", was merged on 2024-10-17. This section pins loss_utils.py from the merge commit: when num_items_in_batch is present, fixed_cross_entropy selects sum reduction, then divides by the number supplied by the caller; ForCausalLMLoss first shifts predictions and labels, then flattens them.

这让“按总有效项归一化”的责任可以沿代码边界追踪，而不只是停留在博客结论。.en: This makes responsibility for normalization by the total valid-item count traceable across code boundaries, beyond a blog's conclusion.

参数名不能替代计数定义.en: Parameter names cannot replace counting definitions

num_items_in_batch究竟表示样本数、标签数还是跨累积组有效Tok.en: Check the caller to determine whether num_items_in_batch means samples, labels or valid tokens across an accumulation group; this small function cannot prove the caller's denominator correct. In particular, boundary changes after shifting, ignore_index, differing rank counts and entirely empty batches may make the count differ from the items actually entering cross entropy.

本书做了两层验证.en: This book performed two levels of verification

第一层平方误差小例让梯度差异达到−1与0，方便手算。第二层实际使用torch.c.en: The first is a small squared-error example with gradients of −1 and 0, easy to calculate by hand. The second actually uses torch.cross_entropy: the gradient from one forward pass over the same 4 samples matches accumulation over groups of 1/3 items normalized by the same total; simply averaging each batch's mean differs. The original gradient matrices are available in the results below.

如何迁移到自己的Trainer.en: How to apply this to your Trainer

先用单设备、固定小数据、无dropout与无随机增强做大批/累积等价性；再开启A.en: First test large-batch/accumulation equivalence on one device with fixed small data, no dropout and no random augmentation. Then enable AMP, DDP, clipping and the actual data loader, adding one kind of factor at a time. If the framework already handles the global denominator, do not multiply by world_size again. For objectives without equal token weights, such as equal weight per conversation, write the intended objective separately instead of copying this formula.

“loss下降就没问题”不成立：错误目标也能下降。“梯度大致接近即可”也不够：先.en: "The loss falls, so everything is fine" does not hold: a wrong objective can fall too. "The gradients are roughly close" is insufficient as well: first ask whether the objective definition explains the difference, then discuss floating-point error. The historical PR supports the problem mechanism; it is not evidence that the current version still has the bug.

D02：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: D02: how to read these results beyond "passed"

逐项比较完整目标、有效Token归一化、错误微批均值和分布式规约。判断的是同一个.en: Compare the full objective, valid-token normalization, incorrect microbatch means and distributed reduction item by item. The question is whether the same training objective is preserved, not only whether loss decreases.

关联问题：<a href=\"../../chapters/04.html#en.en: Related question: <a href="../../chapters/04.html#engineering-E09">E09: The hidden bias in gradient accumulation: is the average taken over batches, or over valid tokens?

E10：混合精度与重计算：顺序错误会让优化器悄悄走错一步.en: E10: Mixed precision and recomputation: the wrong order makes the optimizer quietly take a wrong step

训练损失与参数量、数据量、计算量存在可拟合的经验关系，但它们依赖数据、架构、优化.en: Training loss has empirical relationships with parameter count, data volume and compute that can be fitted, but they depend on data, architecture, optimization and budget ranges. Chinchilla discusses allocating parameters and data under fixed training compute; ratios from its particular research setting are not eternal optima for every model, language or inference cost.

还应区分训练计算最优与部署总成本最优。若模型会被调用很多次，花更多训练Token.en: Also distinguish compute-optimal training from optimal total deployment cost. If a model will be called many times, training a smaller model on more tokens may reduce long-term inference costs. Conversely, a model project used for one exploration may not justify substantial extra training to save inference costs. The actual objective includes training, serving and quality gains, beyond one loss curve.

评估报告还要分开训练损失、验证损失与业务成功率。验证交叉熵略有改善，不保证工具调.en: Reports must separate training loss, validation loss and business success rate. A small gain in validation cross entropy does not guarantee better judgments of tool-call permissions; a higher code pass rate may be concentrated in certain languages. Expanded capabilities need stratified evaluation, not inference from parameter scale.

6. 本书真实训练实验的读法.en: 6. How to read this book's actual training experiment

包含两层因果Transformer，18,320个参数，CPU训练100步。数据.en: contains two causal Transformer layers and 18,320 parameters, trained on a CPU for 100 steps. The data is an author-constructed cyclic sequence of 16 symbols; the task is to learn "The next symbol is the current symbol plus one, modulo 16". This makes gradients, masks and updates verifiable without passing the experiment off as a general language model.

配套运行记录中，训练交叉熵从约2.8468降到0.00345，训练Token准确.en: In the accompanying run record, training cross entropy falls from about 2.8468 to 0.00345, and training-token accuracy reaches 1.0. This proves the code can optimize its defined objective and memorize/fit this simple rule; it does not prove test generalization, multistep reasoning or actual coding capability. Changing future inputs leaves zero error in prefix logits, separately verifying the causal mask.

进一步实验不应只增加训练步：把验证序列改成逆序、换符号映射、增加不同规律；比较训.en: Further experiments should do more than add training steps: reverse validation sequences, change symbol mappings, introduce different rules and compare in-distribution with out-of-distribution results. Check whether failures come from model capacity, data coverage or an unidentifiable task. Retain training seeds and configuration and repeat at least a few seeds to judge whether a gain is just an initialization coincidence.

7. 资深工程师的结论标准.en: 7. The conclusion standard for a senior engineer

看见“数据更多、模型更强”的报告，应追问有效训练Token、去重与污染、计算预算.en: When a report says "More data, stronger model", ask about valid training tokens, deduplication and contamination, compute budgets, deployment costs and task scope. For "Out of VRAM", break down usage rather than immediately reducing the batch. For "Loss is not decreasing", check labels, masks, gradients, learning rate and numerics before changing architecture. Every check must correspond to an observable variable; that is understanding the training system from within.

四个微批累积梯度，为什么不一定等于四倍学习率.en: Why accumulating gradients over four microbatches does not necessarily equal four times the learning rate

输入与条件。</strong>有效批包含4个等大微批，损失按样本平均；各微批一个.en: Input and conditions. The effective batch has 4 equally sized microbatches, with loss averaged by sample; their mean gradients for one parameter are 1, 2, 3 and 4.

完整有效批的平均.en: The mean over the full effective batch

每次平均损失反传但不除4.en: Backpropagate each mean loss without dividing by 4

梯度和10，放大4倍。.en: The gradient sum is 10, amplified 4 times.

每个微批损失先除4.en: Divide each microbatch loss by 4 first

四次backward后一次step.en: Four backward calls, then one step

不是每个微批都更新后再把结果当同一个大批。.en: Not an update after every microbatch treated afterward as one large batch.

含跨样本BatchNorm、随机层或不同优化器步数.en: With cross-sample BatchNorm, random layers or different optimizer step counts

数值与动力学可能不同，不能无条件声称完全等价。.en: Numerics and dynamics may differ; full equivalence cannot be claimed unconditionally.

把过程连起来。</strong>累积梯度必须明确损失归约分母、微批大小和优化器更.en: Join the steps up. Gradient accumulation requires explicit loss-reduction denominators, microbatch sizes and optimizer update counts.

边界与反例。</strong>不等大微批需要按样本或有效Token数量加权，不应.en: Limits and counterexamples. Unequal microbatches require weighting by sample or valid-token counts, not mechanically dividing by the number of microbatches.

用1000个参数算清ZeRO究竟分摊哪份状态.en: Using 1000 parameters to work out exactly which state ZeRO shards

输入与条件。</strong>假设全部使用FP32：1000个参数P占4000字.en: Input and conditions. Assume FP32 throughout: 1000 parameters P take 4000 bytes, gradients G take 4000 bytes, and Adam's first and second moments total 8000 bytes. Share evenly across two devices; count only these three kinds of state.

每张设备各有P、G、两个矩.en: Each device holds P, G and both moments

仅优化器状态均分两张设备.en: Only optimizer state is split evenly across the two devices

梯度与优化器状态均分，参数复制.en: Gradients and optimizer state are split evenly; parameters are replicated

参数、梯度、优化器状态都均分.en: Parameters, gradients and optimizer state are all split evenly

计算某层时仍需拿到相应参数，产生通信和临时材料.en: Computing a layer still requires its parameters, adding communication and temporary materializations

上表不是实际峰值显存，不能据此断言两卡一定装得下。.en: The table is not actual peak VRAM and cannot establish that two GPUs will necessarily fit the model.

把过程连起来。</strong>先画出参数、梯度和优化器状态三份数据，再讨论“切.en: Join the steps up. Draw the three sets of data—parameters, gradients and optimizer state—before discussing sharding, or savings from different stages are easily mixed together.

边界与反例。</strong>忽略激活、通信缓冲、临时聚合、分片不均、额外主权重.en: Limits and counterexamples. Ignores activations, communication buffers, temporary aggregation, uneven sharding, extra master weights and framework overhead. This is state accounting, not device measurement.

1. 预训练能力如何变成助手行为.en: 1. How pretrained capabilities become assistant behavior

预训练优化文本分布，SFT通过示范数据强化某些条件下的回答形式与任务策略。给模型.en: Pretraining optimizes a text distribution; SFT uses demonstrations to reinforce answer forms and task strategies under particular conditions. High-quality traces of "request → answer → tool result → continued action" let the model learn these patterns, but learning the format does not make every call valid. Schema validation, permissions and completion checks remain in the execution layer.

SFT样本的关键并非只有最终文本，还包括任务分布、正确的工具调用与恢复过程、是否.en: SFT samples involve more than final text: task distributions, correct tool calls and recovery, and whether the model may see verification feedback all matter. Removing every failed trace may teach only the smooth path; indiscriminately adding failures may copy errors. Data design should specify which actions merit imitation and which content is only environment feedback.

训练时若只优化最终回答，长轨迹中间某个危险调用可能没有被直接约束。反过来，如果机.en: Optimizing only the final answer may leave a dangerous intermediate call in a long trace unconstrained directly. Conversely, mechanically rewarding every step's form can encourage format compliance without task progress. Distinguish objective levels and observable feedback instead of simply seeking longer reasoning.

2. RLHF中的奖励不是事实真值.en: 2. Rewards in RLHF are not factual truth

典型偏好流程先对回答进行比较，训练奖励模型，再优化策略使奖励变高，同时约束偏离参.en: A typical preference process compares answers, trains a reward model, then optimizes the policy to increase reward while constraining deviation from a reference policy. Preferences may combine helpfulness, style, instruction following, safety and other dimensions; one scalar cannot be assumed to represent every business goal perfectly.

模型可能利用奖励模型的缺陷，例如偏爱冗长、特定语气或表面完整性。工程上看见“答案.en: The model may exploit reward-model weaknesses, such as preferences for verbosity, a certain tone or superficial completeness. Seeing "More confident answers" should not imply "More correct facts". Engineering needs externally verifiable outcomes such as compilation, final database state or evidence support rates, not only another model's satisfaction.

强化学习里的策略更新也不是每次用户聊天都即时更新模型参数。产品可能有独立的数据与.en: Policy updates in reinforcement learning do not mean parameters update instantly during every user chat. Products may have separate data and training pipelines; correcting an answer in the current session changes context directly, while whether it enters later training is a separate question.

3. DPO的目标函数为何出现参考模型.en: 3. Why the DPO objective includes a reference model

从一个带KL约束的理想化优化问题出发：.en: Starting from an idealized optimization problem with a KL constraint:

如果成对偏好概率采用Bradley–Terry形式.en: If pairwise preference probabilities use the Bradley–Terry form

在相减时消失，得到DPO损失：.en: cancels on subtraction, giving the DPO loss:

这解释了DPO为什么能够直接从偏好对优化，而不是只背诵“DPO比RLHF简单”。.en: This explains why DPO can optimize directly from preference pairs, beyond reciting "DPO is simpler than RLHF". The reference model supplies a baseline for relative change, and β controls the scale in the objective. This derivation relies on particular reward regularization and preference-model assumptions; it does not claim that actual human preferences strictly follow this probability model.

序列log概率通常由被计入的Token对数概率求和，长度和mask因此非常重要。.en: A sequence log probability usually sums the log probabilities of included tokens, making length and masks important. Arbitrarily exchanging a sequence mean with a sum changes the preference-learning objective.

检查的是单个偏好对的稳定损失和解析梯度；它不是一个完整DPO训练器，也没有证明偏.en: checks stable loss and analytic gradients for one preference pair; it is not a complete DPO trainer and does not prove preference data improves your coding-task success rate.

4. 可验证奖励与推理强化学习.en: 4. Verifiable rewards and reasoning reinforcement learning

当答案可以通过数学结果、单元测试或规则验证，训练可以获得比纯风格偏好更明确的反馈.en: When answers can be checked by mathematical results, unit tests or rules, training can obtain clearer feedback than style preferences alone. But verifier coverage determines reward quality: passing weak tests does not mean the implementation is correct. If tasks permit editing tests, a model may also earn reward by undermining verification.

DeepSeek-R1相关报告提供了用强化学习形成推理行为的公开研究案例。其方法.en: DeepSeek-R1 reports provide public research cases of reinforcement learning producing reasoning behavior. Their methods, cold-start data, training stages and evaluations have specific experimental conditions; "RL produced reasoning patterns" cannot be expanded into "Any model learns reliable long-term agent behavior from reward alone".

组相对优势的一种直觉是对同一题采样多条回答，以组内奖励均值/尺度为基准比较，减少.en: One intuition for group-relative advantage is sampling several answers to the same question and comparing them against the group's mean reward/scale, reducing dependence on a separate value estimate. If all answers receive the same reward, the relative signal may be weak; if reward checks only the final result, the actual validity of steps remains unclear. "Thinking longer" at deployment allocates inference compute; optimizing a policy in training is a separate matter.

5. 过程监督、结果监督与搜索的边界.en: 5. The boundaries of process supervision, outcome supervision and search

结果监督便宜而直接，但很难指出长推理中第一个错误；过程监督可以更细，却需要可靠步.en: Outcome supervision is inexpensive and direct but struggles to identify the first error in long reasoning; process supervision is finer-grained but needs reliable step labels and may reward steps tailored to a grading format. Multipath sampling, self-consistency voting and tree search spend extra inference-time compute exploring candidates; they do not inherently add base-model knowledge.

若多个候选共享同一错误前提，投票只会放大错误。若验证器只偏好语言流畅，搜索可能更.en: If candidates share a false premise, voting only amplifies it. If a verifier prefers fluent language, search may more consistently find wrong but pleasing answers. Search gains therefore need two conditions together: candidates have useful diversity, and the evaluator can identify better outcomes. Test both with task-level ablations.

对于代码任务，先让模型运行一个相关测试，往往比无证据地生成三份长分析更可核验。这.en: For coding tasks, having the model run a relevant test is often more verifiable than generating three long analyzes without evidence. This is not a law that testing beats reasoning in every situation; it prioritizes buying information that rules out false hypotheses. Deeper analysis can still be highly valuable for risky cross-module changes.

6. 从模型选择落到工程决策.en: 6. From model selection to engineering decisions

区分三种失败：没有相关知识、无法在给定条件下推理、无法可靠执行。第一类优先检索；.en: Distinguish three failures: lacking relevant knowledge, being unable to reason under given conditions, and being unable to execute reliably. The first favors retrieval; the second may need a stronger model, different decomposition or better verification; the third favors repairing tools and state management. Assigning all three to fine-tuning wastes cost and hides execution-system defects.

比较不同推理强度时，保持任务、可用工具和判分一致，记录总成本、总时间、成功率及失.en: When comparing reasoning intensities, hold tasks, available tools and grading fixed, and record total cost, total time, success rate and failure types. Do not compare only final output length. Internal reasoning is not necessarily exposed to clients, and a purported complete internal trace should not be demanded as proof of correctness; observable evidence chains and repeatable results matter more.

PPO正优势被裁剪，负优势却不是同一种取法.en: PPO clips positive advantage, but handles negative advantage differently

输入与条件。</strong>PPO clipped surrogate中r=新.en: Input and conditions. In the PPO clipped surrogate, r=new policy probability/old policy probability, ε=0.2, and the objective takes min(rA,clip(r,0.8,1.2)A), which training usually maximizes.

裁剪分支仍2.4，不再奖励这一方向超幅增加。.en: The clipped branch stays at 2.4, no longer rewarding excessive increases in this direction.

原项−1，裁剪项−1.6，取更小的−1.6。.en: Original term −1, clipped term −1.6; take the smaller −1.6.

坏动作概率下降太多也被裁剪限制.en: Clipping also limits too large a decrease in a bad action's probability

不能忽略A的正负只“把r夹住”。.en: Do not ignore A's sign and simply "clamp r".

还需优势估计、样本、价值/熵项等配置.en: Still needs advantage estimates, samples, value/entropy terms and other configuration

一个标量目标不是完整RLHF流水线。.en: One scalar objective is not a complete RLHF pipeline.

把过程连起来。</strong>裁剪目标的min与优势符号共同影响优化，不是对策.en: Join the steps up. The clipped objective's min and the advantage's sign jointly affect optimization; this is not simply truncating policy probabilities to an interval.

边界与反例。</strong>此为PPO目标局部算例，不是全局KL硬约束，也不保.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is a local example of the PPO objective, not a global hard KL constraint, and does not guarantee every update stays within a trust region.

一组偏好数据总选更长答案，DPO训练后回答更完整，但功能通过率没变化。是否成功？.en: A preference dataset always selects longer answers. After DPO training, answers are more complete but the functional pass rate is unchanged. Is that success? Possibly for the "Prefer long answers" objective, but there is no evidence of success for engineering quality. Adjust the data or evaluation dimensions, or abandon the change, instead of attaching an "Intelligence improved" label afterward.

一个推理模型偶尔在简单任务上浪费很多轮。是否一定要新增复杂度评分器？不一定。先看.en: A reasoning model occasionally wastes many turns on simple tasks. Must a complexity scorer be added? Not necessarily. Check prompts, stopping conditions, tool feedback and default reasoning configuration first; introduce model or intensity routing only when stable gains across task strata cover routing costs. Model capability is a condition for system design, not a reason to add framework layers indefinitely.

目标：能区分概率分布、解码算法和产品停止语义；能够推导推测解码的正确性，而不是只.en: Goal: distinguish probability distributions, decoding algorithms and product stopping semantics; derive speculative decoding's correctness instead of only knowing that it "uses a small model to accelerate generation". Experiment:

采样、贪心和推测验证共享模型分数，却不共享选择规则。下图把每轮选择与下一轮输入分.en: Sampling, greedy selection and speculative verification share model scores but not selection rules. The figure below separates each turn's selection from the next turn's input.

1. 概率最高的下一Token，不等于最好的完整答案.en: 1. The most probable next token is not the best complete answer

贪心选择每一步最大概率Token，不保证全序列概率最大，更不保证业务最优。语言模.en: Greedy selection takes the most probable token at each step; it guarantees neither the most probable complete sequence nor the best business outcome. Language-model probabilities describe conditional continuation distributions, while task value may be determined by external tests. Beam Search maintains several partial sequences to explore high-probability paths, but length bias, repetition and mismatched objectives for open-ended text all need consideration. Suitability for translation does not make a method the default for interactive coding agents.

温度把logits除以τ，τ较小使分布更集中，较大使分布更平缓。它不是“错误率旋.en: Temperature divides logits by τ: smaller τ concentrates the distribution, while larger τ flattens it. It is not an "error-rate knob" and cannot turn an unsupported answer into fact. Top-k retains a fixed number of candidates; Top-p selects the smallest candidate set reaching the cumulative-probability threshold, then renormalizes. If both apply, order and service implementation affect the distribution; check the particular interface.

在约束输出中，解码器还可能屏蔽不符合语法的Token。这样能帮助满足结构约束，但.en: For constrained output, a decoder may also mask tokens that violate syntax. This helps structural constraints, but keep three layers separate: whether bytes parse, whether structure meets the schema, and whether fields match business facts. Valid JSON can still contain a nonexistent file path.

softmax中的减最大值避免指数溢出，却不会解决所有下溢或低精度舍入。若概率接.en: Subtracting the maximum in softmax prevents exponential overflow but does not solve every underflow or low-precision rounding issue. Near-zero probabilities require sequence probabilities to be calculated in log space rather than by direct multiplication. Operator fusion, dtype and parallel-reduction order may change the ranking of close logits, eventually amplified by autoregression into different text. This does not imply "Results cannot be reproduced, so parameters need not be recorded"; record the model/service version, seed support, sampling configuration and environment precisely because of this.

评测多次运行时，不应把同一问题的十次回答当成十个独立业务场景。任务难度带来的相关.en: In repeated evaluation, ten answers to one question are not ten independent business scenarios. Preserve the correlation introduced by task difficulty; Lesson 14 uses task-paired statistical methods. One low-temperature success is especially insufficient evidence of long-term reliability.

3. 推测解码：接受与拒绝补偿.en: 3. Speculative decoding: acceptance and rejection compensation

设目标分布p、草稿分布q，都在同一Token空间。先从q抽样候选x，以.en: Let target distribution p and draft distribution q share a token space. First sample candidate x from q and accept with probability

接受。如果拒绝，再从归一化的.en: . If rejected, sample from the normalized

残差分布采样。被接受的Token贡献概率为.en: residual distribution. Accepted tokens contribute probability

这个一Token推导是本书实验验证的对象。完整多Token推测会先生成一段草稿，.en: This one-token derivation is what the book's experiment verifies. Full multi-token speculation first produces a draft segment, then evaluates its positions in parallel with the target model, accepting in sequence until the first rejection and compensating. If all are accepted, an additional target token can be generated. Implementations must also correctly handle cache rollback, truncation, positions and batches; copying these few lines does not make a complete high-performance service.

“保持分布”有条件：p与q必须是实际解码规则下的归一化分布，接受/残差计算正确。.en: Preserving the distribution is conditional: p and q must be normalized distributions under the actual decoding rules, with correct acceptance/residual calculations. If the target uses Top-p but verification uses untruncated softmax, it is no longer the same p. A poor draft causes many rejections, and added computation may exceed the savings. This improves compute scheduling efficiency; it does not make the target model smarter from nothing.

4. 实验读数与能证明的范围.en: 4. Reading the experiment and its limits of proof

用小词表、固定p/q和大量抽样，比较经验频率与目标概率。统计误差不应要求逐项完全.en: Using a small vocabulary, fixed p/q and many samples, compare empirical frequencies with target probabilities. Statistical error means exact item-by-item equality should not be required; the code uses explicit tolerances and a fixed random seed for rechecking. Also test q=p, support boundaries and strongly mismatched distributions separately. Always accepting the draft should bias empirical frequencies toward q, providing a negative control.

这次实验没有GPU，没有服务端批处理，更没有商业模型加速测量。因此只能证明接受/.en: This experiment has no GPU, no server-side batching and no commercial-model speedup measurement. It can establish only the teaching implementation of acceptance/rejection and its distributional consistency, not a claim of "Several times faster inference". Performance validation needs fixed models, hardware, sequence distributions and batches, end-to-end timing, and checks of output distribution/quality.

5. 文本停止、响应完成与业务完成.en: 5. Text stopping, response completion and business completion

生成停止可能因为EOS、停止字符串、最大输出Token、取消、网络中断、服务错误.en: Generation may stop because of EOS, stop strings, output-token limits, cancellation, network disconnection, service errors or tool-call handoff. These are different kinds of completion. At the API layer, inspect response status, errors and output-item types; at the agent layer, check for pending tools or unfinished acceptance checks.

例如模型返回.en: For example, if the model returns

或相应状态表明因长度停止，最后几行看起来像总结，也不能视为任务成功。工具参数可能.en: or the corresponding status indicates stopping for length, a few final lines that look like a summary still do not mean task success. Tool arguments may be only half generated and cannot be executed. A closed network stream also does not prove the service finished, because the client may have received only a prefix. Lesson 60 provides actual parser tests for truncated SSE.

一个稳健停止器需要同时满足：没有未决操作、验收结果对应当前工件版本、预算未迫使错.en: A robust stopping decision requires all of the following: no pending operations, acceptance results tied to the current artifact version, no incorrect exit forced by the budget, and a fulfilled user goal or explicitly reported limitations. The model saying "Done" is only a claim; a deterministic program should at least check the verifiable parts.

6. 最佳实践不是固定采样参数.en: 6. Best practices are not fixed sampling parameters

创意构思、精确配置生成、长链工具执行需要不同的候选多样性与验证方式。与其设一个永.en: Creative ideation, precise configuration generation and long tool-execution chains need different candidate diversity and verification. Instead of one universal temperature, define success and failure costs first, then select on an actual task set. If a small model generates candidates and a larger model or tests select them, count the full candidate cost, not only the final answer.

对工具动作尤其要区分“生成多样性”与“副作用多样性”。可以生成多个方案并比较，但.en: For tool actions, especially distinguish generation diversity from side-effect diversity. Several plans may be generated and compared, but each must not run once against the production database. Explore candidates in environments without side effects where possible, and check authorization and state before actual submission.

同一概率表，核采样与贪心的可选集合不同.en: The same probability table gives different candidate sets for nucleus sampling and greedy selection

输入与条件。</strong>概率从高到低为[0.5,0.3,0.15,0.05.en: Input and conditions. Descending probabilities are [0.5,0.3,0.15,0.05], with no other filtering.

概率表并未转成文本，仍需查Token。.en: The probability table is not text yet; the token still needs looking up.

累计到第3项才达到0.95.en: The cumulative probability reaches 0.95 only at item 3

通常保留前三项并重归一化。.en: Usually keep the first three and renormalize.

若实现先top-k再top-p.en: If the implementation applies top-k before top-p

候选集与顺序不同，需要记录生成配置。.en: Candidate sets and order differ; record the generation configuration.

把过程连起来。</strong>采样选项改变可选集合或概率，不是模型已经生成一句.en: Join the steps up. Sampling options change candidate sets or probabilities; they do not delete words after the model has already generated a sentence.

边界与反例。</strong>具体等于阈值的保留规则与最少保留项数依实现；本例声.en: Limits and counterexamples. Retention exactly at the threshold and minimum candidate counts depend on implementation; this example explicitly retains the item that crosses the cumulative threshold.

为什么推测解码拒绝后不能直接从p重新采样？因为接受分支已经贡献了.en: Why not resample directly from p after speculative decoding rejects? Because the acceptance branch has already contributed

，再按整个p补充会重复分配一些质量；正确补偿是正残差分布。证明应写出两条分支对每.en: , and adding the whole p again would allocate some mass twice; correct compensation uses the positive residual distribution. A proof must write the total probability contributed by both branches for each token, not answer "It looks similar".

为什么JSON解析成功后仍要验证工具参数？因为解析只说明字符构成合法对象；路径是.en: Why verify tool arguments after JSON parses successfully? Parsing establishes only that characters form a valid object; syntax does not guarantee an in-scope path, an existing target, permission or a fresh request. Decoding and execution are different trust boundaries.

1. Prefill与Decode的资源画像.en: 1. Resource profiles of prefill and decode

Prefill处理整个输入前缀，矩阵运算通常具有更高并行度；Decode每步只新.en: Prefill processes the entire input prefix, usually with more parallel matrix computation; decode adds only a few positions per step but must read model weights and a growing KV cache. The bottleneck depends on the batch, model, precision and hardware; prefill is not always compute-bound, nor decode always bandwidth-bound. These are common analysis directions, not conclusions requiring no measurement.

以注意力为例，完整前缀长度T的分数矩阵规模为T²；标准全注意力的计算随T²增长。.en: For attention, a full prefix of length T has a score matrix of size T², and standard full-attention computation grows with T². Cached decoding scores one new position against T historical keys, making this part of one step grow roughly with T; a long sequence still accumulates its costs. KV caching does not mean history need never be processed again: it avoids recomputing old K/V, not reading the data required for attention to history.

2. Roofline思考：算力还是数据移动.en: 2. Roofline thinking: compute or data movement

设一次操作需要F个浮点运算，搬运M字节，设备峰值算力P和带宽W。粗略下界可写为.en: Let an operation require F floating-point operations and M bytes moved, with device peak compute P and bandwidth W. A rough lower bound is

，实际还有启动、同步、通信、调度和利用率损失。算术强度F/M帮助判断优化方向。.en: , with additional launch, synchronization, communication, scheduling and utilization losses in practice. Arithmetic intensity F/M helps identify optimization directions.

例如减少中间矩阵写回能改善内存受限部分，即使数学运算次数略增加，仍可能更快。反过.en: Reducing writes of intermediate matrices can improve memory-bound parts, potentially making them faster even with slightly more arithmetic. Conversely, extra recomputation may slow an already compute-saturated part. FLOPs or GPU utilization alone cannot identify a serving bottleneck; combine memory bandwidth, operator times, queues and request distributions.

3. FlashAttention为什么能不保存完整注意力矩阵.en: 3. Why FlashAttention need not store the full attention matrix

、softmax概率等T×T矩阵写入高带宽内存。分块算法在更近的片上存储中处理块.en: and other T×T matrices, such as softmax probabilities, to high-bandwidth memory. A tiled algorithm processes blocks in closer on-chip storage and maintains normalization statistics so the result does not require the entire matrix to exist at once. FlashAttention organizes exact attention around this IO problem; it does not turn full attention into linear attention.

对于一个查询行，已处理分数的最大值m、指数和l、未归一化加权和a为：.en: For one query row, the maximum processed score m, exponential sum l and unnormalized weighted sum a are:

。看到新块S、V时：.en: . On seeing a new block S, V:

为什么需要重缩放旧统计？新块最大值更大时，旧l和a是相对于旧m计算的，必须转成相.en: Why rescale the old statistics? When the new block has a larger maximum, old l and a were computed relative to old m and must be converted to the scale relative to m'. Updating m alone without rescaling gives blocks incorrect weights, making results depend on the tiling. This is an error worth injecting deliberately.

实现上述恒等式，并与普通softmax注意力比较不同块大小。它没有CUDA核、共.en: implements these identities and compares different block sizes with ordinary softmax attention. It has no CUDA kernel, shared-memory layout, backward operator or hardware performance measurement. During backpropagation, saved statistics can recompute some probabilities to save space by not storing the full matrix; production implementations must also handle masks, dropout, numeric types and batch layouts.

4. 分页KV缓存解决的是分配与共享.en: 4. Paged KV caching addresses allocation and sharing

长请求长度不一，若每条请求预留连续最大KV空间，容易造成浪费与碎片。PagedA.en: Long requests vary in length; reserving contiguous maximum KV space per request wastes capacity and fragments memory. PagedAttention maps logical token positions to fixed-size KV blocks that may be physically noncontiguous. Shared prefixes can reference shared blocks, with suitable sharing/copying rules when writes diverge.

块太小，元数据、寻址与管理成本上升；块太大，最后一个块的内部碎片增大。缓存压缩与.en: Smaller blocks increase metadata, addressing and management costs; larger blocks increase internal fragmentation in the final block. Cache compression and quantization are separate techniques; paging alone does not automatically reduce K/V bytes per valid token. Sharing a physical prefix does not remove tenant isolation or cache-side-channel concerns.

服务调度必须知道多少KV容量可以分配。允许过多长请求同时进入，可能导致抢占、换出.en: Serving schedulers must know how much KV capacity can be allocated. Admitting too many long requests may cause preemption, swapping or failures; RPM limits alone cannot reflect this pressure. In-flight tokens, requests and output limits can be constrained separately, with service objectives considered in scheduling.

静态batch等一组请求一起完成，新请求不能及时加入；连续批处理在迭代边界加入或.en: Static batching waits for a group of requests to finish together, preventing timely admission of new requests; continuous batching adds or removes requests at iteration boundaries to improve device utilization. But a long prefill can block short requests already decoding and affect per-token latency. Chunking prefill, separating stages or designing fair scheduling each adds complexity and hardware conditions.

指标要分开：TTFT看首次响应，TPOT看输出Token间隔，端到端时间看用户任.en: Keep metrics separate: TTFT measures first response, TPOT measures intervals between output tokens, and end-to-end time measures the user's task; multitenancy also needs tail latency. Raising batch size for throughput may hurt interaction, while running one request at a time for minimal latency may reduce utilization. An optimum exists only relative to the workload and SLO.

Little定律在稳定系统中给出.en: Little's law gives, in a stable system,

。它不描述具体队列尾部分布，却能帮助检查容量规划是否自洽。接近饱和后延迟非线性上.en: . It does not describe a particular queue's tail distribution, but helps check capacity-planning consistency. Latency rises nonlinearly near saturation; a low-load single-request benchmark cannot directly predict production peaks.

6. Prompt缓存与KV缓存不要混为一个开关.en: 6. Prompt caching and KV caching are not one switch

模型内部KV缓存是推理状态；服务的前缀缓存可能复用跨请求前缀计算；计费层对缓存命.en: A model's internal KV cache is inference state; a service prefix cache may reuse prefix computation across requests; the billing definition of a cache hit is a product contract again. Applications should keep reusable prefixes stable and avoid irrelevant timestamps at the start, without retaining incorrect or unauthorized content for cache hits. Security and correctness take priority over hit rates.

如果为了压缩删除中间历史，后续前缀可能变化，降低可复用部分。应比较剩余任务的总成.en: Deleting intermediate history for compaction may change later prefixes and reduce reuse. Compare the remaining task's total cost, not only how much this compaction shortened input. Lesson 15 gives a method for calculating compaction gains and losses.

7. 一份可信的性能实验应该包含什么.en: 7. What a credible performance experiment should include

先保存模型版本、精度、硬件、服务配置、输入/输出长度分布、并发与warm-up方.en: Save the model version, precision, hardware, serving configuration, input/output length distributions, concurrency and warm-up method first. Measure with/without caching, short/long prefixes and single-request/production concurrency separately. Report p50/p95 latency, throughput, failure rate, peak VRAM and task quality; do not hide tail problems behind one best-case point.

验收题：NumPy分块注意力与普通注意力误差很小，能否认定FlashAttent.en: Acceptance question: NumPy tiled attention differs little from ordinary attention. Is the FlashAttention optimization complete? No. This verifies only a mathematical subproblem; GPU layouts, synchronization, actual IO and backward correctness remain to be implemented. Separating a mechanism's correctness from a production system's performance gain is a minimum standard for senior engineering study.

roofline估算为什么只能给下界，不能直接当实测.en: Why a roofline estimate gives only a lower bound and cannot be treated as a measurement

输入与条件。</strong>假想算子需1GFLOP和100MB十进制数据移动；.en: Input and conditions. A hypothetical operator needs 1GFLOP and 100MB of data movement in decimal units; the device peaks at 100TFLOP/s and 1TB/s bandwidth.

100微秒，而非保证110或100实测。.en: 100 microseconds, not guaranteed measurements of 110 or 100.

利用率、kernel启动、同步、缓存命中都可能变化.en: Utilization, kernel launches, synchronization and cache hits may vary

实际可以更慢，实际HBM流量也需正确测量。.en: Actual execution may be slower, and actual HBM traffic needs correct measurement too.

若确为带宽瓶颈.en: If bandwidth is actually the bottleneck

降低读取或提高重用可能比单纯增加乘法吞吐更有用。.en: Reducing reads or improving reuse may help more than increasing multiplication throughput alone.

把过程连起来。</strong>性能模型帮助判断瓶颈方向，不能把纸面峰值替代运行.en: Join the steps up. A performance model helps identify bottleneck directions; paper peak figures cannot replace runtime measurements.

边界与反例。</strong>单位采用MB=10^6、TB=10^12；不是任何.en: Limits and counterexamples. Units use MB=10^6 and TB=10^12; these are not any actual GPU's specifications or a performance promise.

1. 把模型服务视作有状态协议，而不是一个字符串函数.en: 1. Treat the model service as a stateful protocol, not a string function

，但真实Agent需要区分文本消息、函数调用、函数结果、推理或压缩状态以及响应终.en: , but a real agent needs to distinguish text messages, function calls, function results, reasoning or compaction state, and final response state. Some interfaces let the service save history; others require clients to return items. Privacy settings, model capabilities and product interfaces jointly determine what is available. The adapter should retain structured objects, not extract text and discard every other item.

例如一个响应可能同时有说明文本和两个工具调用。如果代码只判断“有文本就结束”，工.en: A response may contain explanatory text and two tool calls together. If code ends whenever text is present, the tools never run; converting the whole response into a string in history loses the original types of call IDs, roles and state required by the service. Opaque state that a public interface requires must be saved unchanged or referenced as documented, not replaced by an invented summary.

工具调用是模型提出的动作候选。它的名称、参数和ID进入验证器；验证器返回可执行的.en: A tool call is a model-proposed candidate action. Its name, arguments and ID enter a validator; the validator returns an executable internal command; the executor performs the actual action; the result is fed back with the matching call ID. Name existence, valid argument syntax, permission, state freshness and successful execution are five independent judgments.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/10.h.en: For the full mechanism and a continuing example, see Streaming back: when can the arguments really be executed?; this section retains its original derivations and experiments. The two explanations address different levels and do not replace one another.

2. 流不是以完整字符或JSON对象为单位抵达.en: 2. Streams do not arrive as complete characters or JSON objects

网络字节流可以把一个中文字符、一个JSON转义序列或SSE边界拆开。正确解析顺序.en: A network byte stream can split a Chinese character, JSON escape sequence or SSE boundary. Parse in this order: incrementally decode UTF-8 bytes, assemble events by SSE line rules, complete an event at a blank line, join data fields, parse that event's JSON, then dispatch the event type.

本书实现支持分块字节、CRLF换行和多data行，并对未结束的最后一事件报截断。.en: This book's implementation supports chunked bytes, CRLF line endings and multiple data lines, reporting truncation for an unfinished final event. Tests feed Chinese content byte by byte to verify that multibyte splits do not corrupt it. Do not apply this directly to every network chunk:

；chunk只是传输边界，不是协议边界。.en: ; a chunk is a transport boundary, not a protocol boundary.

只是参数的增量，可能尚不闭合。模型先输出.en: is only an argument increment and may not yet be closed. When the model first outputs

时，不应提前读取一个目录；看到字符串中途的危险片段，也不能简单通过字符串替换“修.en: , do not read a directory prematurely; seeing a dangerous fragment midway through a string also does not justify "repairing" arguments with string replacement. Wait for the specified output item to finish, then parse and authorize the complete arguments.

本书教学适配器采用保守策略：收集完成的调用项，并在收到响应成功终态后才允许执行；.en: This book's teaching adapter takes a conservative approach: collect complete call items and allow execution only after receiving a successful final response state. Failed or truncated responses prohibit executing uncommitted candidates. This is a reference-implementation choice, not a requirement that every commercial client wait for the same point. Some systems may schedule complete tool items as they arrive, while still handling later interruptions and idempotency.

对象把同一调用ID的增量与完成事件关联。若同一ID被重复用于不同内容，返回冲突；.en: instances associate increments and completion events by call ID. Reusing an ID for different content returns a conflict; if the response fails, collected but unexecuted calls will not run silently. The protocol layer must also distinguish unknown events, which may be ignored for forward compatibility, from critical missing information, which must fail. It must not return empty text for every exception and call that success.

生产接入还需要事件大小上限、解析超时、连接闲置超时、取消传播和重连语义。重连不是.en: Production integration also needs event-size limits, parsing timeouts, idle-connection timeouts, cancellation propagation and reconnection semantics. Reconnection does not mean blindly executing every tool again from the beginning, especially after external side effects in the previous turn.

JSON Schema可以约束字段类型、枚举、必填项和额外字段，但不能判断某个订.en: JSON Schema can constrain field types, enumerations, required fields and extra fields; it cannot determine whether an order belongs to the current user or prove that

指向的是用户授权的仓库。结构化输出是协议可靠性的基础，不是业务可信性的终点。.en: points to the user's authorized repository. Structured output is a foundation of protocol reliability, not the endpoint of business trustworthiness.

应把参数转换成类型明确的内部对象，再验证语义。读取文件工具至少要限定根目录、允许.en: Convert arguments to clearly typed internal objects, then validate semantics. A file-reading tool should at least constrain the root, allowed file types, maximum byte count, symlink policy and encoding-failure behavior. Update tools also need expected-version comparisons to avoid applying changes generated from old code to new code.

异常结果应该具有可行动的含义。.en: Exceptional results should have actionable meanings.

可以指导换定位方式；.en: can guide a different way to locate the target;

表示不能通过换拼写绕过；.en: means changing the spelling cannot bypass the restriction;

说明外部动作是否发生尚不确定。把它们都包成“工具失败，请重试”，会诱导错误恢复策.en: means it is uncertain whether the external action occurred. Wrapping them all as "Tool failed, please retry" encourages incorrect recovery strategies.

5. 工具描述与返回内容如何影响模型.en: 5. How tool descriptions and returned content affect the model

工具名称和描述是模型选择动作的线索。应说明适用场景、关键参数和返回语义，不要把内.en: Tool names and descriptions guide the model's action selection. State applicable situations, key arguments and return semantics without exposing every internal service detail. For easily confused read/write tools, emphasize side effects; for search tools, return hit locations, excerpts, versions and truncation status, which are easier to use than tens of thousands of unstructured text lines.

但“返回更少”不是绝对优化。只返回命中行可能丢失决定分支的前置条件；只返回摘要可.en: Returning less is not an absolute optimization. A hit line alone may omit prerequisites that determine a branch; a summary alone may lose evidence. Better interfaces support locating first, then reading contiguous ranges, with explicit completeness. Letting the model expand evidence gradually is more robust than tools permanently discarding key information themselves.

当前工具Schema也占用上下文。工具很多时可以先提供发现入口，再加载相关定义；.en: Current tool schemas also occupy context. With many tools, a discovery entry point can be supplied first and relevant definitions loaded later, but only if the harness supports this mechanism. "Automatic JIT" in a skill file does not mean the executor implements on-demand tool discovery.

6. 可选在线适配器的边界.en: 6. Boundaries of the optional online adapter

使用官方Responses接口，要求明确.en: uses the official Responses interface and requires an explicit

、用户指定模型和环境变量中的密钥。只暴露只读文件工具，没有Shell、写入或部署.en: , a user-specified model and a key in an environment variable. Only read-only file tools are exposed, with no Shell, writing or deployment tools; network requests are not retried automatically to avoid unclear duplicate costs. Response output items retain their structure when returned.

配套结果不包含这个在线入口的实测，因此服务兼容性、模型能力、实际计费与真实任务效.en: The accompanying results contain no measurements of this online entry point, so service compatibility, model capability, actual billing and real-task outcomes are all marked unmeasured. Readers should use only manually prepared sample directories without secrets; file contents will be sent to the model service. The root-directory check is not a production sandbox for a malicious concurrent filesystem; do not directly expose an entire home directory or enterprise repository.

工具参数语法结束后，还需要等待调用结束信号吗.en: Whether a call-end signal is still needed after the tool arguments' syntax is complete

输入与条件。</strong>流中先出现参数片段.en: Input and conditions. The stream first contains argument fragment

，后面还可能有同一输出项的后续delta或结束事件。.en: , and later may still contain further deltas or an end event for the same output item.

目前字符串恰好是合法JSON.en: The current string happens to be valid JSON

等待所用接口定义的调用参数或输出项完成.en: Wait for argument or output-item completion as defined by the interface

确认没有后续修正或追加。.en: Confirm there are no later revisions or additions.

n必须为正整数且在上限内.en: n must be a positive integer within the limit

完整语法不代表参数可用。.en: Complete syntax does not mean usable arguments.

以稳定call_id登记执行状态.en: Register execution state under a stable call_id

避免重连事件重复触发。.en: Avoid duplicate triggers from reconnection events.

不知道完整结束事件是否到达.en: It is unknown whether the complete end event arrived

按协议查询或重建，不任意猜完成。.en: Query or reconstruct according to the protocol, without guessing completion.

把过程连起来。</strong>可解析前缀、完整参数、调用完成和整个响应完成不是.en: Join the steps up. A parsable prefix, complete arguments, call completion and whole-response completion need not occur at the same time.

边界与反例。</strong>不同API的事件名与完成边界不同，教学代码只实现已.en: Limits and counterexamples. APIs differ in event names and completion boundaries; the teaching code implements only its declared subset.

必须通过四个反例：UTF-8在字符中间切分，参数JSON在字符串中间切分，调用项.en: Four counterexamples must pass: UTF-8 split within a character, argument JSON split within a string, a completed call item followed by response failure, and a network disconnection after text arrives. The first three test protocol state machines; the fourth checks whether a human-visible answer is wrongly treated as task completion.

若模型反复调用不存在的工具，先比较本轮实际工具Schema和模型返回名称，而不是.en: If the model repeatedly calls nonexistent tools, compare this turn's actual tool schema with the returned name before adding prompt warnings. If a tool exists but permissions block it, inspect identity, harness configuration and call scope. The model should not have to guess hidden executor-configuration errors.

1. 最小Agent循环其实有三种状态.en: 1. A minimal agent loop actually has three kinds of state

对话状态描述模型看到了什么；任务状态描述目标、已完成动作与未决问题；环境状态描述.en: Conversation state describes what the model saw; task state describes goals, completed actions and pending issues; environment state describes actual file, database and service contents. They may disagree. The model remembering a test run does not mean it matches current code; a database record saying "Committing" does not mean the external commit has not occurred.

本书的最小循环是：构造上下文，获取模型动作候选，校验，执行，记录结果，更新状态，.en: This book's minimal loop constructs context, gets model-proposed actions, validates, executes, records results, updates state, then decides whether to continue or stop. It need not introduce planning, review, memory and grading agents by default. Add a division of work only when a specific failure mode demonstrates its value.

为了便于诊断，内部事件可区分.en: For diagnosis, internal events can distinguish

。这些是副作用操作的局部状态，不要求每个普通读文件都建立复杂状态数据库。任务规模.en: . These are local states for side-effect operations; an ordinary file read does not require a complex state database. Task scale and action risk determine persistence granularity.

2. 为什么必须有unknown，而不能只有成功与失败.en: 2. Why unknown is necessary alongside success and failure

时间线：写入请求已经到达远程服务，远程服务执行成功，但网络连接在返回结果前断开。.en: Timeline: a write request reaches a remote service, which executes successfully, but the connection breaks before returning the result. The client sees a timeout and cannot determine execution from local information alone. Treating timeout as failure and resending may create duplicate orders or emails; treating it as success may falsely report completion.

正确恢复依赖外部系统的能力：支持幂等键时，用同一业务操作键查询或重试；能读取最终.en: Correct recovery depends on external capabilities: if idempotency keys are supported, query or retry with the same business-operation key; if final state is readable, reconcile it; if neither is available, keep the outcome unknown and seek human confirmation. Retry count is not the core issue; semantics is.

本地文件也有类似窗口：已原子替换文件，但进程在写“完成”日志前崩溃。下次执行不能.en: Local files have a similar window: the file was atomically replaced, but the process crashed before writing a completion log. The next execution must not inspect only log state

就再次修改。必须比较当前工件是否已经是期望结果。.en: and edit again. Compare whether the current artifact already matches the intended result.

3. 本书动作日志的实现.en: 3. How this book implements its action journal

、相对路径、修改前哈希、修改后哈希和状态。写入前先比较当前内容与expected.en: , relative paths, before/after hashes and status. Before writing, it compares current content with expected. If an operation ID already exists with different arguments, reuse is rejected; if the file already equals the target content, recovery marks it reconciled rather than writing again.

测试不是修改一个布尔变量模拟崩溃，而是启动子进程，在文件替换后调用.en: The test does not simulate a crash by changing a boolean; it starts a subprocess and, after replacing the file, calls

。父进程随后恢复并检查文件内容与日志。因此它验证了一个真实本地崩溃窗口的恢复机制.en: . The parent process then recovers and checks file contents and the journal. This verifies recovery across an actual local crash window. It does not verify power loss, directory fsync, concurrent writers, cross-database transactions or remote Exactly-once.

SQLite事务能够约束自身数据库的更新，但不能自动覆盖外部文件替换或远程API.en: A SQLite transaction constrains updates within its own database, but cannot automatically include external file replacement or remote APIs. Without a shared transaction, two systems need reconciliation, idempotency or compensation; writing

就获得原子性。.en: in a table does not grant atomicity.

4. Compare-and-swap为何比“直接应用模型补丁”可靠.en: 4. Why compare-and-swap is more reliable than applying model patches directly

模型根据版本A生成补丁，用户此时改成版本B。执行器若不检查就写入，会覆盖用户修改.en: The model generates a patch from version A while the user changes it to B. An executor that writes without checking overwrites the user's changes. CAS requires current content to still equal the expected content read earlier; otherwise it returns stale and rereads. Versions may use commits, ETags or content fingerprints, depending on artifact boundaries.

内容哈希用于这里的并发前置条件是有实际语义的；但把每篇技能文档的全文哈希写死在测.en: Content hashes have meaningful semantics for this concurrency precondition. Hardcoding the full hash of every skill document in tests so mere wording changes cause failure is usually a brittle snapshot. The same technique has different value in different places; neither reject it categorically nor overuse it everywhere.

本书实现是单写者参考，没有对恶意进程的TOCTOU防御。路径检查和随后的打开之间.en: This book's implementation is a single-writer reference without TOCTOU defenses against malicious processes. The filesystem may change between path checks and opening; production isolation needs directory handles, safe-open flags, containers/sandboxes or permission limits. Do not package a teaching CAS as a security product.

故障注入：在副作用提交之后立刻杀掉执行进程.en: Fault injection: killing the execution process the moment after the side effect commits

实验为何要真的退出进程.en: Why the experiment must actually exit the process

仅在函数里raise异常，可能触发finally、缓冲刷新或测试框架补救，不能代.en: Raising an exception inside a function may trigger finally blocks, buffer flushes or test-framework recovery; it does not represent a process abruptly disappearing. This book's worker calls os._exit(17) after the downstream SQLite commit, deliberately leaving the confirmation journal at pending. Data is written only in a temporary directory, with no external account or actual payment.

两个数据库模拟不同原子边界：external.sqlite保存效果，journa.en: Two databases model different atomic boundaries: external.sqlite stores effects, and journal.sqlite stores execution state. Recovery without an idempotency key writes a second effect; the stable-key path uses a downstream unique constraint to retain one. The experiment demonstrates boundaries, not coverage of network latency, distributed replication or multi-region failures.

读源码要抓提交顺序.en: Look for commit order when reading the source

先看CREATE/INSERT和commit在哪里，再看崩溃点，再看恢复条件。若.en: Locate CREATE/INSERT and commit first, then the crash point and recovery conditions. If the crash occurs before the side-effect commit, both paths may execute only once, so the test cannot distinguish the window that actually needs protection. The valuable point is a fault location that kills an incorrect implementation.

从一个具体有副作用的工具开始：定义业务意图ID，记录规范化参数指纹；返回状态区分.en: Start with one specific tool that has side effects: define a business-intent ID and record a normalized argument fingerprint; distinguish not occurred, occurred and unknown in return states; use downstream deduplication when available, otherwise add verification and human recovery. Do not build a universal transaction platform for one local read-only search tool; publishing, deletion and commits still need more than natural-language summaries for tracking.

本实验不验证断电持久化、数据库复制、唯一键过期和服务端多次响应一致性。生产接口还.en: This experiment does not verify power-loss durability, database replication, unique-key expiry or consistency across repeated server responses. Production interfaces must also define idempotency retention, same-key/different-argument handling and whether late requests remain valid. The textbook provides a runnable minimal proof, not whole-system exactly-once certification.

D03：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: D03: how to read these results beyond "passed"

把崩溃前远端效果与崩溃后本地日志分开。这里的副作用次数来自临时数据库实验；有稳定.en: Separate remote effects before the crash from local logs after it. Side-effect counts here come from a temporary-database experiment; stable-key and no-stable-key paths are independent controls.

E41：外部动作成功、日志没来得及确认：为什么本地事务无法保证只执行一次？.en: E41: The external action succeeded but the log never got to confirm it: why can a local transaction not guarantee exactly-once execution?

E42：三层各重试三次，为什么最底层会被打27次？.en: E42: Three layers each retrying three times: why does the bottom one get hit 27 times?

批准后参数改写.ja: 承認後の引数の書き換え

对最终动作计算稳定身份摘要，分别改变字段顺序和目标环境。字段顺序变化不应改变逻辑.en: Computes a stable identity digest for the final action, then changes the field order and the target environment in turn. Changing the field order should not change the logical identity; changing the target environment should invalidate the original approval.
对最终动作计算稳定身份摘要，分别改变字段顺序和目标环境。字段顺序变化不应改变逻辑.ja: 最終的な操作から安定した識別用ダイジェストを計算し、フィールド順と対象環境を別々に変えます。フィールド順が変わっても論理的な識別は変わらず、対象環境が変われば元の承認は無効になる必要があります。

关键边界：</strong>不要只批准函数名；审核日志同时记录实际执行与向模型呈.en: Key boundary: do not approve a function name alone; the audit log records both what was actually executed and what was presented to the model.
关键边界：</strong>不要只批准函数名；审核日志同时记录实际执行与向模型呈.ja: 重要な境界：関数名だけを承認してはいけません。監査ログには実際の実行と、モデルに提示した結果の両方を記録します。

顺着源码或工程依据继续追：</strong>尤其警惕“拒收结果”被误读为“动作未.en: Follow it further through the source or the engineering basis: be especially wary of "the result was rejected" being misread as "the action did not happen". Do not check only the path that goes well; check the behavior on cancellation, on a version change, and when the result is unknown.
顺着源码或工程依据继续追：</strong>尤其警惕“拒收结果”被误读为“动作未.ja: ソースコードや工学的根拠をさらにたどる：「結果の受け入れ拒否」が「操作は未発生」と誤読されることに、特に注意します。正常な経路だけでなく、キャンセル、バージョンの変化、結果不明の場合の振る舞いも照合します。

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/10.h.en: For the full mechanism and a continuing example, see Why can a pre-check and a post-check not replace each other?; this section retains its original derivations and experiments. The two explanations address different levels and do not replace one another.

证据与理解边界：</strong>后置检查发生时动作可能已完成。Codex与Cl.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding:By the time a post-hoc check runs, the action may already be complete. The semantics of a post-hoc block differ between Codex and Claude Code; and even where the result is redacted, the original log still has to be checked.
证据与理解边界：</strong>后置检查发生时动作可能已完成。Codex与Cl.ja: 証拠と理解の限界：事後の確認時には、操作が完了済みの場合があります。CodexとClaude Codeでは、事後のblockの意味が異なります。結果をマスキングするときは、元のログも確認する必要があります。

5. 完成判定应该绑定当前工件.en: 5. Completion decisions should be tied to current artifacts

记录测试开始和结束时的工件版本。若测试通过后文件又改变，原绿色结果失效，.en: Record artifact versions at test start and end. If the file changes after tests pass, the green result is invalid, and

拒绝把它作为当前证据。修改后的注释也会使本教学哈希失效，这是保守的工件新鲜度选择.en: refuses to treat it as current evidence. Even edited comments invalidate this teaching hash; that is a conservative artifact-freshness choice. Large repositories can use dependency-aware strategies, but must prove the risk of omissions acceptable.

同时，测试结果不等于用户目标全部达成。一个功能可能通过测试却缺少迁移、文档或部署.en: Test results also do not mean every user goal is met. A feature may pass tests but lack migration, documentation or deployment steps. Check necessary completion items against the task's original requirements, instead of demanding heavy deliverables for every project by default.

错误恢复也需要停止条件。模型连续两次相同工具失败、没有新证据、动作未变化时，应切.en: Recovery needs stopping conditions too. When the model hits the same tool failure twice with no new evidence or changed action, switch locating methods or explicitly report a block instead of looping until the budget is exhausted. Recoverable transient rate limits can use backoff; permission denials must not be bypassed by changing commands.

6. 单Agent与确定性控制的边界.en: 6. Boundaries between a single agent and deterministic control

哪些动作交给模型？不确定的定位、候选方案、证据关联和取舍。哪些交给程序？解析、授.en: What belongs to the model? Uncertain locating, candidate plans, evidence connections and trade-offs. What belongs to the program? Parsing, authorization, file-version comparisons, idempotency keys, timeouts and billing budgets. Not every business judgment can be made deterministic, but reliably verifiable parts should not depend only on telling the model to "Be careful".

规划可以是一小段任务状态，不一定另开Agent。评审可以在当前上下文中核对dif.en: Planning can be a short task-state record rather than a separate agent. Review can check the diff and tests in current context without rereading the whole repository every time. A database can be a local file rather than beginning with an event-bus design. The goal is fewer actual failures, not the maximum number of architectural components.

外部文件写入与本地数据库提交之间的崩溃窗口.en: The crash window between writing an external file and committing the local database

输入与条件。</strong>流程先os.replace写v8，再把数据库动作c.en: Input and conditions. The process first writes v8 with os.replace, then marks database action c7 successful; it crashes between the two steps.

若只看数据库重做写操作.en: Repeating the write based only on the database

可能产生重复副作用或覆盖新版本。.en: May duplicate side effects or overwrite a new version.

对比当前文件内容、预期工件和动作身份.en: Compare current file content, the expected artifact and action identity

确认c7的外部结果是否已发生。.en: Confirm whether c7's external result has occurred.

若外部动作不可查询.en: If the external action cannot be queried

本地事务无法神奇覆盖它，需幂等接口、补偿或人工核查。.en: A local transaction cannot magically include it; idempotent interfaces, compensation or human verification are needed.

把过程连起来。</strong>两个各自原子的操作并不自动形成一个跨资源原子事务.en: Join the steps up. Two individually atomic operations do not automatically form one atomic transaction across resources.

边界与反例。</strong>这描述常见失败窗口，不能给一般外部写操作提供恰好一.en: Limits and counterexamples. This describes a common failure window; it cannot guarantee exactly-once execution for general external writes.

子进程写文件后崩溃，恢复时文件既不等于before也不等于after，应该怎么做.en: A subprocess crashes after writing a file; on recovery, the file matches neither before nor after. What should happen? Treat it as an external edit or state conflict, stop overwriting, preserve evidence and investigate again. Do not guess which version is "more reasonable".

取消请求已发出，能否立即宣布所有副作用停止？不能。需要知道执行器是否支持取消，以.en: A cancellation request was sent; can every side effect immediately be declared stopped? No. The executor's cancellation support and the operation's state when cancellation arrives must be known. Irreversible external actions still need reconciliation. A reliable agent is first a reliable execution system, then a high-quality language model.

，其后是配置的备用名称。读取受.en: , followed by configured fallback names. Reading is limited by the total

总预算限制；这里是字节，不是Token。.en: budget; this is bytes, not tokens.

本章不逐行翻译源码，而用一个原创排障例子说明后果：假设仓库根规则很长，当前目录又.en: Rather than translate source line by line, this chapter uses an original diagnostic example: suppose root rules are long and the current directory also has specialist rules. In an implementation concatenating in path order under a total budget, earlier files may exhaust it. The model appears to "ignore specialist rules", but the rules may never have loaded; another "follow every rule" instruction cannot fix a byte budget.

同目录有override与普通规则时，也不能默认两份叠加。应先检查候选优先级和该.en: If override and ordinary rules coexist in one directory, do not assume both are combined. Check candidate priority and whether only one file is selected per directory. Missing deeper rules may also reflect an unexpected starting cwd rather than model routing errors.

从这些机制可以导出回归样本：无规则、根规则、嵌套规则、override、备用文件.en: These mechanisms suggest regression cases: no rules, root rules, nested rules, override, fallback filenames, zero budget, truncation across byte boundaries and different cwd values. The source includes related tests; this book only reads them and does not claim to have run these Rust tests. New teaching experiments do not replace regression checks on the actual harness version.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/09.h.en: For the complete mechanism and the continuous example see Why does every model call need a consistent context snapshot?; this section keeps its original derivation and experiment, and the two accounts work at different levels rather than replacing each other.
完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/09.h.ja: 仕組み全体と一連の例は、モデル呼び出しごとに一貫したコンテキストのスナップショットが必要なのはなぜか？を参照してください。この節でも従来の導出と実験を残しています。両者は異なる水準の説明であり、互いを置き換えるものではありません。

3. 初始上下文是有类型的项目序列.en: 3. Initial context is a sequence of typed items

在这个快照中从执行策略构造开发者级指令，加入可选开发者指令、用户项目规则和环境信.en: constructs developer-level instructions from execution policies in this snapshot, adding optional developer instructions, user project rules and environment information. It returns a collection of

集合，不是最终Token数组。之后服务仍可能应用不可见的模板和系统规则。.en: , not a final token array. The service may still apply invisible templates and system rules afterward.

调试时应问每条信息在什么角色、什么阶段进入。项目规则在客户端通常作为某类用户上下.en: Ask what role and stage each item enters. Client-side project rules are usually a kind of user-context item; a filename resembling "system rules" must not confer unlimited authority. Tool Schemas may also be stored in a different field from chat text. Judge visibility at the actual request boundary rather than from chat bubbles shown in the UI.

这对技能系统的重要启发是：专业指令应有明确进入点，并能观测“元数据发现→完整内容.en: For skill systems, the key lesson is to give specialist instructions an explicit entry point and distinguish "metadata discovered → full content read → used in the result" observably. Text on disk does not mean model visibility, and visibility does not mean correct execution.

4. run_turn：一个用户轮次可以包含多次模型调用.en: 4. run_turn: one user turn can contain multiple model calls

该函数先检查输入与上下文用量，必要时触发压缩，读取技能相关信息，记录用户输入和技.en: The function first checks input and context usage, triggers compaction if needed, reads skill-related information, records user input and skill-injection items, then enters the model-call loop. The loop also handles user input appended during execution, builds the current prompt from history and decides whether further action requires continuation or termination.

从工程角度看，用户的一次“修复问题”不是单次HTTP调用。工具输出、运行中追加约.en: In engineering terms, one user request to "fix the issue" is not one HTTP call. Tool outputs, new constraints added while running and compacted history may all change the next input. Performance statistics should use the complete user task at the top level rather than count only the first model call.

把这段机制用于排障：若技能刚开始加载过，但后续未生效，需要看之后的历史是否保留、.en: Apply this to diagnosis: if a skill loaded initially but later had no effect, inspect whether subsequent history retained it, was compacted, entered a sub-agent or was superseded by new evidence. An opening log cannot prove the complete skill content remained throughout a long task.

5. compact.rs：本地摘要路径不等于所有Codex压缩.en: 5. compact.rs: a local summary path is not all Codex compaction

所读快照的一条本地路径会发起摘要请求，在上下文超限时裁掉较旧项目后重试；成功后从.en: One local path in the snapshot requests a summary, trims older items and retries when context exceeds the limit, then extracts the summary on success. It rebuilds history from the initial context and user messages fitting the budget and saves a compaction event. The code also explicitly warns that repeated compaction may affect accuracy.

这里要谨慎：另有官方Compaction接口能返回不透明压缩项目；本地可读摘要与.en: Be careful: a separate official Compaction interface can return opaque compaction items; a readable local summary and opaque server state are different implementations. Old source does not establish that "Codex always turns history into plain text". Encrypted returned items also do not establish "completely lossless semantics". The internal representation is unpublished; continued tasks must verify business fidelity.

源码注释与代码行为发生张力时，应优先描述实际操作并保留疑问。例如删除历史开头项目.en: When comments and code behavior are in tension, describe actual operations first and preserve the question. For example, determine how deleting early history items affects prefix caching by recalculating the reusable prefix from actual requests, not by copying a "for caching" comment as a universal conclusion. Senior source reading includes checking comments, not treating them as algorithmic proofs.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/14.h.ja: 仕組み全体と一連の例は、非同期に要約を生成している間に新しいツール結果が来たら、データを失わないためにはどうするか？を参照してください。この節でも従来の導出と実験を残しています。両者は異なる水準の説明であり、互いを置き換えるものではありません。

6. SSE转换：显示内容与可执行项目分开.en: 6. SSE conversion: separate display content from executable items

分别处理文本增量、完成的输出项、失败与完成事件；相关测试包含流未收到完成事件便关.en: handles text deltas, completed output items, failures and completion events separately; its tests include an error for a stream closed before a completion event. This matches the boundaries of the Lesson 60 teaching parser, but this book's implementation is not a Rust port and does not cover every event type.

实际产品还需要处理取消、重连、模型特性与兼容版本。读源码时，先画出“网络事件→内.en: Real products must also handle cancellation, reconnection, model features and compatible versions. When reading source, diagram the type chain "network event → internal event → history → tool runner → next request", then check each conversion for lost IDs, state or errors. Text appearing in the UI alone cannot establish state-machine correctness.

7. 将源码阅读转成自己的排障方法.en: 7. Turn source reading into your own diagnostic method

遇到“子Agent没有技能/MCP”，应依次验证：宿主版本及产品面、配置发现路径.en: For "the sub-agent has no skills / MCP", verify in order: harness version and product interface, configuration-discovery paths, actual loading, available tools, delegation input construction, execution permissions and returned evidence. Do not invent an inheritance system to fix an unestablished defect.

毕业标准不是背住几个函数名，而是拿到另一个提交后能够重新找到等价边界，辨认变更对.en: Graduation means finding equivalent boundaries in another commit and identifying effects on context, skills and error recovery, rather than memorizing function names. Change only layers your extension owns: if the harness already implements execution, permissions and caching, do not rebuild an entire harness in the skill repository.

源码函数名相同，调用条件改变后结论如何失效.en: How conclusions expire when function names stay the same but calling conditions change

输入与条件。</strong>阅读固定提交中函数build_tool_call，.en: Input and conditions. Read build_tool_call in a pinned commit, where it converts FunctionCall to ToolCall. Another commit may change the exposed tool set before this call.

函数仍然能构造ToolCall.en: The function can still construct ToolCall

不证明所有请求都能到达它。.en: This does not prove every request can reach it.

检查谁调用、何种响应类型会进入.en: Check callers and which response types enter

调用者与配置是结论一部分。.en: Callers and configuration are part of the conclusion.

记录commit、路径、符号和观察范围.en: Record commit, path, symbol and observation scope

不只抄函数名。.en: Do more than copy the function name.

新版比较暴露计划与调用链.en: Compare exposure plans and call chains in the new version

局部源码未变也可能整体行为不同。.en: Unchanged local source may still yield different overall behavior.

不写成“所有Codex始终如此”。.en: Do not write "all Codex versions always do this".

把过程连起来。</strong>源码证据必须与版本、入口和条件绑定，避免局部真相.en: Join the steps up. Bind source evidence to version, entry point and conditions so local truths do not mislead about the whole system.

边界与反例。</strong>本例是源码阅读方法；具体Codex事实依本书保留的.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is a source-reading method; specific Codex facts depend on this book's retained snapshots and are not updated through guesses.
