目标：能比较真实产品的上下文、委派和权限，而不把不同产品面、不同版本混为一谈。证.en: Goal: compare real products' context, delegation and permissions without conflating interfaces or versions. Evidence comes from official pages read on 2026-10-17 and does not imply unchanged future versions.

公开能力、观察到的行为与不可见内部应分栏记；没有公开证据的实现不补猜。.en: Record public capabilities, observed behavior and invisible internals in separate columns; do not guess implementations lacking public evidence.

1. 比较对象必须先明确.en: 1. Specify the objects being compared first

Claude Code CLI、IDE中的聊天、Copilot CLI、GitH.en: Claude Code CLI, IDE chat, Copilot CLI and GitHub-hosted coding agents are different execution environments. A tool, Skill, memory or MCP feature available in one interface does not automatically exist in another. Model-capability comparisons must control the actual model, tools, network, repository index, permissions and environment, or they measure whole-system differences.

官方文档公开了Claude Code的循环、上下文构成、自动清理与压缩、子Age.en: Official documentation describes Claude Code's loop, context composition, automatic cleanup and compaction, sub-agents and memory; Copilot CLI custom-agent documentation describes profiles and tool configuration. Neither reveals every internal prompt or service implementation. Mark unpublished areas "not public / untested" rather than infer a fixed algorithm from one output.

2. 上下文不是只有聊天记录.en: 2. Context includes more than chat history

Claude Code公开说明其上下文包含会话、工具结果、项目指令、记忆和按需加.en: Claude Code publicly describes context containing conversation, tool results, project instructions, memory and on-demand content, with old-tool-output cleanup and session compaction. Skills can load descriptions first and bodies when used. Tool-definition discovery may also vary by implementation; an old version's tool token cost is not a constant.

工程上要区分“文件已存在于项目”“工具已经读过”“目前仍在模型上下文”“被保存在.en: Distinguish four states: "file exists in the project", "tool has read it", "still in model context" and "saved in external memory". A large file previously read may survive compaction only as a summary; when exact code is needed later, reread the original location rather than demand reconstruction from a summary.

对多目录仓库，还应检查规则加载作用域。自动记忆与人工维护的项目指令具有不同生命周.en: For multi-directory repositories, check rule-loading scope too. Automatic memory and manually maintained project instructions have different lifecycles; both containing "memory" in their names does not give them equal authority. Current source and explicit user requests should correct stale experience rather than remain overridden by historical summaries.

3. 子Agent不应被笼统描述为“完整继承”或“完全空白”.en: 3. Do not broadly describe sub-agents as "inheriting everything" or "completely blank"

Claude Code文档描述独立子上下文，也存在fork当前会话的方式；委派模.en: Claude Code documentation describes separate sub-contexts and ways to fork a current session; delegation modes yield different initial contexts. Verify returned content, whether tool calls remain in the sub-context and whether skills preload against the specific configuration.

Copilot CLI的自定义profile包含描述、提示、可选工具列表和MCP.en: A Copilot CLI custom profile includes a description, prompt, optional tool list and MCP configuration; documentation says a profile without tool restrictions can access the available tool set. "Available tools" still depend on harness configuration, connections and permissions; not every MCP service is automatically logged in and usable.

从工程角度可拆成三层：工具发现决定看见哪些名称，Agent配置决定允许请求哪些工.en: Distinguish three engineering layers: discovery determines visible tool names, agent configuration determines permitted requests, and execution permissions determine whether a specific call succeeds. Model tool selection is a fourth layer. Fixing one alone does not guarantee a call occurs.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/12.h.en: For the full mechanism and a continuous example see Rule-file loading and sub-agent inheritance: why is "inherited automatically" not enough to say?; this section keeps its own derivation and experiment, and the two accounts work at different levels rather than replacing each other.

4. 一套低成本、可复查的宿主行为探针.en: 4. Low-cost, repeatable probes of harness behavior

本书没有在用户本机运行Codex、Claude或Copilot。下面是读者可自行.en: This book has not run Codex, Claude or Copilot on the user's machine. The following is an experiment design for readers, not measured results: create a sample repository without secrets; put harmless, recognizable rules in root and subdirectories; start the same simple task from different cwd values; record versions, loading notices and outputs. Then explicitly invoke a read-only custom agent and compare visible tools and rules.

探针不应让模型仅回答“我已经加载了技能”。应设置必须使用该规则才能满足的可验证结.en: A probe should not merely ask the model to say "I loaded the skill". Require a verifiable result dependent on the rule, such as JSON with a prescribed key, without leaking that key directly into the user task. Even a correct result is only indirect evidence; combine it with more direct loading logs or context displays when supported.

压缩探针可以在长任务早期设置明确约束，中间加入正常工作记录，触发受支持的压缩，再.en: For a compaction probe, set an explicit constraint early in a long task, add ordinary work records, trigger supported compaction, then continue a task depending on that constraint. Keep uncompacted controls, different positions and repeated trials. One successful recollection does not establish safety for every long task.

一些工具提供文件编辑回退或会话恢复，但不应推断它能撤销外部邮件、远程部署或数据库.en: Some tools offer file-edit rollback or session recovery; this does not imply reversal of external email, remote deployment or database writes. File checkpoints, session history, execution logs and the remote world occupy different state spaces. Lesson 63's unknown state matters in real products too.

配置“只读审查”也要检查工具能力。如果审查Agent能执行任意Shell，实际权.en: Check tool capabilities even with "read-only review" configuration. A reviewer able to execute arbitrary Shell commands may exceed the written permissions. Enforce restrictions through the executor rather than only saying "do not edit files". Ordinary file reads need not always require human approval; a clearly bounded sandbox reduces approval fatigue.

6. 面向rd-skills这类扩展层的最佳取舍.en: 6. Best choices for extension layers such as rd-skills

扩展层应该增加宿主欠缺的专业知识与准确路由，而不是重复实现宿主已有的会话、工具、.en: Extensions should supply missing expertise and accurate routing rather than duplicate existing harness sessions, tools, persistence and permissions. Locate the failure in the skill description, loading boundary, specialist content, returned evidence or harness itself first. If the right skill is visible but generic, more router optimization will not fix expertise quality.

一个高价值改动的例子：某技能在明确不相关任务误加载，添加适用边界及反例，并在误加.en: A high-value change: a skill loads on clearly unrelated tasks; add applicability boundaries and counterexamples and verify both irrelevant and mandatory-load tasks. A low-value change: fear of omissions leads to loading all specialist material by default and adding multiple routing agents to review it. That adds context, latency and conflicts and needs very clear measured gains to justify it.

严谨结论应写成：“在某版本CLI、某仓库、某权限与工具配置下，任务集X观察到Y；.en: A rigorous conclusion reads: "With a particular CLI version, repository, permission and tool configuration, task set X showed Y; hosted versions and other models were untested." Avoid "Claude always does this; Copilot always does that". Product behavior changes; trustworthy engineering knowledge distinguishes stable principles from version-specific facts.

本章验收：能够为一次技能未生效列出至少三个相互竞争的解释，并设计最少额外调用来区.en: Chapter acceptance: give at least three competing explanations for a skill failing to take effect, and design the fewest extra calls to distinguish them. Prefer observable configuration and execution evidence over model self-reports or ever more rules.

黑箱产品实验：只改一项指令来源.en: Black-box product experiment: change only one instruction source

输入与条件。</strong>准备同一仓库同一任务，A运行在仓库指令缺失时，B只.en: Input and conditions. Use the same repository and task; run A without repository instructions, then B with only a read-only rule file added, keeping tool permissions and model configuration unchanged.

版本、表面、规则位置和发现日志.en: Version, interface, rule locations and discovery logs

观察是否读取规则以及是否提出写动作.en: Observe rule reading and proposed writes

不只看最终答复是否客气。.en: Inspect more than the politeness of the final answer.

避免为了测试而实际产生越权副作用。.en: Avoid actual unauthorized side effects merely for testing.

只能说明这组条件下行为变化，不揭示闭源内部Prompt全文。.en: This only shows a behavioral change under these conditions, not the full text of internal closed-source prompts.

相同任务多次与相邻任务对比.en: Compare repeated runs of the same task and adjacent tasks

区分偶然采样和稳定影响。.en: Distinguish random sampling from stable effects.

把过程连起来。</strong>公开文档与黑箱行为实验可以互补，但不能由一次行为.en: Join the steps up. Public documentation and black-box experiments complement each other, but one behavior cannot reveal the entire internal implementation.

边界与反例。</strong>这是实验设计而非已执行的商业产品测试，没有虚构胜率.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is an experiment design, not an executed commercial-product test; no success rates are invented.

目标：把Context Engineering从提示技巧推进到可检查的信息供给管.en: Goal: turn Context Engineering from prompting techniques into an inspectable information-supply pipeline. Experiment:

。这里的“编译器”是工程组织类比，不是宣称自然语言有确定性语义。.en: . "Compiler" here is an engineering analogy, not a claim that natural language has deterministic semantics.

选择上下文既要看相关性，也要守依赖：工具结果缺少调用条件时可能变成孤立事实。.en: Context selection must respect dependencies as well as relevance: a tool result without its calling conditions can become an isolated fact.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../../visual/F28.html\.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 16 · Retrieval finds candidates first, then judges whether they can answerLesson 22 · Compaction must keep the facts an action depends onO10 · Compaction, retrieval and prompt cache: three different kinds of saving

1. 每轮输入都应有一个明确目的.en: 1. Every turn's input needs a clear purpose

Agent不需要一次性知道整个仓库，而需要足够的信息选择下一步可靠行动。一个调试.en: An agent need not know the entire repository at once; it needs enough information to choose the next reliable action. A debugging turn may need only entry points, candidate branches, relevant tests and current constraints; implementation needs exact code ranges; verification needs the current diff and acceptance criteria. Information needs change with the stage.

上下文管线可分为：获得候选信息，验证来源与权限，判断适用范围与新鲜度，去重，选择.en: The context pipeline can gather candidates, verify provenance and permissions, judge scope and freshness, deduplicate, select necessary dependencies, allocate budgets, serialize and record provenance. Do not assign every step to one "summarize this" prompt, or retrieval misses, selection losses and compaction errors become indistinguishable.

原始证据与指导规则也应分区。网页里写“忽略前面指令”，只是外部文本，不应在序列化.en: Keep original evidence separate from guidance too. "Ignore previous instructions" on a web page is external text and must not become a high-priority command after serialization. The harness must generate permission and source labels rather than trust a document's self-proclaimed "highest authority".

设候选项i有成本ci、估计价值vi、选择变量xi。最简单选择问题类似背包：最大化.en: Let candidate i have cost ci, estimated value vi and selection variable xi. The simplest selection resembles a knapsack problem: maximize

。但现实还存在必须保留项和依赖：如果读取调用点需要类型定义，则.en: . Real systems also have mandatory items and dependencies: if understanding a call site needs a type definition, then

。没有这些约束，仅按“语义相关度/Token”排序可能留下无法理解的碎片。.en: . Without these constraints, ranking only by "semantic relevance / tokens" may leave incomprehensible fragments.

使用明确依赖闭包和价值密度启发式，不声称求出全局最优。必要项先保留；如果必要项本.en: uses explicit dependency closure and a value-density heuristic without claiming global optimality. Mandatory items are retained first; if they alone exceed the budget, it reports an explicit error rather than silently dropping hard constraints. Cycles and missing dependencies also fail explicitly. These metadata checks admit deterministic tests, but vi is teaching input, not measured, calibrated real information value.

预算也不能只等于最大上下文窗口。要预留工具结果、模型输出和后续步骤，并考虑服务实.en: Budget is not just the maximum context window. Reserve room for tool results, model output and later steps, accounting for actual service computation. Approximate token counts need a margin and calibration against service usage; bytes, characters and tokens are not interchangeable.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/13.h.en: For the full mechanism and a continuous example see Why can assembling context not just be "take the first N items"?; this section keeps its own derivation and experiment, and the two accounts work at different levels rather than replacing each other.

3. 小而完整，比碎片多更重要.en: 3. Small and complete matters more than many fragments

，函数定义解释path相对仓库根，测试说明末尾斜杠代表目录。三个片段共同定义行为.en: , the definition says path is relative to the repository root, and tests say a trailing slash marks a directory. All three define the behavior together. Keeping only the call site misleads string handling; test names without assertions also fail to establish the contract.

“最小充分证据”不是固定行数，而是足以回答当前决策的闭包。源码读取可先拿定义与关.en: "Minimal sufficient evidence" is not a fixed line count but a closure sufficient for the current decision. Start code reading with definitions and key callers, then extend to exception handling and boundary tests, explaining what uncertainty each addition resolves. This avoids unconditional scanning without reducing complex tasks to one-sided fragments.

长文件截断时要显示是否截断、总范围与继续读取位置。返回100行却不告诉模型后面还.en: Truncated long files should report truncation, total range and where to continue. Returning 100 lines without revealing later logic creates false completeness. Precisely scoped continuation is more controllable than letting a model conclude from truncated results.

4. 权威、新鲜度与适用范围不是一个分数.en: 4. Authority, freshness and scope are not one score

用户明确要求、当前源码、官方接口文档、过往经验、模型假设有不同语义。不能简单给每.en: Explicit user requests, current source, official API documentation, experience and model assumptions have different meanings. Do not assign confidence scores and average them. High-scoring experience cannot authorize edits to prohibited files; relevant old API examples cannot override actual current-version responses.

推荐分开记录：来源类型、版本或读取时间、作用域、状态（观察/假设/已验证）、证据.en: Record source type, version or read time, scope, state (observation / hypothesis / verified) and evidence location separately. Apply hard constraints first, then consider value and cost within the allowed set. A simple structured list can do this without a database for every task.

信息冲突应保留冲突及解决条件。两个文档描述相反，先看版本和适用产品面；无法判定时.en: Preserve conflicts and conditions for resolving them. For contradictory documents, check versions and product interfaces first; unresolved claims must not merge into a seemingly certain summary. Preserve exactly what is uncertain rather than add a generic disclaimer.

5. JIT加载的收益与失败方式.en: 5. Benefits and failure modes of JIT loading

技能描述适合保持短而可判别，专业细节在确认相关后读取，资源按任务继续展开。这样减.en: Keep skill descriptions short and distinguishable, read specialist detail after confirming relevance, and expand resources as needed. This reduces default context, but narrow descriptions miss skills, broad ones load irrelevant skills, and late discovery of key constraints causes rework.

因此JIT的评价不是“加载Token减少”，而是必需能力召回、不必要加载、首次有.en: Evaluate JIT through necessary-capability recall, unnecessary loading, time to first effective action and final engineering results, not merely fewer loaded tokens. Skills need action-changing expertise such as language concurrency semantics, storage transaction boundaries or framework testing strategies; generic demands for "high quality and maintainability" cannot replace it.

代码注入与工具权限也不同。加载一个含MCP说明的Skill，不会自动授予MCP连.en: Code injection also differs from tool permissions. Loading a Skill describing MCP does not automatically grant an MCP connection. Verify content routing and tool routing separately; mistaking a permission failure for a JIT failure leads to the wrong design.

对同一组任务比较全量默认加载、按需加载、按需加结构状态三种方案。固定模型、工具与.en: Compare default full loading, on-demand loading and on-demand loading with structured state on the same tasks. Fix models, tools and tests; record actual files read, first appearance of required evidence, repeated reads, compaction counts and final pass rates. Stratify by task type so averages do not hide regressions on complex tasks.

还可以做移除实验：拿掉一份参考后结果不变，说明它在当前任务集中的边际贡献可能有限.en: Also remove a reference and compare: unchanged results suggest limited marginal contribution on this task set, not irrelevance to every future task. Additions need explicit failure examples, and deletions need corresponding regression cases.

选了高分片段，却漏掉它的否定前半句.en: A high-scoring chunk loses its preceding negation

输入与条件。</strong>原句“不要部署到production；stagin.en: Input and conditions. The original says "Do not deploy to production; staging is allowed." Candidates are split into "deploy to production" and "staging is allowed".

前半残片与部署问题高度相关.en: The first fragment is highly relevant to deployment

检索分数并不能保留逻辑否定。.en: Retrieval scores do not preserve logical negation.

恢复完整句子及主体.en: Recover the full sentence and subject

完整句多占少量空间.en: The full sentence uses slightly more space

先保约束完整，而非机械挑最高相关短片。.en: Preserve complete constraints before mechanically picking the most relevant short fragment.

区分用户限制与引用资料.en: Distinguish user restrictions from quoted material

防止重新获得错误指令身份。.en: Prevent mistaken instruction authority from being regained.

应拒绝，staging仍按其余条件判断。.en: Reject it; judge staging under the remaining conditions.

把过程连起来。</strong>上下文选择需要语义依赖，不能只优化各独立片段的分.en: Join the steps up. Context selection needs semantic dependencies, not just optimized score-to-length ratios for isolated fragments.

边界与反例。</strong>“上下文编译器”在本书是工程类比，不意味着LLM输.en: Limits and counterexamples. This book's "context compiler" is an engineering analogy, not a claim of fully deterministic semantic checking for LLM input.

一条高价值调用示例依赖一个很长的类型文件，预算放不下，怎么办？先检索精确类型定义.en: What if a valuable call example depends on a type file too long for the budget? Retrieve exact type definitions and necessary fields to reduce cost; if still too large, first understand the type and record traceable conclusions as a separate stage, without treating unread content as known. Handle mandatory-constraint conflicts explicitly.

本章最重要的成果不是一个庞大context manager，而是能指出每轮输入里.en: The chapter's main outcome is not a huge context manager, but identifying what each turn needs, why it is trustworthy, where it comes from, when it expires and which specific error its absence would cause.

Evaluate context without perturbing it7. Acceptance questions

The greatest danger is not losing a few background details3. What recoverable state should store4. How to offload and retrieve original evidence5. Compaction breaks even on more than token savings6. How to evaluate semantic fidelity7. A practical strategy and counterexamplesChecking the generation number when a candidate is installed

目标：能设计和评估压缩后的任务连续性，而不是只检验摘要是否流畅。实验：.en: Goal: design and evaluate task continuity after compaction rather than summary fluency alone. Experiment:

只验证结构与版本；自然语言语义压缩效果本书没有实测商业模型。.en: checks only structure and versions; this book has not measured commercial models' semantic compaction of natural language.

压缩的质量目标是继续做对，而不是摘要流畅；先看状态怎样变错。.en: The quality target is continued correctness, not fluent summaries; first inspect how state becomes wrong.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../../visual/F27.html\".en: Related step-by-step process: Compaction must keep the facts an action depends on. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../../visual/F24.html\.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 02 · Task state is not a one-line summary in the chatO10 · Compaction, retrieval and prompt cache: three different kinds of saving

1. 压缩是一种有损的信息转换.en: 1. Compaction is a lossy information transformation

原历史H包含目标、工具反馈、尝试、假设和已验证事实。压缩函数得到C(H)，之后模.en: Original history H contains goals, tool feedback, attempts, assumptions and verified facts. A compaction function produces C(H), from which the model continues acting. The question is whether C(H) increases decision errors over future task distribution Q, not its literal similarity to the original. A short summary may preserve every currently important condition; a long one may lose the sole crucial negation.

Anthropic的上下文工程讨论了压缩、笔记与子Agent；OpenAI文档还.en: Anthropic discusses compaction, notes and sub-agents in context engineering; OpenAI also documents opaque compaction state. These show forms beyond ordinary summaries, but form alone cannot establish lossless downstream tasks.

本书采用一个工程性目标：优先保留会影响后续动作的约束、结论状态、证据入口和未完成.en: This book adopts an engineering objective: prioritize constraints, conclusion status, evidence entry points and unfinished work that affect later actions. This is not a universally optimal compaction algorithm, but a design testable through task recovery experiments.

2. 最危险的损失不是少几个背景细节.en: 2. The greatest danger is not losing a few background details

原记录：“怀疑Skill未加载；但日志未检查，不能认定。”坏摘要：“Skill未.en: Original: "Suspect the Skill was not loaded, but logs are unchecked, so this is unconfirmed." Bad summary: "The unloaded Skill caused the failure." A hypothesis becomes fact, directing later edits toward a wrong root cause.

原记录：“仅调整description，不改变技能内容，也不新增router。”.en: Original: "Change only description, without changing skill content or adding a router." Bad summary: "Optimize skill routing." Negative constraints disappear and scope may expand.

原记录：“测试在commit A通过，之后改过B文件。”坏摘要：“测试全部通过。.en: Original: "Tests passed on commit A; file B changed afterward." Bad summary: "All tests passed." Lost evidence freshness creates false completion.

三类错误分别是认识状态改变、作用范围扩大、证据版本丢失。不能只用关键词召回测试它.en: These errors change epistemic status, expand scope and lose evidence versions respectively. Keyword-recall tests are insufficient because bad summaries still contain Skill, routing, tests and other original terms.

这不是要求每个五分钟任务建立十个文件。短任务可保持会话，只有跨窗口/跨会话或高风.en: Not every five-minute task needs ten files. Short tasks can stay in a session; external state is needed only across windows / sessions or for high-risk tasks. Fields should prevent specific recovery errors rather than complete a form.

验证已确认事实是否引用存在的证据、证据版本是否与当前工件一致。它不能判断“证据文.en: checks whether confirmed facts cite existing evidence and whether evidence versions match the current artifact. This cannot judge whether the evidence text actually supports a conclusion; that requires original reading, specialist semantic judgment or human review. Confusing structural validity with semantic fidelity is a particularly easy misreading of older simulation experiments.

4. 原始证据应该如何卸载和找回.en: 4. How to offload and retrieve original evidence

大日志、完整源码和长文档可放在外部，摘要只保留定位信息及关键片段。但定位信息要可.en: Keep large logs, full source and long documents externally, with locations and key excerpts in summaries. Locations must work: repository path + version + symbol is more stable than a temporary line number; expiring tool-result IDs need lifetimes or retained evidence. "Read some material earlier" cannot restore anything.

并非所有原始内容都值得永久保存。可重新获取、成本低、没有决策影响的内容可以不保存.en: Not all originals deserve permanent retention. Cheaply reacquired material without decision impact can be omitted; mutable external sources, evidence underlying major decisions and costly-to-recover evidence merit retention more. Repeatedly archiving whole repositories for memory adds permission and maintenance burdens.

重新读取也应遵循权限和版本。某个旧工具结果当时允许访问，用户权限后来撤销，就不能.en: Rereading must respect permissions and versions. A formerly accessible tool result cannot remain usable merely because a cached copy survives revoked authorization. Compaction and memory do not remove data-governance duties.

5. 压缩成本的盈亏不只看Token差.en: 5. Compaction breaks even on more than token savings

设压缩本次成本Cc，剩余k轮，压缩后每轮节省Si，但前缀缓存损失为Li，重新检索.en: Let current compaction cost be Cc, remaining turns k, savings per compacted turn Si, prefix-cache loss Li and retrieval cost Ri. A rough calculation is:

。还需考虑压缩错误的返工成本和质量损失，不能将其默认为零。.en: . Include rework and quality losses from compaction errors rather than assume zero.

任务马上结束时，调用一次模型压缩可能没有回本。相反，历史很长且剩余步骤多时，适度.en: A model call for compaction near task completion may not pay back. With long history and many remaining steps, moderate compaction may substantially reduce continuing cost. Better triggers consider remaining work, information contamination, budget margin and recovery difficulty, not just a fixed occupancy percentage.

缓存命中率下降并不表示压缩一定不值得；压缩后的上下文更小，后续多轮仍可能总体更便.en: Lower cache-hit rates do not necessarily make compaction unhelpful: smaller context may still cost less over later turns. Do not keep stale errors to preserve caching. Compare total cost and quality per successful task.

准备含不同类型约束的长任务，在压缩前后做三类测试：事实/约束恢复、证据定位、继续.en: Prepare long tasks with varied constraints and test three things before and after compaction: fact / constraint recovery, evidence location and continued execution. Include negations, withdrawn suggestions, version conflicts and unresolved side effects. Define questions before the experiment rather than select ones the resulting summary can answer.

未压缩历史作为对照，但它也可能因过长而退化，所以还可增加“人工整理的最小充分状态.en: Use uncompacted history as a control, recognizing it too may degrade through length; add "manually organized minimal sufficient state" as an upper-bound reference. Test repeated compaction separately because summaries of summaries may reinforce errors. Record error types rather than only an overall score.

对于商业服务的不可读压缩项，不能直接审查内部内容；仍可把相同任务分叉，比较后续事.en: Opaque commercial compaction items cannot be inspected directly; fork identical tasks and compare later factual answers and actual completion. This is black-box behavioral evaluation, not a claim to have read the internal compressed representation.

故障实验：用两条数据库连接抓住压缩覆盖新事件.en: Failure experiment: catch compaction overwriting new events with two database connections

模型摘要再好，也可能输在提交协议.en: Even an excellent model summary can fail at the commit protocol

连接A读取历史revision=10，开始压缩；连接B写入工具成功事件并把rev.en: Connection A reads history revision=10 and starts compaction; connection B writes a tool-success event and updates revision to 11; A writes back its old summary. An unconditional UPDATE overwrites the new event with old state. This book actually creates two SQLite connections to reproduce the sequence and rejects stale commits with a conditional UPDATE.

SQL语义是“只有当前rev仍等于我读取的10才写入”；影响行数为0时必须作为冲.en: The SQL means "write only if current rev still equals the 10 I read"; 0 affected rows must be treated as a conflict rather than success just because no exception occurred. The final state retains [11, c7 succeeded]. This state evidence matters more than summary fluency.

摘要内容与协议窗口都要验证.en: Verify summary content and protocol windows

服务端压缩接口可能返回包含多类项目的完整窗口；不能只取opaque项。.en: A server-side compaction interface may return a complete window with several item types; keep more than just the opaque item.

应把模型压缩后的上下文与确定性的执行日志分开：前者供理解，后者决定工具是否已经.en: Keep model-compacted context separate from deterministic execution logs: the former supports understanding, the latter determines whether tools executed and retries are allowed.

可以保留快照之后的完整事件尾部，但要检查它是否推翻摘要中的“待完成/未授权”等断.en: The complete event tail after a snapshot can be retained, but check whether it overturns summary claims such as "unfinished / unauthorized". Appending one new tool result to an old summary may leave contradictory state. Regenerate the summary or use authoritative merge rules for structured control state. No single method is universal; acceptance requires the correct next step during recovery.

迟到工具结果、用户修改目标、取消请求、权限变更和第二次压缩同时进行都应覆盖。对每.en: Cover late tool results, changed user goals, cancellation, permission changes and concurrent second compaction. Define permitted and forbidden next actions for each; shorter post-compaction text does not prove continuity.

D04：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: D04: read the result rather than just "passed"

先比较返回项目是否完整，再看历史版本10的摘要是否能覆盖已经到11的真实事件。c.en: Compare completeness of returned items first, then whether a revision-10 summary can overwrite real events already at 11. changed_rows=0 protects new state; it does not mean the compaction request returned nothing.

关联问题：<a href=\"../../chapters/14.html#en.en: Related question: <a href="../../chapters/14.html#engineering-E27">E27: why can a compaction result not retain only the item that "looks most condensed"?

E28：压缩期间工具结果刚好回来：一次历史替换如何丢掉真实进展？.en: E28: a tool result arrives during compaction: how can replacing history lose real progress?

先使用宿主已经提供的压缩机制，同时在项目中保留精简的权威任务状态和原始证据入口。.en: Start with harness-provided compaction while retaining concise authoritative task state and original-evidence entry points in the project. Add targeted safeguards only after repeated observed fidelity failures. Do not default to an extra summarizer agent every few turns, which may add latency, break caching and create competing state.

验收题：压缩后记住所有待办，却忘记已排除的根因，为什么仍危险？因为Agent会重.en: Acceptance question: why is remembering every pending task but forgetting ruled-out causes still dangerous? The agent may repeat disproved paths or promote old hypotheses again. Save a "failed experience" if it changes later retrieval or avoids costly mistakes, not because every attempt needs permanent storage.

一个压缩方案省90%，但两类错误要分开计.en: A compaction approach saves 90%, but count two error categories separately

输入与条件。</strong>基准有10项关键事实；摘要保留8项，其中1项把un.en: Input and conditions. A benchmark has 10 key facts; the summary retains 8, with 1 changing unknown to success, and adds another unsupported conclusion.

关键事实准确保留率70%，不是看到8条文字就算80%。.en: Accurate retention of key facts is 70%, not 80% merely because 8 text items remain.

可能靠原文重取恢复。.en: They may be recovered from the original.

比普通遗漏更可能诱发错误执行。.en: More likely than ordinary omissions to trigger wrong execution.

需要单独记作虚构，不能混进遗漏率。.en: Record it separately as fabrication rather than mix it into omission rate.

尝试按摘要继续任务.en: Try continuing the task from the summary

观察是否跳过核查，才能评价实际风险。.en: Observe skipped verification to assess actual risk.

把过程连起来。</strong>保真度不是单一压缩率；遗漏、误改与虚构有不同修复.en: Join the steps up. Fidelity is not a single compaction ratio; omissions, incorrect alterations and fabrications have different repair costs.

边界与反例。</strong>10项是人工标注教学基准，不能代表自然语言所有事实.en: Limits and counterexamples. The 10 items are a manually labeled teaching benchmark, not an exhaustive account of every natural-language fact.

，提供真实BM25和RRF，不把字符串匹配称为Embedding。.en: , providing real BM25 and RRF rather than calling string matching an embedding.

在一组固定候选上比较排名，才能分清检索模型、融合算法与证据筛选各自的贡献。.en: Compare rankings on fixed candidates to distinguish contributions from retrieval models, fusion algorithms and evidence filtering.

1. 检索是一个分阶段的信息损失过程.en: 1. Retrieval loses information stage by stage

用户问题先被解释为查询；检索器从语料中得到候选；权限与版本过滤限制可见集合；排序.en: A user question becomes a query; retrievers obtain corpus candidates; permission and version filters constrain visibility; ranking selects limited results; the context compiler trims again; finally the model uses evidence. If key material disappears at any stage, even a strong downstream model may answer wrongly.

所以RAG不能只画成“向量数据库→LLM”。需要知道文档如何切分、索引何时建立、.en: RAG therefore needs more than a "vector database → LLM" diagram. Know chunking, index creation time, query encoding, result completeness and how evidence supports answers. Contextual Retrieval adds chunk context and combines retrieval signals, but gains must be remeasured on your own tasks.

首先建立低成本基线：路径/符号精确检索和BM25。只有它们在真实查询上暴露语义缺.en: Start with low-cost baselines: exact path / symbol retrieval and BM25. Add vectors, query rewriting or graphs only after real queries expose semantic gaps. Large frameworks are not prerequisites for retrieval quality.

2. BM25：词频饱和与长度归一化.en: 2. BM25: term-frequency saturation and length normalization

本书采用一种常见的非负IDF形式：.en: This book uses a common nonnegative IDF form:

词越罕见，idf通常越大；一个词在文档内反复出现，收益逐渐饱和，不是重复一百次就.en: Rarer terms usually have larger idf; repeated occurrences within one document give saturating gains, not linear rewards for a hundred repetitions. Length normalization reduces advantages from mere verbosity. Implementations differ in IDF and query-frequency handling; fix the specific formula for comparisons.

代码将snake_case和camelCase拆分，再匹配英文数字词与单个中文字.en: The code splits snake_case and camelCase, then matches English alphanumeric words and individual Chinese characters. This transparent, testable teaching tokenizer is not a high-quality Chinese tokenizer. It often helps English code symbols but may lose Chinese phrase meaning. Measure recall on real queries rather than assume a BM25 implementation completes professional retrieval.

双塔检索通常分别编码查询和文档，通过点积或余弦计算相关性。文档向量可以离线计算，.en: Two-tower retrieval usually encodes queries and documents separately and scores relevance by dot product or cosine. Documents can be encoded offline and queries online; training positives, negatives and task instructions shape the similarity it supports. Similar descriptions need not mean identical facts; semantic approximation may hide opposite conditions, versions and exact identifiers.

如果使用余弦，常见做法是归一化后点积；若索引按内积而向量没有按预期归一化，向量范.en: Cosine commonly uses normalized dot products; if an inner-product index receives unexpectedly unnormalized vectors, norms affect ranking. Changing embedding models, dimensions, preprocessing or instruction templates usually requires rebuilding related indexes; do not mix different vector spaces in one collection.

Cross-encoder让查询与文档共同编码，能做更细相关性判定，但候选对数量.en: A Cross-encoder jointly encodes queries and documents for finer relevance judgments, but candidate-pair counts directly increase cost. It suits reranking small retrieved sets and cannot recover missing candidates. ColBERT retains multi-token representations with late interaction between single-vector efficiency and finer matching, with more complex storage and indexes.

4. ANN为何更快，也为何可能漏掉.en: 4. Why ANN is faster and why it may miss results

精确向量搜索扫描全部向量，容易建立正确性基线。近似最近邻索引用可控的召回损失换速.en: Exact vector search scans every vector, giving a straightforward correctness baseline. Approximate nearest-neighbor indexes trade controlled recall loss for speed or storage. HNSW navigates candidate neighbors through layered graphs; more search candidates usually improve recall at greater cost. IVF selects coarse-cluster buckets, then searches within them; too few probes miss results, too many approach scanning. PQ encodes vector blocks as codebook indexes, reducing storage while approximating distances.

不要把ANN检索的Recall@k与业务证据召回混为一谈。ANN指标可能只是与精.en: Do not conflate ANN Recall@k with business-evidence recall. ANN metrics may only compare with exact vector rankings and show few neighbors lost; if the embedding never ranked the right document highly, even strong ANN recall cannot guarantee business success.

元数据过滤会影响ANN行为。如果先取全局top-k再过滤权限，可能只剩一两项，授.en: Metadata filters affect ANN behavior. Global top-k followed by permission filtering may leave only one or two items, withholding findable material from authorized users. Options include prefiltering, appropriate over-retrieval, partitioning or filter-aware indexes; measure recall and latency under strict ACLs and highly selective filters.

BM25分数与余弦分数不一定同尺度，直接相加容易被某一信号支配。RRF只使用名次.en: BM25 and cosine scores may differ in scale; direct sums risk domination by one signal. RRF uses only ranks:

。它简化跨分数标定，但也舍弃了分数间隔信息。c是调节头部权重的参数，不是神奇常数.en: . This simplifies cross-score calibration but discards score-gap information. c adjusts emphasis on top ranks; it is not a magic constant.

实验实现对每个排名列表去重，防止同一检索器重复返回一个文档制造额外票数。版本不同.en: The experiment deduplicates each ranked list so repeated documents from one retriever cannot manufacture votes. Same-named documents at different versions need clear IDs rather than incorrect merging. Redundancy or coverage selection may follow fusion, but diversity must not remove a necessary second piece of evidence.

查询改写与HyDE可以扩大语义召回：先形成可能的描述，再检索。但假设文档是查询辅.en: Query rewriting and HyDE broaden semantic retrieval by forming possible descriptions before searching. Hypothetical documents are query aids, not real evidence; generated false premises must not enter the final factual chain.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/16.h.en: For the full mechanism and a continuous example see Relevant is not the same as usable: from recall to evidence closure; this section keeps its own derivation and experiment, and the two accounts work at different levels rather than replacing each other.

6. 索引是有生命周期的数据产品.en: 6. An index is a data product with a lifecycle

入库时保存来源ID、内容版本、片段位置、Embedding版本、权限与更新时间。.en: At ingestion, save source ID, content version, chunk position, embedding version, permissions and update time. Source edits or deletion should invalidate indexes and caches; document ACL changes need handling too. Incremental indexing includes replacing, deleting, merging and resolving conflicts, not just adding vectors.

先按tenant、principal、version筛选，再计算可见集合的BM2.en: first filters by tenant, principal and version, then computes BM25 on the visible set; cache keys include these fields, and replacing the document set clears the cache. This actually tests cross-user cache isolation and version switching, but linear scanning establishes no million-item performance and implements no vector index. Production caches also need permission-group changes, index generations and short-term authorization revocation handled.

删除敏感内容不能只从结果列表隐藏。如果摘要、答案缓存或长期记忆仍保留派生内容，也.en: Deleting sensitive content requires more than hiding results. Derived content retained in summaries, answer caches or long-term memory also needs governance. Retrieval security concerns the whole dataflow, not one filter before display.

权限过滤在召回后做，为什么top-k会不足.en: Why permission filtering after retrieval can leave too few top-k results

输入与条件。</strong>查询排名为[私有A,私有B,公开C,公开D]，用户.en: Input and conditions. Query ranking is [private A,private B,public C,public D]; the user may see only C/D and wants 2 results.

随后权限过滤得到空集。.en: Permission filtering then yields an empty set.

先限制权限或扩大可过滤候选.en: Restrict permissions first or expand filterable candidates

候选生成与输出时权限可能变化.en: Permissions may change between candidate generation and output

防止使用过期权限快照。.en: Prevent use of a stale authorization snapshot.

召回率必须相对于用户有权访问的相关集合.en: Recall must use the relevant set the user is authorized to access

不能用全库标注强迫返回私有资料。.en: Global labels must not force private material into results.

把过程连起来。</strong>过滤不只影响安全，也影响召回与“无结果”的解释。.en: Join the steps up. Filtering affects security, recall and the meaning of "no results".

边界与反例。</strong>预过滤、后过滤和混合实现取决于索引能力；示例不承诺.en: Limits and counterexamples. Pre-, post- and hybrid filtering depend on index capabilities; this example does not promise that any particular database supports arbitrary ACLs efficiently.

近似图搜索为什么会漏掉真正最近的点.en: Why approximate graph search can miss the truly nearest point

输入与条件。</strong>查询在数轴0。图中A=4、B=5、C=1；只有A—.en: Input and conditions. The query is at 0 on a number line. A=4,B=5,C=1, with only undirected edges A—B and B—C; start at A. C is clearly nearest, at distance 1.

A距离4，它的邻居B距离5.en: A is distance 4; its neighbor B is distance 5

如果只愿意走向更近的点，就停在A。.en: Moving only toward nearer points stops at A.

A没有更好的一跳邻居.en: A has no better one-hop neighbor

但并不代表全图没有更好的点。.en: This does not mean no better point exists elsewhere in the graph.

暂时保留较差的B，再访问其邻居C.en: Temporarily keep worse B, then visit its neighbor C

发现C距离1，替换当前最佳。.en: Find C at distance 1 and replace the current best.

候选队列与探索预算扩大，会增加访问量.en: Larger candidate queues and exploration budgets increase visits

可能提高召回，但本例不保证任何预算下都能找到全局最近点。.en: They may improve recall, but this example does not guarantee finding the global nearest point under every budget.

把过程连起来。</strong>近似搜索不是“向量一算就必定找对”。距离计算可以.en: Join the steps up. Approximate search is not "compute vectors and always find the right result". Distances may be completely correct while exploration misses candidates.

边界与反例。</strong>这是图遍历反例，不是HNSW完整算法或其精确参数模.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is a graph-traversal counterexample, not the full HNSW algorithm or an exact parameter simulation; real implementations also contain layered graphs, construction strategies and queue rules.

检索诊断：先查表示空间，再查授权候选，最后查融合排序.en: Retrieval diagnosis: representation space, authorized candidates, then fusion ranking

不要让生成模型掩盖上游失败.en: Do not let a generator hide upstream failures

检索系统回答错时，可以暂时把正确证据直接提供给生成器，判断下游能否利用；但这只是.en: When a retrieval system answers wrongly, temporarily supply correct evidence directly to the generator to test its use. This is a diagnostic experiment, not a deployment result. Restore the real index afterward, retain candidates by stage and locate the earliest error.

本书用四个独立但边界明确的小实验：新旧向量基底错配会在相同维度下选错文档；全局T.en: This book uses four independent, explicitly bounded experiments: mismatched old and new vector bases select wrong documents despite equal dimensions; global Top2 then tenant filtering yields nothing; duplicating one retrieval route changes RRF weights; version and tier mismatches prevent real citations supporting conclusions. Model cards, pgvector and Elastic documentation support the corresponding mechanisms separately.

每一阶段要有自己的oracle.en: Every stage needs its own oracle

表示契约检查模型/前缀/池化版本；ANN用小样本精确检索作参考；融合检查候选身份.en: Representation-contract checks cover model / prefix / pooling versions; ANN uses small-sample exact retrieval as reference; fusion checks candidate identity and windows; evidence checks proposition conditions. A plausible final answer cannot prove every preceding stage correct.

记录查询时的授权版本、索引代际和原文指纹。过滤后的空结果应区分“确无允许材料”和.en: Record authorization version, index generation and original-text fingerprint at query time. Distinguish "no permitted material exists" from "candidates were truncated" after filtering; bind final-answer caches to permissions and versions too. Answers from old summaries after revocation are a knowledge-supply-chain issue, not just a database-query issue.

本实验未运行HNSW服务或真实embedding模型，因此没有ANN性能、真实语.en: This experiment runs no HNSW service or real embedding model, so it provides no ANN performance, real semantic recall or business Q&A success rates. It supplies falsifiable logical boundaries and a diagnostic order. Before release, add quality / latency / permission tests on your own data distribution.

D05：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: D05: read the result rather than just "passed"

四组结果分别对应表示空间、候选权限、融合重复源和证据条件。它们位于不同阶段，不应.en: The four result groups concern representation space, candidate permissions, duplicate fusion sources and evidence conditions. They occupy different stages; do not replace every retrieval component at once and then guess what helped.

关联问题：<a href=\"../../chapters/15.html#en.en: Related question: <a href="../../chapters/15.html#engineering-E29">E29: why can equal-dimensional query and index vectors still occupy completely different spaces?

E30：向量查询带了WHERE，为什么仍可能返回不足k条？.en: E30: why can a vector query with WHERE still return fewer than k items?

E31：RRF不看原始分数，为什么重复来源仍会把排名带偏？.en: E31: RRF ignores raw scores, so why can duplicate sources still skew rankings?

E32：相关、可引用、足以支持结论：证据要过三道不同的门.en: E32: relevant, citable, sufficient for a conclusion: evidence must pass three different gates

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/15.h.en: For the full mechanism and a continuous example see Which metadata, once lost while the index is built, is hard to recover?; this section keeps its own derivation and experiment, and the two accounts work at different levels rather than replacing each other.

建立包含精确符号、同义描述、否定条件、跨文档组合、旧版本干扰和无答案的查询集。分.en: Build queries covering exact symbols, synonymous descriptions, negations, cross-document combinations, old-version interference and no answers. Measure candidate-evidence Recall@k, ranking MRR/nDCG, final-answer support rate, latency and cost separately, and require zero unauthorized leakage. Keep the original chunks missed by retrieval rather than judge only whether the model guessed correctly.

验收题：重排模型升级后nDCG变高，但答案更差，可能是什么？候选覆盖不变但证据多.en: Acceptance question: why might higher nDCG after a reranker upgrade accompany worse answers? Coverage may stay unchanged while evidence diversity falls, long-text trimming loses conditions, ranking favors fluent documents over current versions, or task scoring disagrees with retrieval labels. Diagnose stage by stage rather than add larger vector models.

专题研修</span><span>约3.2千字</span><span>图表与逐.ja: トピック研究約3.2千字図表と項目ごとの説明

目标：将“搜索代码”升级为理解语法、名称绑定与变更影响；同时知道哪些关系无法由静.en: Goal: move from "searching code" to understanding syntax, name binding and change impact, while knowing which relationships static analysis cannot guarantee. Experiment:

和第65课仓库修复。.en: and the repository fix in Lesson 65.

结构检索比关键词多了一层关系，却仍依赖源码快照与语言解析能力。.en: Structural retrieval adds relationships beyond keywords, but still depends on source snapshots and language-parsing capabilities.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../../visual/F30.html\".en: Related step-by-step process: Code retrieval cannot rely on "semantically similar" alone. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../../visual/F34.html\.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 04 · A test looks for counterexamples; it does not stamp code greenLesson 23 · Long-term memory is not a note that is always right

1. 文本匹配、语法匹配与语义绑定.en: 1. Text matching, syntax matching and semantic binding

全文搜索回答“这个字符串出现在哪里”；AST回答“这个位置是什么语法结构”；名称.en: Full-text search answers "where does this string appear?"; an AST answers "what syntactic structure is at this position?"; name binding/type analysis answers "which definition does this identifier actually reference?" They are not equivalent. For example, two files may both contain

，它们可能分别是内置函数、方法或导入别名，全文搜索无法消歧。.en: , yet these may be a built-in function, method or imported alias; full-text search cannot disambiguate them.

Tree-sitter查询可以按节点结构和字段定位语法片段；它还暴露错误或缺失节.en: Tree-sitter queries locate syntax fragments by node structure and fields; they also expose error or missing nodes, making them useful for incomplete code under editing. LSP defines requests between clients and language services, including definitions, type definitions, references and diagnostics; check capabilities and implementation to establish whether a language server supports them and how accurately.

AST并不自动提供完整调用图。动态属性、反射、依赖注入、生成代码和运行时插件使静.en: An AST does not automatically provide a complete call graph. Dynamic attributes, reflection, dependency injection, generated code and runtime plugins can make static relationships incomplete. This book's Python AST experiment returns only function/class names and line ranges; it does not claim cross-file name resolution.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/17.h.en: For the complete mechanism and the continuous example see Why does code evidence need the work-tree version, and not just the commit?; this section keeps its original derivation and experiment, and the two accounts work at different levels rather than replacing each other.
完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/17.h.ja: 仕組み全体と一連の例は、コードの証拠に、commitだけでなく作業ツリーのバージョンが必要なのはなぜか？を参照してください。この節でも従来の導出と実験を残しています。両者は異なる水準の説明であり、互いを置き換えるものではありません。

2. 一次“技能没有加载”的证据路径.en: 2. An evidence path for "the skill did not load"

先读取实际任务记录，确定失败发生在发现、选择、读取、注入还是执行。然后定位加载入.en: Read the actual task record first to locate failure in discovery, selection, reading, injection or execution. Then locate the loading entry point and conditional branches; read the configuration types and callers that determine the branch; finally find tests for those conditions. This path follows a falsifiable hypothesis rather than traversing the whole root directory first.

例如候选根因是cwd错误。必须找到启动时cwd如何产生、规则发现函数如何使用cw.en: For example, suppose the candidate root cause is an incorrect cwd. Find how startup establishes cwd, how rule-discovery functions use it, and whether tests cover nested directories. Seeing only a function name

，还不能证明它被调用，更不能证明返回内容进入模型输入。运行轨迹和源码链共同建立证.en: does not prove it was called, much less that its return entered model input. Execution traces and the source-code chain establish evidence together.

当代码路径不明确，文本搜索可以低成本先找错误消息、配置键和日志事件；语义检索则帮.en: When a code path is unclear, text search cheaply finds error messages, configuration keys and log events; semantic retrieval maps "why does it not take effect?" to possible modules. The right approach usually combines methods rather than declaring one retrieval method a universal replacement for the rest.

按固定字符数切代码，可能截断函数签名、异常处理和闭包。按AST符号切块更符合结构.en: Fixed-character code chunks may cut through function signatures, exception handling or closures. AST-symbol chunking better respects structure, but large functions may remain too long and small functions may lose type and caller context. A reasonable index can store the main symbol text, parent scope, import summary, path and version, then expand related information on demand.

符号名称不能单独做全局主键：重载、同名类、不同文件、不同版本都会冲突。可用仓库+.en: A symbol name alone cannot be a global primary key: overloads, same-named classes, different files and different versions collide. Use repository+version+path+qualified symbol name as a locator, with a stable range attached. Line numbers are snapshot coordinates and may move after edits; display the version alongside them.

代码注释和文档也是证据，但与执行逻辑冲突时要调查，而不是自动选择更易读的一方。测.en: Comments and documentation are evidence too, but conflicts with execution logic need investigation rather than automatically choosing the easier-to-read side. Test assertions express expectations and source code expresses current behavior; a mismatch may be the defect to fix. "The current code does this" does not mean the user must want it.

图节点可以是模块、函数、类型、配置或测试；边可以表示调用、导入、继承、数据依赖或.en: Graph nodes can be modules, functions, types, configuration or tests; edges may represent calls, imports, inheritance, data dependencies or coverage. Edge confidence varies: compiler-resolved direct references are usually stronger than text-based guesses; runtime traces cover only executed paths and do not establish that others are absent.

修改函数后，先看直接调用者、参数与返回契约，再看边界使用和错误处理；测试选择可以.en: After changing a function, inspect direct callers and argument/return contracts, then boundary uses and error handling; test selection can expand along dependencies. Missing static edges, dynamic paths, shared data and build configuration can still cause omissions. For high-risk changes, broaden regression checks after focused tests rather than treating the graph as absolute proof.

这也解释了为什么代码库RAG不仅需要“找最像的一段代码”。实现任务需要定义、调用.en: This also explains why codebase RAG needs more than "find the most similar code snippet". Implementation needs combined evidence from definitions, calls, configuration and tests. RepoCoder studies iterative retrieval and generation together, but success on repository-completion benchmarks does not directly establish arbitrary bug-fixing capability.

提交历史有助于找到行为何时引入、当时理由、相关测试和回滚风险。它是当前代码理解的.en: Commit history helps identify when behavior appeared, the reasons at the time, related tests and rollback risks. It supports understanding current code rather than replacing it. An old decision may address constraints that no longer exist; making an old PR conclusion a permanent rule creates stale memory.

对回归问题，可用二分定位引入变化的范围，但环境与依赖必须可复现；否则测试红绿可能.en: For regressions, binary search can narrow the change that introduced the issue, but the environment and dependencies must be reproducible; otherwise, infrastructure noise may determine test passes and failures. Recording failing samples and commands is more useful than one commit alone. Commit messages may also be incomplete and need diffs and runnable evidence.

6. “没搜到”为什么不是不存在.en: 6. Why "not found" does not mean nonexistent

搜索可能受忽略规则、文件类型、隐藏目录、索引延迟、语言服务器未完成分析或查询表达.en: Search may be limited by ignore rules, file types, hidden directories, index delays, unfinished language-server analysis or query expressions. Negative conclusions need a search scope and method. For example, "no text references to this symbol were found in the current src directory" cannot become "the entire system never calls it".

扩大搜索应由缺口触发：先增加可能模块或配置目录，再查动态注册和生成代码。无限扩展.en: Expand searches to address gaps: add likely modules or configuration directories first, then inspect dynamic registration and generated code. Expanding indefinitely into every dependency also reduces efficiency. Stop when evidence supports the decision, or when remaining uncertainty is explicit and needs external material, rather than insisting on traversing every file.

7. 检索到证据后还要控制写入.en: 7. Writes still need control after evidence is retrieved

精确定位后，补丁应针对读取版本生成并验证。文件可能在检索与写入之间改变，LSP.en: After precise location, generate and verify the patch against the version read. Files can change between retrieval and writing, LSP buffers may differ from disk, and tests may read build artifacts rather than current source. Such version mismatches are frequent engineering risks in AI development.

在IDE场景，应明确以未保存编辑器buffer还是磁盘文件为准；在CLI场景，应.en: In an IDE, specify whether unsaved editor buffers or disk files are authoritative; in a CLI, inspect existing user changes in the work tree and avoid overwriting them. AI development does not justify weaker change-isolation standards than ordinary software engineering.

增量分析一个函数改名，哪些证据应更新.en: Incrementally analyzing a function rename: which evidence must change

输入与条件。</strong>把a.py中的parse改名为parse_conf.en: Input and conditions. Rename parse in a.py to parse_config; b.py imports it statically, while c.py registers the name through a string.

增量解析只需重建受影响语法范围。.en: Incremental parsing rebuilds only the affected syntax range.

检查语言服务索引是否重建。.en: Check whether the language-service index was rebuilt.

c.py字符串未被静态重命名覆盖.en: c.py's string is not covered by static renaming

用注册表与运行测试补验证。.en: Add verification through the registry and runtime tests.

旧搜索结果仍显示parse.en: Old search results still show parse

作为过期定位线索，不直接采信。.en: Treat them as stale location clues, not authoritative evidence.

导入、注册查找与调用测试.en: Import, registration lookup and call tests

覆盖不同证据类型的遗漏。.en: Cover omissions across different evidence types.

把过程连起来。</strong>增量语法树更新不等于全项目语义和运行行为自动一致.en: Join the steps up. Updating an incremental syntax tree does not automatically align project-wide semantics and runtime behavior.

边界与反例。</strong>各语言服务器重命名覆盖不同；不保证所有动态引用可被.en: Limits and counterexamples. Rename coverage differs across language servers; static tools cannot be guaranteed to find every dynamic reference.

AST找到了一个函数调用，能否证明目标函数必然执行？不能，控制流可能不进入该分支.en: Does finding a function call in an AST prove its target must execute? No. Control flow may never enter that branch, and name binding may point to another object. Control flow, type/binding information and runtime conditions are needed.

一次修复的证据包应至少能指出：哪个行为不满足什么要求、根因在哪个具体分支、哪些调.en: A repair evidence package should at least identify which behavior violates which requirement, the exact root-cause branch, affected calls, how the patch changes behavior, and which checks pass on the current version. It can be short, but a vague "everything was checked" cannot replace the chain.

专题研修</span><span>约4.0千字</span><span>图表与逐.en: Topic studiesabout 4.0k charactersFigures and item-by-item notes
专题研修</span><span>约4.0千字</span><span>图表与逐.ja: トピック研究約4.0千字図表と項目ごとの説明

目标：设计能降低重复研究、又不会变成第二份错误真相的记忆。实验：.en: Goal: design memory that reduces repeated research without becoming a second, incorrect source of truth. Experiment:

。本章是系统设计，不假设模型会自动把对话写进参数。.en: . This chapter concerns system design, without assuming the model automatically writes conversations into parameters.

来源、有效时间与录入时间共同限定记忆能否使用；冲突不能只靠最近写入覆盖。.en: Provenance, valid time and recording time jointly determine whether memory is usable; conflicts cannot be resolved by overwriting with the latest write alone.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../../visual/F31.html\".en: Related step-by-step process: Long-term memory is not a note that is always right. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

1. 从认知分类走向存储语义.en: 1. From cognitive categories to storage semantics

CoALA用记忆、行动和决策组织语言Agent；MemGPT讨论有限上下文与外部.en: CoALA organizes language agents through memory, action and decisions; MemGPT discusses layered management of limited context and external storage. They help establish structure, but are not production database schemas that must be copied.

工作记忆是当前任务所需状态；情景记忆记录具体经历；语义记忆保存可复用事实；程序性.en: Working memory holds current-task state; episodic memory records specific experiences; semantic memory keeps reusable facts; procedural memory stores methods. Engineering concerns how each item is written, when it applies, what evidence supports it, and how it is retrieved and deleted. A skill file can carry procedural knowledge without every success automatically warranting a new skill.

任务checkpoint和长期经验要分开。前者需要精确的已执行动作与未决状态，后.en: Separate task checkpoints from long-term experience. The former need precise executed actions and unresolved states; the latter should distill information that changes future actions. Permanently storing entire task conversations in an experience database adds retrieval noise and many unproductive guesses.

2. 一条经验什么时候值得留下.en: 2. When an experience is worth keeping

设重新发现某结论的成本为Cr，未来被正确复用次数估计n，写入/维护/检索成本为C.en: Let rediscovering a conclusion cost Cr, its estimated number of correct future reuses be n, writing/maintenance/retrieval cost Cm, and incorrect-reuse loss Ce. Rough net value is then

。这不是要求精确算概率，而是提醒记忆也有成本。.en: . This does not require exact probability calculations; it reminds us that memory also has costs.

对研发项目，高价值记忆常是“入口在哪里”“哪条看似合理的路径已经被证伪”“某决策.en: For development projects, valuable memories often identify "where the entry point is", "which plausible path was falsified", "why a decision exists" or "which checks catch this error class". Low-value memories are often obvious from code, available in one search or general knowledge without conditions of use. Memory retrieval should replace repeated reading, not add to all existing context.

例如：“该版本规则加载有总字节预算，嵌套规则未进入输入时先检查预算与cwd，证据.en: For example: "This version has a total byte budget for rule loading; if nested rules never enter input, inspect the budget and cwd first, with evidence from a specific commit and function." This changes the next action and is more useful than "remember to check skill loading". Changed code in a new version requires invalidating or rewriting the experience.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/18.h.en: For the full mechanism and continuing examples, see Why is writing memory a pipeline with leases and acceptance?. This section retains its original derivations and experiments; the two explanations work at different levels and do not replace each other.

3. 双时间：事实何时有效，与系统何时知道.en: 3. Bi-temporality: when a fact is valid and when the system knows it

假设配置在第20天切换，但系统第30天才收到证据。回答“第25天实际是什么配置”.en: Suppose configuration changes on day 20, but the system receives evidence only on day 30. "What was the actual configuration on day 25?" and "what did the system know on day 25?" are different questions. One update timestamp cannot answer both.

表示记录进入系统的时间，并保留来源版本。查询带.en: for when the record enters the system, while retaining source versions. Queries with

，能够区分迟到信息。有效区间使用左闭右开，避免边界时刻两个版本都自动生效。.en: distinguish late information. Validity intervals are left-closed and right-open so two versions do not automatically take effect at the same boundary instant.

这是真实SQLite查询，不是模拟模型记忆。当前实现没有完整事务时间历史、撤回事.en: These are actual SQLite queries, not simulated model memory. The current implementation lacks full transaction-time history, retraction events, concurrent merging and natural-language conflict judgments; it shows how minimal metadata prevent temporal confusion. Whether production needs bi-temporality depends on retrospective queries and late updates; ordinary personal notes need not add it by default.

4. 冲突不应通过“最新一条”盲目覆盖.en: 4. Do not blindly overwrite conflicts with "the latest entry"

两条说法矛盾可能因为版本不同、作用域不同、时间不同，也可能真的存在错误。先按这些.en: Contradictory statements may differ in version, scope or time, or may contain actual errors. Separate these dimensions before deciding whether a conflict exists. With multiple valid conclusions under identical conditions, this book returns

，不随机选一条。.en: instead of choosing one at random.

模型抽取出的事实先作为候选，不应因语言流畅就自动升级为active。验证可来自当.en: Model-extracted facts start as candidates and should not automatically become active because they sound fluent. Verification may come from current source, deterministic tests, authoritative documentation or human confirmation. Evidence strengths imply different uses, without requiring a complex grading system; explicit "verified / awaiting verification / invalid" states are usually enough.

长期记忆不能覆盖用户当前明确约束。用户要求本次不增加新Agent，即使历史经验偏.en: Long-term memory must not override the user's clear current constraints. If the user requests no new agents this time, follow that goal even if past experience favors multiple agents. External pages or low-trust tool results especially cannot gain authority through "writing memory"; this is where memory poisoning and prompt injection intersect.

记忆诊断：错误不在“没搜到”，而在拿错时间、拿到已撤销结论.en: Memory diagnosis: the error is wrong timing or a retracted conclusion, not "not found"

“第6天当时我们知道多少”与“现在回看第6天实际是多少”是不同问题。本书按有效时.en: "What did we know on day 6 at the time?" differs from "looking back now, what was the actual value on day 6?" This book queries the same event stream by valid time and recording time, obtaining 10 and 20. Keeping only the latest value would collapse the questions into one answer. Temporal reasoning and knowledge updates need separate evaluation.

来源变更如何影响派生经验.en: How source changes affect derived experience

再把doc→chunk→summary→memory/answer_cache画.en: Then draw doc→chunk→summary→memory/answer_cache as a dependency graph. Retracting doc must at least block unsupported derivatives from further use. The program computes the invalidation closure and retains original local results; deleting one embedding vector is not enough.

适用条件也属于记忆内容.en: Conditions of use are also memory content

“遇到超时可重试”应带条件：只读、下游幂等或已核验未执行。去掉条件后保存成通用经.en: "Retry after a timeout" needs conditions: read-only operation, downstream idempotency or confirmation that execution did not occur. Saving it without conditions as general experience turns a past safe policy into a future dangerous action. Experience entries need at least triggers, provenance, versions, and success/failure boundaries, not just one affirmative recommendation.

先写入、检索、产生派生结论；再补充追溯生效的新事实、撤销原来源或修改权限；最后询.en: First write, retrieve and derive conclusions; then add newly evidenced facts effective retrospectively, retract original sources or change permissions; finally ask about past and present, checking retrieved evidence and final executable actions. Tests of one write and one recall rate cannot reveal this long-term drift.

本实验治理外部记录，不操作基础模型参数，也不声称完成法律上的删除合规。真实系统还.en: This experiment governs external records, not base-model parameters, and does not claim legal compliance with deletion requirements. Real systems must also include backups, logs, third-party storage and permission revocation in policy; extend the design for your environment rather than copying one teaching table directly.

D06：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: D06: how to read these results rather than only "passed"

先区分有效时间与获知时间，再沿来源依赖处理撤回。两条事实都能被检索到，不意味着它.en: First separate when a fact was valid from when the system learned it, then handle retractions along provenance dependencies. Retrieving both facts does not mean both apply to the current question.

关联问题：<a href=\"../../chapters/18.html#en.en: Related question: <a href="../../chapters/18.html#engineering-E35">E35: "When it was true" and "when it became known": the two times in memory have to be kept apart

E36：删掉原文不等于遗忘：摘要、缓存与经验条目也有依赖.en: E36: Deleting the original text is not forgetting: summaries, caches and experience entries depend on it too

记忆检索可以先按项目、模块、任务类型、版本和权限缩小，再用词项或向量找相关条目。.en: Memory retrieval can narrow by project, module, task type, version and permissions before terms or vectors locate relevant entries. Relevance is not applicability; check lifecycle state before returning results. Whether source code needs reading after memory depends on task risk and information-change speed; current implementation details usually need rechecking.

记忆条目应带证据入口，不要求每次把证据全文加载。索引可以是一份简短目录，文件系统.en: Memory entries should link to evidence without always loading it in full. A short catalog can be an index, and a file system may suffice. Consider dedicated services or graph databases only when scale, queries or concurrency create actual bottlenecks.

重复条目合并时保留来源与适用条件，不要把不同版本的相似经验融合成无条件规则。删除.en: When merging duplicates, keep provenance and conditions of use rather than blending similar experience from different versions into unconditional rules. Deletion and revoked permissions must also propagate to summaries, caches and indexes, not just the main table.

6. A-MEM、Mem0与图结构：怎样读而不迷信.en: 6. A-MEM, Mem0 and graph structures: read critically

A-MEM探索动态链接、组织与更新记忆；Mem0讨论从对话提取与维护可扩展记忆。.en: A-MEM explores dynamic memory linking, organization and updates; Mem0 discusses extracting and maintaining scalable memory from conversations. Their experiments suggest potential in some organizational methods, but benchmarks, models, data and comparisons each have limits. Paper names or scores alone cannot determine suitability for a code repository.

图结构适合需要跨关系组合的问题，但抽取边本身可能有错，更新与冲突更复杂。若实际任.en: Graphs suit problems requiring combinations across relationships, but extracted edges may themselves be wrong, and updates and conflicts become more complex. If the task merely finds a historical root cause by module, a lightweight index may be better. Compare no-memory, static-rule and retrieval-on-demand baselines before adding graphs.

LongMemEval等评测包含跨会话信息利用、时间与更新等挑战，说明记忆评价不.en: Evaluations such as LongMemEval cover cross-session information use, time and updates, showing why memory evaluation needs more than one factual question.

真实研发评价还应测重复错误是否减少、首次有效定位是否更快、当前源码冲突时是否纠正.en: Real development evaluation should also test whether repeated errors decrease, the first useful location is found sooner, conflicts with current source are corrected, and stale advice is rejected.

必须保留无记忆对照。如果系统原本两次搜索就能完成任务，新记忆却增加抽取、检索、验.en: Keep a no-memory control. If two searches originally complete a task, but new memory adds three model calls for extraction, retrieval and verification, a correct final result may still not justify it. Evaluate "which costs memory replaced", not merely the number of entries stored.

一条相似记忆不适用于当前环境.en: A similar memory does not apply to the current environment

输入与条件。</strong>记忆A：“测试环境timeout=3”，记忆B：“.en: Input and conditions. Memory A: "test environment timeout=3"; memory B: "production environment timeout=5". The user asks about production, but A's wording is more similar to the question.

B已过期且无新证据.en: B has expired, with no new evidence

应重新查生产配置，不退回A凑答案。.en: Recheck production configuration rather than fall back to A to fill the answer.

新生产值7有证据.en: A new production value of 7 has evidence

写入新有效区间并失效旧生产值，不影响测试环境记录。.en: Write a new validity interval and invalidate the old production value without affecting test-environment records.

把过程连起来。</strong>记忆检索首先是带条件的事实选择，其次才是文字相似.en: Join the steps up. Memory retrieval first selects facts under conditions; textual similarity comes second.

边界与反例。</strong>示例为简单结构化条件；复杂自然语言适用范围仍可能存.en: Limits and counterexamples. This example uses simple structured conditions; complex natural-language scopes may still be misjudged.

一条经验连续三次奏效，可以升级为通用规则吗？不能仅凭次数。三次可能来自同一模板或.en: Can an experience that works three times in a row become a general rule? Not from the count alone. All three may share a template or version; examine task coverage, shared conditions, counterexamples and change risks. An upgraded rule must remain retractable and state when it should not be used.

专题研修</span><span>约3.0千字</span><span>图表与逐.ja: トピック研究約3.0千字図表と項目ごとの説明

目标：能区分技能发现、内容加载、工具权限、模型选择和实际能力应用；以少而准确的机.en: Goal: distinguish skill discovery, content loading, tool permissions, model selection and actual application of expertise; improve quality with a few precise mechanisms rather than building multiple routing layers by default.

Prompt、Skill、工具、模型各在不同层起作用；先确认失败点，再改变路由。.en: Prompts, skills, tools and models operate at different layers; identify the failure point before changing routing.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../../visual/F32.html\".en: Related step-by-step process: A skill exists — so why can it still be of no use at all?. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../../visual/F25.html\.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 08 · MCP connects interfaces; it does not hand over permissions on its ownLesson 11 · Each turn's context is like a working file with a boundaryO12 · Model routing: cheaper per call is not cheaper per successful task

1. 四种路由不是同一个问题.en: 1. Four kinds of routing are different problems

技能路由选择程序性知识；工具路由选择可执行能力；模型路由选择成本/能力配置；任务.en: Skill routing selects procedural knowledge; tool routing selects executable capabilities; model routing selects a cost/capability configuration; delegation assigns control and context responsibilities. These can be combined, but one "relevance score" cannot make every decision.

例如一个存储系统任务需要事务专业知识，不一定需要新的子Agent；主Agent可.en: For example, a storage-system task may need transaction expertise without a new sub-agent; the main agent can read the skill on demand. Needing database tools does not authorize production writes. Deep reasoning does not necessarily require a model classifier to choose the model first. Every added layer should address a specific real failure.

Agent Skills规范描述元数据、主体和资源组织；宿主如何发现、加载和执行.en: The Agent Skills specification describes metadata, bodies and resource organization; check the particular implementation for how a harness discovers, loads and executes resources. Following the file format meets only one condition for recognition, not proof of identical CLI behavior.

2. 描述应该帮助区分，而不是扩大存在感.en: 2. Descriptions should distinguish scope, not maximize visibility

一个差描述：“处理所有高级软件工程问题，保证最佳质量。”它几乎匹配任何任务，无法.en: A poor description: "Handle all advanced software engineering problems and guarantee the best quality." It matches almost any task and reveals no boundary. A better description states task signals and expertise, such as transaction isolation, write consistency or data migration, while saying pure styling changes do not need it.

但描述也不能过窄到必须出现准确关键词才加载。用户说“两个请求同时更新后丢了一次修.en: A description also must not be so narrow that loading requires exact keywords. "Two simultaneous requests lost one update" may need concurrency and consistency expertise without the words "lost update". Regression samples should cover keywords, synonyms, implicit expertise needs, easily confused neighboring tasks and unrelated tasks.

路由目标是恰当，不是加载越多越好。漏掉必要技能与多加载无关技能代价不同，需结合任.en: Routing aims for appropriateness, not maximum loading. Missing necessary skills and loading unrelated ones have different costs; consider task quality and cost together. Loading every skill makes recall look high but defeats routing's purpose.

3. 一份专业Skill应该包含什么.en: 3. What a specialist skill should contain

专业内容应能改变工程动作。以持久化为例：本地事务不能覆盖远程副作用，超时需要un.en: Expert content should change engineering actions. For persistence: local transactions do not cover remote side effects, timeouts need an unknown state, retries need idempotency/reconciliation, version checks prevent stale writes, and tests should cover crash windows. These are more useful than "consider security, performance and maintainability".

建议核心保持目标、适用条件、关键风险与执行路径，细节资源按需读取。示例应标明约束.en: Keep goals, applicability, key risks and execution paths in the core, reading detailed resources on demand. Examples should state constraints rather than force every project into one framework. A simple fix should not require a full architecture report; a complex distributed problem needs more than a generic checklist.

代码资源与模板应可运行、可验证；内容中的版本依赖需标注。工具命令不得默认带有不必.en: Code resources and templates should be runnable and verifiable, with version dependencies stated. Tool commands must not default to unnecessary privileges. A downloaded skill is also input needing review; placement in the skill directory does not make it trustworthy.

4. “已激活”与“有效应用”之间的证据链.en: 4. The evidence chain from "activated" to "effectively applied"

至少分成发现、选择、读取、进入上下文、形成动作、结果满足专业要求六步。日志显示选.en: Separate at least six steps: discovery, selection, reading, entering context, shaping actions and meeting specialist requirements in the result. A log showing skill selection establishes only the earlier steps; the model saying "followed" does not establish the later ones.

评价应在结果中找专业差异。例如事务Skill是否让实现处理超时未知、避免重复写入.en: Look for specialist differences in results. For example, does a transaction skill handle unknown timeout outcomes, prevent duplicate writes and add matching fault tests, rather than merely repeat "idempotency" in the answer? Conversely, correct completion without explicitly loading a skill suggests that task may not justify the extra skill cost.

静态测试能检查描述格式、路径、路由边界样本和资源存在；它不能证明真实宿主将其加载.en: Static tests check description formats, paths, routing-boundary samples and resource existence; they cannot establish that a real harness loads the skill and improves code quality. Report static contract tests separately from actual task A/B comparisons, without substituting the former for the latter.

5. 模型路由：先知道候选，再谈最优.en: 5. Model routing: know the candidates before seeking the optimum

不同CLI、账号和配置可用模型不同。扩展层不应凭记忆硬编码一组“肯定可用”的模型.en: Available models vary by CLI, account and configuration. An extension should not hardcode supposedly available model names from memory; prioritize candidates visible to the harness and user configuration. Capability also depends on tool support, context and output formats, not just the price per token.

一个简洁策略是使用可靠默认模型，只有已知任务约束或明确证据需要时才切换。引入级联.en: A concise policy uses a reliable default model and switches only for known task constraints or explicit evidence. For cascades, include the first failure, retries, context handoff and error-detection rate. If a small model errs and the verifier misses it, escalation never triggers.

推理强度与模型路由应避免双重过度控制。先用真实任务测试默认配置，再讨论某类低风险.en: Avoid excessive control of both reasoning effort and model routing. Test default settings on real tasks first, then consider downgrading some low-risk task types. Do not add an analysis agent merely to decide whether analysis is needed, creating recursive costs.

多个Skill同时定义“必须先分析”“立即实现”“一定独立Review”，可能产.en: Multiple skills demanding "analyze first", "implement immediately" and "always get independent review" can conflict. Follow user goals, harness permissions and explicit project constraints, while specialist skills offer conditional advice rather than compete for top-level process control.

工程简报或任务状态若存在，应作为当前目标的集中入口，其他文件引用它而不复制多份版.en: If an engineering brief or task state exists, use it as the central entry point for the current goal; other files should reference it rather than duplicate versions. Not every project needs a formal brief, but when scattered information conflicts, reduce authoritative copies instead of adding another coordination layer.

技能召回变高但误加载也变高，算不算优化.en: Is higher skill recall an optimization if unnecessary loading also rises?

输入与条件。</strong>10个需要并发技能的任务中旧系统命中8，新系统命中.en: Input and conditions. Among 10 tasks needing a concurrency skill, the old system finds 8 and the new one 10; among 90 tasks not needing it, false triggers rise from 2 to 30.

大量无关任务被增加流程。.en: Many unrelated tasks receive extra process.

30个误触发任务多读资料和审查.en: 30 falsely triggered tasks add reading and review

可能拖慢多数普通工作。.en: Most ordinary work may slow down.

看漏掉的2个正例为何不匹配.en: Find why the 2 missed positive cases did not match

尝试定向边界修复而非泛化“所有开发”。.en: Try targeted boundary fixes instead of generalizing to "all development".

同时比较任务成功与效率.en: Compare task success and efficiency together

不能用一个召回指标宣布全面更好。.en: One recall metric cannot establish overall superiority.

把过程连起来。</strong>技能路由要兼顾该用时用与不该用时不用，指标需要同.en: Join the steps up. Skill routing must load when needed and avoid loading when unnecessary; metrics must constrain both.

边界与反例。</strong>数据是教学混淆矩阵，非任何真实rd-skills测.en: Limits and counterexamples. These are a teaching confusion matrix, not actual rd-skills evaluation results.

完整机制与连续例子见 <a href=\"../../chapters/19.h.en: For the full mechanism and continuing examples, see How does a progressively loaded skill go from "a file" to actual capability?. This section retains its original derivations and experiments; the two explanations work at different levels and do not replace each other.

选择一组真实任务，比较无技能、旧技能、新技能，在相同宿主/模型/工具下测专业缺陷.en: Choose real tasks and compare no skill, the old skill and the new skill under the same harness/model/tools. Measure specialist defects, functional success, extra reading and total time. Keep clear false-loading and missed-loading cases; ablate the new approach to identify which content produces gains.

验收题：新版路由准确率提高，但生成代码质量下降，是否合并？不能仅按路由指标合并。.en: Acceptance question: routing accuracy rises but generated-code quality falls. Should the new version merge? Not on routing metrics alone. The correct skill may have stale content, or loading costs may displace source evidence. The final goal is engineering tasks, not the routing classifier itself.
